# dsh-media-gen [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key already configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.** ## Features - Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation card or command. - Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for image or video generation. - Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default). Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session. - English and Japanese UI; command responses are English. ## Compatibility Choose a release for your DSH version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen/releases). Supported versions and changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Replace `` with the full release tag you selected: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen.git#' ``` The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be authenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile. To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs the latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-media-gen ``` Restart DSH after removal. In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key. ## Usage

*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation edited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.* ### Generation cards and chat Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options. - **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details. - **Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first. You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/image --count` instead repeats the same prompt. Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card using the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft. Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval. ### Commands Place options before the prompt and quote paths containing spaces with `"`. | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--yes] ` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs | | `/video [--model id] [--duration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] ` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames and reference images | | `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediately | | `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults | | `/media-model image` | List image model IDs | | `/media-model image [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation | | `/media-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection | | `/media-approval on` | Allow generation in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation | | `/media-approval off` | Restore normal per-request confirmation | Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; selections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own model argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card model through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection. ### Approval and costs Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent requests ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conversation permission; only the user can change it. Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second generation call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `requireApproval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them. Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges. Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image request fails, already saved images are returned with the failure. ### Video jobs Jobs resume tracking after a DSH restart when storage is available. Completed files are downloaded automatically; completion, failure, or expiry is reported to the session when it is open. Jobs started with `/video` do not wake the agent on completion; use `/media-jobs` or wait for the next agent turn. After `videoMaxWatchMs` (3 hours by default), tracking stops. This does **not** cancel the provider job or guarantee a refund. Ask the agent to check the job with `media_video_status` and its `job_id` to resume tracking. ## Configuration Open **Plugins → Media Generation → Components → Media Generation >** for model defaults, chat-menu models, limits, approval, and notifications. **All models…** can select a model outside your chat-menu filter; the agent can still list all models. | Setting | Default | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `defaultImageProvider` / `defaultImageModel` | unset | Default image provider/model IDs | | `defaultVideoProvider` / `defaultVideoModel` | unset | Default video provider/model IDs | | `chatImageModels` / `chatVideoModels` | `[]` | Chat-menu model IDs; empty shows all | | `maxImagesPerCall` | 4 | Images per call | | `maxVideoSeconds` | 10 | Video duration limit; see Limitations | | `requireApproval` | true | Normal per-generation confirmation | | `outputDir` | `generated-media` | Relative output path within the working directory | | `notifyOnVideoCompletion` | true | Notify the session when a video job ends | For polling, tracking, timeout, cache, and download-size settings, see the [configuration schema](src/index.ts). ## Limitations - Input images are sent to OpenRouter. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 20 MiB are accepted, and the model must support the requested input images or frames. API keys are not sent to the browser. - Avoid common output-folder names such as `Pictures`. To display older outputs, the image route also accepts images in matching output folders without distinguishing working directories. - Video previews support mp4, m4v, webm, and mov up to 32 MiB, independently of the download limit. - When duration is omitted, `maxVideoSeconds` can limit the model's default only if its catalog lists supported durations. - Without DSH storage, video tracking does not survive restarts. ## Development After cloning: ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm check ``` `pnpm check` runs type checks, the build, tests, and CHANGELOG validation. To load the local checkout: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add ``` After editing `src/`, run `pnpm build` and commit the generated `lib/` files with the source changes. Update both READMEs whe

plugins.description: View and manage DeepSeek Harness agent modes in Web Settings: toggle plugins, edit system prompts, create modes from templates.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-modes · Mode Manager English | [中文](https://github.com/xiaohai-78/dsh-modes/blob/main/README.zh.md) Mode manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). It adds a **Modes** page to the Web interface's Settings, where you switch what each agent mode can do, edit each mode's system prompt, create your own modes from templates, and merge built-in updates in one click after a dsh upgrade. ## What it does - **Understand each mode at a glance**: every mode gets a card that lists what it can do (run commands, read and write files, browse the web, use subagents, and so on), so you can compare modes without opening them. - **Switch capabilities, not plugins**: 15 capabilities, one switch each. For example, turn off "Run commands" or make files read-only, without facing dozens of plugin names. - **Edit the prompt**: edit each mode's system prompt with a preview and a version history. You can also let a saved prompt reach sessions that are already running, or let the model change the prompt in chat; every save asks you first. - **Create your own modes**: start from four templates (Develop, Write, Chat, Read-only research), or copy any existing mode. - **Keep up with dsh upgrades**: when dsh updates its built-in modes, merge the changes in one click and keep yours. When a plugin fails to load, turn off just the failing plugins in one click. ## Install You need the dsh Web interface (`dsh web`). See [Compatibility](#compatibility) for supported versions. ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-modes ``` If you run dsh from source, run `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-modes` in the source folder instead. After installing, restart `dsh web` and open **Settings → Modes**. ## Quick start 1. Open **Settings → Modes** and look at the built-in modes: the small labels on each card are what it can do. 2. Click **New mode** at the top right, pick **Read-only research**, and click **Create**. 3. The new card opens on the **Capabilities** tab: **Run commands** is off, and **Files** is on with **Allow file changes** off. 4. Click **New session with it** on the card and ask it to change a file. This mode has no tool to write files, edit files, or run commands, so it can only read and search. 5. Go back to the card's **Prompt** tab, change a sentence, and save. New sessions use it right away; to apply it to sessions that are already running, turn on **Live prompt** below. ## Features ### The mode list Each mode is one card: - **Header**: the name and description, with **Default** and **Custom** labels. - **Capability labels**: what the mode can do, for example "Commands · Files (read-only) · Web". - **Status line**: plugins on, open sessions, changes made, and whether the prompt is live. - **Buttons**: **New session with it** opens a new session in this mode. The **⋯** menu holds the other actions: Make default, Duplicate, View configuration (YAML), Edit details, Restore built-in, and Delete. - **Notices**: when something needs your attention, the card shows one notice with a button to fix it, for example "The built-in mode was updated", "plugins cannot load", or "an unsaved prompt draft". Click a card to open it. It has three tabs: **Capabilities**, **Prompt**, and **All plugins**. ### Capabilities | Group | Capabilities | |---|---| | What it can do | Run commands, Files (with a separate **Allow file changes** switch), Web, Subagents and workflows, Extend itself (plugin management, plugin market, plugin API lookup) | | How it works | Plan mode, To-do list, Session goals, Skills, Ask you, Deliverables, Reminders | | Context | Workspace instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and similar), Time awareness, Context compaction | - **Turning a capability on** restores it as the built-in mode has it. Plugins that switch by environment (such as Bash and PowerShell) go back to **Auto**, and plugins the built-in mode keeps off (such as the Codex subagent) stay off. - **Turning a capability off** switches off every plugin it includes. - A capability with only some of its plugins on is marked **Partly on**. - Capabilities the mode has no plugins for are hidden; for example, dsh before 0.2.1 has no Reminders. ### Prompt - **System prompt**: edit this mode's system prompt. Insert variables such as `{{model}}` with a click, and the editor checks them as you type. **Preview full system prompt** shows everything the model receives. - **Advanced settings**: a closing prompt (added after tool guidance and workspace rules), "use only the opening text as the complete prompt", and "include runtime context". - **Save**: click **Save** or press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter. Everything above takes effect only after you save. - **History**: every save records a version (up to 30), labeled by where it was made: Settings, in chat, or elsewhere. You can load any version back into the editor. - **Import and export**: `.md` files. - **Restore built-in prompt**: asks before it replaces your prompt. - **Nothing gets lost**: unsaved edits stay in the browser as a draft, even after a page refresh. If the prompt changes elsewhere while you edit, saving is refused and you choose between loading the latest version and overwriting it with yours. The **In chat** section has two switches that **save as soon as you click them**. They apply to sessions created afterwards: - **Live prompt**: after you save the prompt, running sessions use it from their next step. - **Allow prompt changes in chat**: you can tell the model "change your prompt to …". The model reads or changes this mode's prompt with the `mode_prompt` tool, and **asks for your approval before every save**. ### All plugins Lists every plugin in the mode, for when you need to adjust them one by one: - Search within the tab, or show only changed plugins. - Plugins that switch by environment offer **Auto / On / Off**. - Each changed plugin can be reset on its own with **Restore**. - **Details** shows the row id, module, and full configuration. ### New modes | Start from | What it can do | Good for | |---|---|---| | Develop | Same as the Standard mode | Everyday coding | | Write | Read and write files, workspace instructions, to-do list, deliverables, skills, context compaction, asking you, time; **no terminal** | Documents and drafts | | Chat | Web, context compaction, asking you, time; **no files or terminal** | Questions and conversation | | Read-only research | Read and search files, web, workspace instructions, to-do list, skills, context compaction, asking you, time; **cannot change files or run commands** | Reading code and research | | Copy a mode | Same as the mode you copy | Small changes to an existing mode | Each template comes with a starter prompt in Chinese or English, following the interface language. The name and ID are filled in for you, and you can change both. ### Keeping up with dsh upgrades - **Sync built-in update**: after a dsh upgrade, built-in modes you changed, and custom modes based on a built-in mode, show "The built-in mode was updated". Before you sync, the card lists the plugins that were added, removed, or changed upstream. When you confirm: - plugins you never touched follow the built-in version; - settings you changed keep your value; - plugins added upstream join template-based modes switched off. - **One-click repair**: when a plugin in a mode fails to load, the whole mode stops working. The card lists the failing plugins with their reasons; **Turn these plugins off** switches off only those, and the mode works again. - **Before you delete**: deleting a custom mode first tells you how many open and saved sessions use it. Those sessions cannot be opened after the mode is deleted. ## When changes take effect - Every change applies to **sessions created afterwards**; running sessions keep what they started with. The one exception is a mode with **Live prompt** on: its saved prompt text reaches running sessions from their next step. - Changes are written to the current dsh profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, so other windows using the same profile see them too. plugins.description: DSH 插件：向模型暴露 Komari 探针面板工具（列机器、远程执行、上传下载文件），设置页配置面板地址与账号 | DSH plugin exposing Komari monitoring-panel tools (list nodes, remote exec, file transfer) with a settings-page config card
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-komari DSH 插件（bundle 形式）：把 [Komari](https://github.com/komari-monitor/komari) 探针面板的能力暴露给模型——**列机器**（节点清单 + 实时状态）、**控制机器**（远程执行命令）与**传输文件**（本机 ↔ 目标机），并在 WebUI 设置页配置面板地址与账号。四个工具经 [dsh-plugin-toolsets](https://github.com/huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-toolsets) 注册为一个**按需加载的工具集**。 DSH plugin (bundle): exposes a Komari monitoring panel to the model — list machines with live status, run shell commands on them, and move files between this machine and them — configured from the WebUI settings page. Tools ship as one lazily-loaded toolset through dsh-plugin-toolsets. ## 工具集（按需加载） 四个工具注册为名为 `komari` 的 toolset：平常只占一行目录（名称 + 「什么时候该用」摘要 + 工具数），模型判断需要时调用全局 `get_tools({"toolset":"komari"})` 把整组工具加载进当前 agent，**下一轮**起可用。 - 依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`（peer，需已安装，否则本插件的 `inject: ['toolsets']` 不满足、不会加载）。 - 目录行内容即 [src/tools.ts](src/tools.ts) 里的 `TOOLSET_DESCRIPTION`。 - 子 agent 不继承：子 agent 需自行调用 `get_tools`。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |------|------| | `komari_list_nodes` | 列出面板上的机器及其实时状态（在线、CPU%、负载、内存/磁盘/Swap、网络总量、运行时长、连接数、温度、系统、备注）。参数：`group`（分组精确过滤）、`include_offline`（默认 true）。 | | `komari_exec` | 在一台或多台机器上执行 shell 命令，返回每台的输出与 exit code。参数：`command`、`nodes`（uuid / 精确名称 / 唯一名称子串）、`wait_seconds`（默认 30，最大 300）。 | | `komari_upload_file` | 把**本机**（运行 dsh 的机器）的文件传到一台或多台机器。参数：`local_path`、`remote_path`、`nodes`。走面板分片上传协议，单文件上限 8 GiB。 | | `komari_download_file` | 把某台机器上的文件取回**本机**（流式写盘）。参数：`remote_path`、`node`、`local_path`（缺省写系统临时目录下的 `komari-downloads/`）。目录不可下载。 | `komari_upload_file` 会**覆盖目标路径上已存在的文件**，同样需要先确认。 `komari_exec` 是**危险工具**：命令经面板 agent 在目标机上以其自身权限执行（多数 Linux 节点即 root，Windows 节点为 agent 服务账户，走 PowerShell）。工具描述已要求模型在执行重启/删除/改配置/批量命令前先说明计划并取得用户明确同意；面板侧也会记录 `REC, task id: ...` 审计日志。 ## 设置页配置 「设置 → 插件」中找到 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari` 这一行，展开其配置卡： | 字段 | 说明 | |------|------| | 面板地址 | 如 `https://status.example.com`；粘贴 `/api` 或 `/api/v1` 后缀会被自动去掉，无协议时默认补 `https://`。 | | 用户名 / 密码 | 面板账号，**必须是管理员**（远程执行是 admin 权限）。开启 2FA 的账号无法用于本插件（登录接口需要动态 TOTP 码）。 | | 请求超时 (ms) | 单次面板 HTTP 请求超时，默认 15000。 | 改完点「保存」即时生效（工具每次调用都读取最新配置，无需重启）；点「测试连接」会用当前已保存的配置做一次登录 + 拉取节点，验证地址与账号是否可用。 凭据以明文写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该 entry 的 `config` 下——请自行确认该文件的权限。 ## 文件传输备注 - 上传走面板的四步协议：`operation=init`（拿 `upload_id`/分片大小）→ 逐个 `operation=chunk`（原始字节，`Content-Length` 必须等于该分片期望长度）→ `operation=merge`（提交）；任一步失败会自动 `operation=cancel` 清掉半成品。 - 面板限制：单文件 ≤ 8 GiB，分片 1 MiB–128 MiB（默认 25 MiB），上传会话 15 分钟过期，最多 4 个并发上传（因此多机上传是串行执行的）。 - 下载是 `GET .../file/download?path=<绝对路径>` 的二进制流，插件边收边写盘；总时长受「传输超时」约束。 - 路径风格随目标机：Linux 用 `/tmp/...`，Windows agent 用 `C:\Windows\Temp\...`（面板会把它规范化成 `/C/Windows/Temp`）。 ## 数据可见性与安全 - 插件以面板**管理员会话**访问 `/api/admin/*`。`GET /api/admin/client/list` 的原始响应里含每台机器的 **Agent Token**，插件在进入模型之前用显式白名单投影（`pickNode`/`pickLive`），只保留状态字段；单元测试 `tests/komari.spec.ts` 钉死了这一行为。 - 会话 Cookie 只保存在宿主进程内存中；遇到 401/403 会清掉旧会话、重新登录并重试一次。 - 密码不写入日志、不回显在工具结果里。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run build # tsdown: lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser half, __ModuleLoader__ 包裹) ``` 结构： | 路径 | 职责 | |------|------| | `src/index.ts` | 入口：`name` / `inject` / `Config`（全部字段 `.volatile()`）/ `apply` | | `src/komari.ts` | `KomariClient`：登录、Cookie 会话、`/api/rpc2`、`/api/admin/*`、字段白名单投影 | | `src/tools.ts` | 四个 `defineTool` 定义、`buildKomariToolset()` 与 `registerTools()`（注册到 `ctx.toolsets`） | | `src/transfer.ts` | 本地文件 IO：分片读取上传、流式写盘下载、默认落地路径 | | `src/summary.ts` | 纯函数：节点摘要、引用解析、文本渲染（无 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，便于单测） | | `src/rpc.ts` | 宿主 RPC：`komari.probe`（设置卡「测试连接」） | | `src/client/*` | 浏览器半：`plugins.row.config` 配置卡（row key `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari#dsh-komari`） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 配置层：insert 一行 `dsh-komari`，`config` 是首次启动的种子值 | 约束：`lib/` 预构建入库（含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* ` peer，git 安装时无 `prepare`）；不改 DSH 源码。 ## 运行 ```sh # 本地开发（改源码后重新 pnpm run build 即可生效，无需重装） dsh plugin --profile web add "link:D:/Projects/deepseek-harness/dsh-plugin-komari" # 从远端安装 dsh plugin --profile web add "github:huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-komari" ``` 装好后**重启 `dsh web` 进程**，浏览器硬刷新（`Ctrl+Shift+R`），再到「设置 → 插件」填上面四个字段。 ## 检查 ```sh pnpm run typecheck # tsc --noEmit pnpm test # 40 个单测（mock fetch；含 token 不泄漏回归、分片协议回归、toolset 契约） pnpm vitest run tests/e2e.komari.spec.ts # 真实面板 e2e（未设置环境变量时自跳过） ``` 真实面板 e2e 需要： ```powershell $env:KOMARI_E2E_ENDPOINT='https://status.example.com' $env:KOMARI_E2E_USERNAME='admin' $env:KOMARI_E2E_PASSWORD='...' ``` 它覆盖四条链路：登录 + 列机器、读实时状态、在**一台在线机器**上执行 `echo dsh-komari-e2e`、以及**文件往返**（上传一个小文本文件到在线机器的临时目录 → stat 校验 → 下载回来比对内容 → 删除远端文件）。只跑无害命令与临时文件。 ## 已知限制 - 面板账号开启 2FA 时无法使用：登录与 `admin:exec` 都需要动态 TOTP 码。需要这种场景时应改用面板 API Key 认证（当前未实现）。 - 只覆盖「看机器 + 控制机器 + 传文件」：节点增删改、Ping 任务管理等面板管理写入接口未暴露。 - 强依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`：未安装时本插件因 `inject` 不满足而整体不加载（工具不可见）。

plugins.description: ChatGPT-style notification overlay on the DSH taskbar button: unread completion count + attention dots (question / permission)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-badge-notify

DSH 任务栏徽标：在 **Windows 任务栏的 DSH 图标周围**（贴着图标轮廓，不是任务栏外围）
叠画一个鼠标穿透的浮层。

- **数字徽标**：ChatGPT 风格——黑底圆角方块 + 白色数字＝**未读**的已完成会话数。
  徽标**坐在图标右上角上方**（中心抬升 `badge.lift`×徽标边长，默认 0.5＝徽标底边正贴着图标顶边），
  所以不再遮住图标本身。
  - 「未读」与 DSH 侧边栏的小绿点**同义**：会话跑完时你正在看它就不计数；跑完后你打开它即视为已读，计数自动减掉
  - 想改回「所有完成都计数」：`badge.unreadOnly: false`
- **提示点**：中心落在图标左边缘线上，自上而下排列。**每种提示只有一个点**（`dots.group: "kind"`）
  - 黑点 = 有提问待回答（`user-questions/request`）——需要人工介入
  - 黄点 = 有权限申请待批准（`approval/request`）
  - 第一个点与徽标**同一水平线**（左上角位置），第二个点落在左边中点；同类的多个待处理仍只有一个点
  - 想回到“每个待处理项一个点”，把 `dots.group` 改成 `"item"`

## 截图

DSH 任务栏图标上的实际效果（左边黑点=待回答，左下黄点=待批准，右上角标=未读完成数）：

![DSH 任务栏图标](screenshots/icon.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-badge-notify
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 源码安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dthcle/dsh-badge-notify
```

装完**不用重启 DSH**：宿主半端会自动把浮层载荷部署到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\`
并拉起浮层，几秒内就能在任务栏的 DSH 图标上看到徽标。
在 **设置 → 插件 → 任务徽标** 里可以看状态、启停、清零。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-badge-notify
```

### 运行要求

- **平台**：Windows 10 / 11（靠 UI Automation 定位任务栏按钮 + 分层窗口叠画，Windows 专有）
- **DSH**：桌面版（`desktop` profile）。浮层需要一个能显示任务栏的桌面会话
- **无需管理员权限**：不注入进程、不读跨进程内存，只用 UIA 读取按钮坐标
- **不联网**：没有外部服务，全部本地运行
- **资源占用**：约 0.7% 单核 CPU、~145 MB 内存（其中 ~91 MB 是 PowerShell + WinForms 的运行时地板）

> 浮层找的是**桌面版 DSH** 那个任务栏按钮（`Appid: com.deepseek.dsh`），所以装到这个 App
> 正在用的 profile 里才有效——默认是 `desktop`。如果你启动时用的是别的 profile 名，
> 把命令里的 `--profile desktop` 换成你的那个即可。

## 形态

- **Host 半端**（`lib/index.js`，跑在 DSH 进程里）：订阅 `agent/status`（running→idle 记一次
  完成）、`user-questions/request`、`approval/request`（waterfall 观察者，用 `prepend` 抢在
  应答方之前，否则请求被应答方 claim 后就看不到了）。状态写入 `state.json`，并注册
  `/api/dsh-badge-notify/*` 三条 loopback 路由与系统提示词说明。
- **浮层半端**（`assets/BadgeNotify.ps1`，独立进程）：用 **UI Automation** 定位 DSH 的任务栏按钮
  （`Appid: com.deepseek.dsh`，不需要提权、不碰跨进程内存），再从按钮自身像素里量出
  **图标本体** 的位置，最后用 `UpdateLayeredWindow` 画带 alpha 的黑底白字徽标与提示点。
- **鼠标穿透**（默认）：`WS_EX_TRANSPARENT`，不挡任务栏图标的点击。窗口不进 Alt+Tab、不抢焦点。
- **脱离宿主**：宿主 spawn 时 `windowsHide`（CREATE_NO_WINDOW），DSH 重启不影响已在跑的浮层。

## 图标定位（为什么要量像素）

任务栏按钮（UIA 给的 66×72）比图标本体大得多，直接把徽标贴在按钮角落就会落在**图标外围**
——所以浮层会截取按钮一帧，取众数色当背景，对差异像素做**连通分量**分析，取最靠近中心的那一块
（真图标），得到**字形外接框**。这条路上有两类噪声被自动排除：相邻按钮的边缘带、
运行中应用的下划线指示条。量不出来时回退到“按钮中心按 `iconScale` 取方形”的几何估算。

锚点用的是这个外接框（`anchor.iconPad` 放大系数，默认 `1.0`＝正好是字形轮廓）：

- 徽标中心 = 外接框**右上角**再向上抬 `badge.lift`×徽标边长（默认 0.5）
- 提示点中心 = 外接框**左边缘**；第一个点默认与徽标中心同高（`dots.start: badge`），
  之后按 `点径 + dots.gap` 依次向下，直到图标底边（点太多时自动压缩间距并缩小点径）

因为标记在轮廓上/轮廓外，浮层画布比图标外接框四周大 `pad` 像素（= 抬升量/半标记 + 描边 + 2），
窗口也相应外扩。27×20 的鲸鱼图标上实测：`pad=20`，画布 67×60，徽标 16px、提示点 15px。

**量像素时必须先把浮层藏起来**：否则自己画的徽标会被当成“图标墨迹”，连通分量一轮比一轮大
（实测 30→32→35→38px 每 30 秒膨胀一次），徽标和提示点会慢慢爬离图标。

## 配置

`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\config.json`（用户文件：缺失才写；架构版本 `configVersion` 变化时
刷新，旧文件备份为 `config.json.bak`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor.target` | `icon` | `icon`＝贴图标本体；`button`＝贴整个按钮矩形 |
| `anchor.referencePx` | `27` | 调参时用的图标基准边：所有**绝对像素**键都按 `基准边/referencePx` 缩放，换机器等比 |
| `anchor.iconScale` | `0.5` | 量不出图标时的方形边长比例（相对按钮短边） |
| `anchor.iconPad` | `1.0` | 字形外接框放大系数：`1.0`＝锚点正好在字形轮廓上 |
| `anchor.calibrate` | `true` | 关掉就只用几何估算 |
| `anchor.offsetX/Y` | `0` | 浮层整体位移 |
| `anchor.iconOffsetX/Y` | `0` | 图标框位移（微调到“正贴在图标上”） |
| `badge.unreadOnly` | `true` | `true`＝只统计**未读**的完成（与绿点同义）；`false`＝所有完成都计数 |
| `attention.minVisibleMs` | `1500` | 提示标记的最短可见时间：请求若在几毫秒内就被答复，标记仍会保留这么久，否则浮层根本来不及画 |
| `badge.sizeRatio` | `0.73` | 徽标边长 ÷ 图标边长（`badge.size>0` 时改用绝对像素） |
| `badge.lift` | `0.5` | 徽标中心相对图标右上角抬高多少（×徽标边长）：`0.5`＝徽标底边贴着图标顶边，`0`＝中心落在角上 |
| `badge.insetX/Y` | `0` / `3` | 徽标中心再往左/往下微调多少像素 |
| `badge.fontSizeRatio` | `0.8` | 数字字号 ÷ 徽标边长（`badge.fontSize>0` 时改用绝对像素）；数字按**真实墨迹**居中，`textOffsetX/Y` 可再光学微调 |
| `dots.sizeRatio` | `0.56` | 提示点直径 ÷ 图标边长（`dots.size>0` 时改用绝对像素） |
| `dots.gap` | `3` | 提示点之间的缝；`fit` 模式下点太多会自动压缩，保证不越过图标底边 |
| `dots.start` | `badge` | `badge`＝第一个点与徽标同一水平线；`corner`＝第一个点落在图标左上角 |
| `dots.mode` | `fit` | `fit`＝压缩点径塞进图标高度；`fixed`＝保持点径+缝，允许向图标下方溢出 |
| `dots.group` | `kind` | `kind`＝每种提示一个点（黑点/黄点各最多一个）；`item`＝每个待处理项一个点 |
| `dots.insetX` | `-3` | 提示点**中心**相对图标左边缘的横移量 |
| `dots.insetY` | `2` | 第一个点再往下多少像素 |
| `dots.max` | `2` | 最多画几个点 |
| `dots.order` | `kind` | `kind`＝先黑点后黄点；`time`＝按发生时间 |
| `clickThrough` | `true` | 鼠标穿透 |
| `pollMs` | `500` | 状态轮询间隔 |
| `buttonRefreshMs` | `4000` | 按钮矩形重读间隔（UIA 跨进程调用，别设太小：会吃 CPU） |
| `buttonSearchMs` | `120000` | 健康元素的后台重发现间隔（防 explorer 重启后句柄失效） |
| `buttonRetryMs` | `4000` | 查找失败后的重试间隔（否则一次 UIA 抖动会白屏一整个慢周期） |

改完约 2 秒内自动生效（浮层持续盯着 `config.json` 的修改时间，变了就重读、重新校准图标框并重画）。

尺寸的自适应基准是“图标方形边长”＝`max(字形宽,字形高) × iconPad`；在 27×20 的 DSH 鲸鱼图标上
即 27px。所有尺寸都是它的比例，剩下的绝对像素键再按 `基准边 / anchor.referencePx` 缩放
（本机 `referencePx = 27`，即 1:1），所以换台电脑、换 DPI、换任务栏缩放都只会等比变化。

## 手动调参（不想改配置文件时）

往数据目录写一份 `preview.json`，浮层就固定画这些标记、忽略真实事件，方便对着任务栏调
`config.json`（改完约 2 秒生效）：

```json
{ "enabled": true, "count": 8, "dots": ["question", "approval"] }
```

删掉该文件（或 `"enabled": false`）立刻回到实时状态。模板见 `assets/preview.example.json`。

## 管理 API（仅 loopback POST）

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/status` | 运行状态 / pid / 已完成数 / 待处理列表 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/start` | 部署（含载荷升级：内容变了就重启浮层）+ 拉起 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/stop` | 停止浮层（记 `stopped.flag`，DSH 重启不会自动拉回） |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/clear` | 已完成计数清零 |
| `/api/dsh-badge-notify/read` | 客户端半端上报「当前主视图打开的会话集合」`{"sessionIds":[...]}`，这些会话视为已读、不再计数 |

Web GUI：**设置 → 插件 → 任务徽标**（状态点、启停、清零、待处理列表，5s 轮询）。

### 未读语义从哪来

DSH 侧边栏的绿点由客户端 `completionUnread` 决定（`dsh-client-ui-session`），它只在
`retainedBy.mainView > 0`（该会话正开在主视图）时消除。这个保留计数**只存在于浏览器侧**，
宿主完全不知情，所以插件用一个客户端半端把这份状态镜像给宿主：

- 订阅 `ctx.get('sessions')` 的列表快照 + 每个会话的 `retainInfo(id)`；
- `retainedBy.mainView > 0` 的会话即「已读」，整集 POST 到 `/read`；
- 宿主据此维护两件事：正在看的会话完成时不计入、已读的会话从计数里退掉。

不猜测点击、不使用计时器，规则与 DSH 绿点完全一致。

## 诊断

- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\logs\host.log`：宿主半端各阶段（apply 各步、boot 结果、
  事件命中）。这里能看到 `apply: xxx FAILED`——宿主里的异常否则只会表现为“插件没反应”。
- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DshBadgeNotify\logs\badge-notify.log`：浮层半端。每次画面变化记一行：
  ```
  draw box 2039,2110 27x27 source=measured ink=316 glyph=27x20@32,36 bg=235,239,249
  anchor ink 2040,2115 27x20
  frame count=2 dots=1 canvas=51x44@2028,2103 pad=12 badge=16 dot=9 icon=27x20
  ```
  `draw box` 是按钮内图标框，`anchor ink` 是真正用来定位的**字形外接框**，
  `canvas` 是分层窗口的位置与大小。查“徽标跑到哪去了”看这三行最快。
  若出现 `slow tick: previous poll took ...ms (UIA may be blocking)`，说明某次 UIA 调用卡了很久
  （树劣化时会发生）；若出现 `UIA: no DSH button among N taskbar buttons: ...`，会一并列出
  任务栏上真实存在的按钮，便于核对 `buttonMatch`。
- 手动体检（会打印测到的图标框与外接框，然后退出，不进消息循环）：
  ```powershell
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\DshBadgeNotify\BadgeNotify.ps1" -Calibrate
  ```
  输出形如 `MEASURED icon: 2039,2110 27x27 ... buttonOffset=+19,+22` +
  `ANCHOR ink  : 2040,2115 27x20`。

## 已知坑（实现记录）

- **`-shl` 会按左操作数类型截断**：`[byte]235 -shl 16` 在 PowerShell 里回绕成 0，颜色打包必须用
  乘法（`[int]$c.R * 65536`）。
- **UIA 要非沙箱进程**：在受限 token 下 `OpenProcess` 拿 explorer 会被拒、UIA 只看得到几十个元素，
  任务栏按钮根本不出现。由 DSH 宿主 spawn 的进程不受此限。
- **任务栏按钮会移动**：窗口增减都会改变它，所以按钮位置要周期性重定位，不能缓存太久。
  但 UIA 的跨进程属性读取不便宜（每 2.5s 一次实测 ~6% 单核），现在按 `buttonRefreshMs`
  读矩形、`buttonSearchMs` 才做一次任务栏内 `FindAll`，空闲占用约 0.4%。
- **UIA 树会劣化，且桌面级搜索会被坏元素永久阻塞**：实测一次 explorer 树劣化后，
  从桌面根节点搜任务栏按钮返回 190 个重复项（正常 3 个），其中某个元素属性读取直接卡死，
  把整个轮询线程钉住（CPU 33%、无日志、无重绘）。现在只在 `Shell_TrayWnd` 内搜索
  （9ms vs ~3000ms）、候选先校验再采用、坏元素跳过，并有 `slow tick` 看门狗兜底。
- **UIA 会瞬时抽风**：按钮矩形读取失败、或一次 `FindAll` 找不到按钮都可能发生。此时
  **保留上一次的矩形继续画**，下一轮立刻重试（`buttonRetryMs`），而不是当场隐藏。
- **状态文件的 mtime 不能单独当变更依据**：`state.json` 用 (mtime, 长度) 双重判断，
  另外每 2.5s 无条件重解析一次，避免“时间戳同刻改写”被漏掉。
- **`Add-Type` 编译的 C# 里不要用 `Bitmap.GetHbitmap`** 给 `UpdateLayeredWindow`：它不做
  预乘 alpha，圆角会出现亮边；本插件自己 `CreateDIBSection` 后逐像素预乘。

plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feishu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Deep **Feishu / Lark** integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It gives the agent eight tools that act on a real Feishu tenant (and a browser
panel that shows what it did and fixes authorization in one click):

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `feishu_bitable` | Create **Bitable (多维表格)** apps with their tables and fields in one call; list tables and fields; insert, search, update, and delete records in batches |
| `feishu_dashboard` | Create dashboards and **chart blocks** inside a Bitable (柱状图 / 折线图 / 饼图 / 排行榜 / 指标卡 / NPS … 15 types), position them, and read a chart's computed numbers |
| `feishu_query` | Run a **grouped, aggregated query** over a table (group by, sum / avg / min / max / count / distinct_count, filter, sort, top-N) with the aggregation done server-side |
| `feishu_doc` | Create documents; append Markdown (converted to native blocks), append raw blocks, read plain text, or import a local Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF file as a new cloud document |
| `feishu_sheet` | Create spreadsheets; add sheets; read, write, and append ranges |
| `feishu_drive` | Browse folders, create folders, upload and download files, move, delete, read metadata |
| `feishu_wiki` | List wiki spaces and nodes, resolve a wiki token to its document, create and move nodes |
| `feishu_message` | Send text, interactive cards, rich posts, files, and images; reply in a thread; post through a custom-bot webhook |
| `feishu_auth` | Diagnose authorization, produce the authorization URL, complete a manual code exchange, refresh, and log out |
| `feishu_api` | Call any documented Feishu open-platform path, with the same auth, retry, and error mapping |

New content lands in **the user's own cloud drive** because the tools act as the
authorized user, not as the app. When no user grant is stored they fall back to
the app identity and say so in a warning rather than silently filing documents
into a space the user cannot see.

---

## Quick start

### 1. Create a Feishu app

1. Open the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or
   [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) and create a **custom app**.
2. Under **凭证与基础信息**, note the **App ID** and **App Secret**.
3. Under **安全设置 → 重定向 URL**, add the callback this plugin serves:

   ```
   http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/feishu/oauth/callback
   ```

   The port is whatever DeepSeek Harness serves on (the plugin reads it from the
   host and reports the exact URI in `feishu_auth` action `status`).
4. Under **权限管理**, add the scopes below, then **publish a version** — scopes
   only apply after the version is released:

   | Scope | Needed for |
   |---|---|
   | `offline_access` | **Required** — without it Feishu returns no refresh token and the user must re-authorize every couple of hours |
   | `bitable:app` | Bitable |
   | `docx:document` | Documents |
   | `drive:drive` | Drive, imports, uploads |
   | `sheets:spreadsheet` | Spreadsheets |
   | `wiki:wiki` | Wiki |
   | `im:message`, `im:resource` | Messages and file/image sending |
   | `contact:user.base:readonly` | Reading the authorized user's name |

### 2. Enable the plugin

See [Install](#install) below, then restart DeepSeek Harness.

### 3. Configure it in the GUI

Open **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu**. Everything is editable there — no YAML by hand:

- **应用凭据** — the App ID, the App Secret (write-only), the credential
  reference name, and the brand (飞书 / Lark).
- **默认落点与身份** — the folder new content lands in, and which identity the
  tools use by default.
- **功能开关** — whether the tools register, whether the HTTP routes mount,
  whether the floating panel shows, and the tool-name prefix.
- **授权** — the scopes to request and the redirect URL to register.
- **高级** — endpoint overrides and the page-size caps.

**Saving writes only this plugin's entry** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`,
which the harness hot-reloads, so most changes apply without a restart. The App
Secret is *never* written to that file: it goes straight into the credential
store under the reference name, and the page only ever shows whether it is set.

### 4. Authorize

Press **授权飞书** on the settings page, or ask the agent to run `feishu_auth`
with action `authorize_url`. The browser lands on the callback, the grant is
stored, and every later call acts as that user. The same form shows the redirect
URL to register on the Feishu app and lists the scopes to grant.

> Host without a reachable browser callback (a remote or headless session)? Open
> the URL anywhere, then pass the `code` query parameter to `feishu_auth` with
> action `complete`.

---

## Install

Two ways, and they are alternatives — **do not do both.** Each creates a loader
entry with id `feishu`, and the loader rejects a composition that defines one id
twice with `duplicate loader entry id`.

### As a bundle (recommended)

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so a bundle-aware CLI installs and
mounts it in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:2048lr/dsh-feishu
```

That appends `dsh-feishu` to `dsh.profile.bundles` and profile boot merges
[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. Nothing else
needs editing.

The settings page is aware of this: when the profile mounts the bundle, it writes
an **id-targeted config override** rather than a second `insert`, so saving from
the GUI never breaks the composition.

### By hand (no CLI)

The plugin must be resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`, so it is copied
there:

```powershell
# from the repository root
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1
```

The script copies the package into the profile's `node_modules` and inserts the
entry into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu
      name: dsh-feishu
      config:
        appId: cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx
        # appSecretRef: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        # brand: feishu          # or lark
        # defaultFolderToken: fldcnxxxxxxxx
```

**Restart DeepSeek Harness.** The host half is a Node module cached in-process,
so a reload alone does not pick it up. The browser half reloads with the page.

After that first restart, use **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu** instead of editing the YAML:
the page rewrites the block the installer added and the harness hot-reloads it.

### Why the package avoids `@deepseek-ai/*` imports

A third-party plugin is loaded from a junction or a copied directory inside the
profile, where a bare `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` specifier resolves to whichever
DSH installation is reachable — which may not be the running host. The host half
therefore imports **only Node builtins** and hand-writes its tool definitions
and its configuration validation. The test suite checks every generated schema
against the real SDK validator, so the hand-written form cannot drift from what
the registry accepts.

---

## Configuration

All fields are optional except `appId`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `appId` | — | The Feishu app id. Required. |
| `appSecretRef` | `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | Credential reference resolved through the harness credential store, then the environment. |
| `appSecret` | `''` | Literal fallback. Discouraged: it puts a secret in configuration. |
| `brand` | `feishu` | `feishu` (open.feishu.cn) or `lark` (open.larksuite.com). |
| `apiBaseUrl` / `accountsBaseUrl` | per brand | Override the endpoints (for a proxy or a private gateway). |
| `defaultFolderToken` | `''` | Where new documents, sheets, Bitable apps, and uploads go when a call omits a folder. |
| `defaultIdentity` | `auto` | `auto`, `user`, or `app`. `auto` uses the user when authorized and otherwise the app, reporting the fallback. |
| `toolPrefix` | `feishu_` | Rename the tools (for example `fs_`). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout. |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | Total attempts for rate-limited or transient failures (capped at 6). |
| `enableTools` | `true` | Register the model-facing tools. |
| `enableOAuth` | `true` | Mount the `/api/feishu/*` routes (status, activity, config, OAuth). |
| `enableUi` | `true` | Show the floating panel. |
| `oauthRedirectUri` | auto | Override the callback. Empty means "use

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-babel **让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![test](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2563eb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 ## 它解决什么问题 插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录： ``` .claude-plugin .codex-plugin .cursor .gemini-extension.json ... ``` DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。 同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。 ## 功能 - **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。 - **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。 - **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。 - **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。 - **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。 - **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。 - **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。 - **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel # 或本地目录 plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel ``` 也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。 安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。 ## 配置 配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里： | 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 | | `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` | | `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 | | `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） | | `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） | 开启真注册： ```yaml config: dryRun: false registerCommands: true registerMcp: true ``` ## 兼容矩阵（诚实版） | 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 | | MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 | | MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 | | MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 | | 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） | | 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 | | Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler | | 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 | | 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 | ## 报告长什么样 在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印： ``` === dsh-babel 兼容性报告 === 文件: 28 服务器: 28 方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14} 传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11} 结论: 可用 14 / 需密钥 5 / 不可用 9 ✗ 不可用 (9): laravel-boost [stdio] BLOCKED - [command] command not on PATH: php terraform [stdio] BLOCKED - [daemon] docker installed but not running (no socket / probe failed) - [secret] missing credential: TFE_TOKEN codex_app [stdio] BLOCKED - [env] depends on CODEX_MCP_NODE_PATH (other-harness runtime), not available in DSH ``` 这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。 ## 目录结构 ``` index.js 插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式） cordis.patch.yml bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行） locale/zh.json 卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介） locale/en.json same, in English icon.svg 插件图标 lib/normalize.mjs 内核：方言 → IR lib/discover.mjs 发现：遍历文件系统找声明 lib/preflight.mjs 预检：命令 / daemon / 密钥 / 版本 lib/secrets.mjs 密钥解析：env 为主 + 钥匙串白名单兜底 lib/commands.mjs 命令归一化：.md / .toml → 命令 IR lib/register.mjs 命令注册：ctx.commands.register + 参数替换 lib/register-mcp.mjs MCP 注册：连接 + createMcpToolDefinition + 工具注册 lib/report.mjs 报告：聚合 + 文本渲染 bin/dsh-babel.mjs CLI runner（本地测试用） test/ 单测 + 冒烟 docs/ 详细文档 CHANGELOG.md 版本变更记录 ``` ## 开发与测试 ```bash npm test # 全部单测（75 断言） node test/mcp-smoke.mjs # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器） node bin/dsh-babel.mjs # 直接跑一次报告 ``` ## 文档 - [功能详解](docs/FEATURES.md) - [配置参考](docs/CONFIG.md) - [兼容性说明](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) - [架构与中间表示](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [版本变更](CHANGELOG.md) ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Claude Code visual theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI ??warm paper palette, terracotta accent, Claude Code transcript markers and mono-forward typography.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; /* Roomier or tighter surfaces. */ --cct-composer-radius: 24px; --cct-control-radius: 6px; --cct-editor-inset: 20px; } ``` | Knob | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `--cct-sans` | system UI stack | UI face, including the sidebar and composer | | `--cct-prose` | `var(--cct-sans)` | Face used for assistant prose only | | `--cct-mono` | DSH's code stack | Code, tool output and paths | | `--cct-control-radius` | `8px` | Buttons, rows, chips, code blocks | | `--cct-composer-radius` | `18px` | The composer surface | | `--cct-editor-inset` | `16px` | Composer text inset from its edge | | `--cct-focus` | brand primary | Focus ring colour | To retune colours instead, stack your own layer on top — later layers win per token: ```js ctx.theme.overrideTokens('my-tweaks', { '--dsw-alias-brand-primary': { light: '#c96442', dark: '#d97757' }, }) ``` ## How it works The plugin is a browser half plus an inert host row. The browser half (`lib/client.js`) does exactly two things, both inside one Cordis effect, so unloading or HMR removes the theme completely: 1. Calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-claude-code-theme', …)` with 174 tokens as `{ light, dark }` pairs. This is DSH's documented third-party theme extension point. plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

# dsh-auto-maximize
DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮）

适用于 DSH desktop profile，以及所有基于 Electron / 系统窗口运行 DSH 的场景。

**仓库**：Gitee（主）<https://gitee.com/FideFei/dsh-auto-maximize> ｜ GitHub（镜像）<https://github.com/FideFeiPlane/dsh-auto-maximize>

## 原理与平台支持

插件是 host-only 插件，随桌面版 host 进程在应用启动时加载。host 进程是 Node 子进程
（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，由 Electron 主进程拉起），拿不到 `BrowserWindow`，
因此按平台调用系统级「最大化」能力，全部**尽力而为、失败只记日志、绝不 crash host**：

| 平台 | 策略 | 依赖 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows | Win32 `ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` | **pwsh 7** → **Windows PowerShell 5.1** 自动回退 | pwsh 7 缺失时自动用 5.1（Windows 自带）；无需额外安装。PowerShell 按 PATH 解析、不写死安装路径；5.1 的 `Add-Type` 内置编译器，脚本两版通用 |
| macOS | 把窗口设为主屏可视区大小（`NSScreen.visibleFrame`，即「向窗口发送最大化指令」）；该调用失败时再点击绿色 `AXZoomButton` 作为补救 | `osascript`（系统自带） | 需要「辅助功能/Accessibility」授权，未授权会给出指引日志；`processName` 可覆盖应用名 |
| Linux | `wmctrl` → `xdotool` 设置 `_NET_WM_STATE_MAXIMIZED` | 通常**未预装**，需自行安装 | 尽力而为；两者都缺则跳过 |

窗口定位（Windows）：优先取 host 进程的父进程 PID（即 Electron 主进程）且可执行文件路径一致，
失败则按可执行文件路径扫描所有带主窗口的进程。macOS/Linux 按窗口标题/进程名匹配
（默认取运行中的可执行文件名，可用 `processName` 覆盖）。

**为什么不能直接调 `BrowserWindow.maximize()`**：host 进程是纯 Node（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，
已实测 `require('electron')` 失败），插件只能拿到系统级窗口句柄——因此「自动最大化」被实现为
「等价于用户点击一次最大化按钮」的系统调用，而非 Electron API 调用。

## 安装

### 方式一：通过插件市场 / npm（推荐，发布后可用）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-auto-maximize
```

### 方式二：本地工程安装（开发调试）

在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```jsonc
// package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-auto-maximize": "file:./plugins/dsh-auto-maximize" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* 追加 */ "dsh-auto-maximize" ] } }
}
```

然后 `pnpm install`，重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖 `auto-maximize` 行即可：

```yaml
- id: auto-maximize
  config:
    enabled: false        # 禁用
    timeoutMs: 30000      # 等待窗口出现的超时（毫秒，默认 20000）
    processName: 'DeepSeek Harness'   # macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程名
```

配置项：

| 配置 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | `false` 时整个插件不做事 |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `20000` | 启动后持续寻找窗口的最长时间（毫秒） |
| `processName` | string | 可执行文件名 | macOS/Linux 定位窗口用的进程/窗口标题名 |
| `logFile` | boolean \| string | `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log` | 诊断日志：`false` 关闭文件日志；字符串指定自定义路径；删除文件即清空 |

## macOS：需要「辅助功能」授权

macOS 出于安全限制，用 `osascript`（System Events）控制其他 App 的窗口必须先获得
**「辅助功能 / Accessibility」**授权。

> ⚠️ **注意事项：指令形式同样需要授权。** 插件把窗口直接设为 `set position/size`（「向窗口发送
> 最大化指令」）还是点击 `AXZoomButton`，**两种方式都走同一套 macOS Accessibility API，都需要
> 辅助功能授权**。原因：插件跑在 host（外部 Node 进程）里，要挪动另一个进程的窗口只能走该 API，
> 系统的闸门拦的是 API 本身、不是进程身份——哪怕 `osascript` 是 DSH 自己的子进程也一样（TCC 会把
> 授权追溯归属到 DSH 应用，所以勾选 DeepSeek Harness 即可覆盖它，但这并不豁免授权）。唯一能免授权的
> 路径是让 DSH 在自身进程内最大化自己的窗口（如启动参数 / host→main 的 IPC 调
> `BrowserWindow.maximize()`），那需要 DSH 本体提供通道，插件作为外部方做不到。**因此请保留授权**。

插件未获授权时会在 host 日志输出指引（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），按以下步骤授权后重启即可：

1. 打开 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能**；
2. 勾选 **DeepSeek Harness**（以及承载/启动它的终端或启动器，如有）；
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness（授权对已运行的进程不生效）。

仍无效时，可用 `processName` 指定实际的进程名——打包后应用显示名可能与可执行文件名不同。

**诊断日志**：从 1.1.2 起，插件每一步都会追加写入 `~/.dsh/auto-maximize.log`
（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\auto-maximize.log`）。排查「没生效」时直接看这个文件，能立刻看到
`osascript` 返回的 `perm:`（缺授权）/ `nowindow:`（没找到窗口）/ `maximized-bounds`（成功）等结果。
不需要日志时用 `logFile: false` 关闭，或直接删除该文件清空。每次启动会把上一次日志轮转为
`auto-maximize.log.old`，只保留本次与最近一次，文件不会无限累积。

> 对比：**Windows 端不需要任何额外权限**——`ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MAXIMIZE)` 是直接 Win32 API
> 调用（非模拟点击），对同一用户的窗口无需提权。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 两处（`dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`）移除
`dsh-auto-maximize`，再执行 `pnpm install`，重启应用。

## 开发

```sh
npm install   # 无第三方运行时依赖；仅 dev 需要（测试用 node:test）
npm test      # 冒烟测试：模块加载 / 禁用分支 / 效果注册
npm pack      # 生成可发布的 tarball（先跑测试）
```

## 发布到 npm

```sh
npm login                                   # 首次
npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
```

发布后即可在 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 插件市场的
「申请收录插件 ↗」入口提交收录（指向 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
的 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`，见 [提交指南](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/contributing.md)）。

## 已知限制

- 仅在桌面版（desktop profile）有意义；web profile 无窗口，插件会安静跳过。
- 只启动时执行一次，不会干预会话中手动调整的窗口状态。
- 多实例/多窗口：Windows 上优先通过「host 的父进程 PID + 可执行路径」精确定位所属实例的
  主窗口，多个 DSH 实例互不干扰；父进程匹配失败时才按可执行路径扫描，此时多开场景可能
  命中另一个实例的窗口。macOS/Linux 取「最前端/首个匹配」窗口，多开时建议用 `processName` 区分。
- 失败只写 host 日志（关键字 `dsh-auto-maximize`），不影响应用运行。

## Roadmap（未实现，欢迎 PR）

- **设置 UI 开关**：把 `enabled` 接进「设置 → 通用设置」。当前为 host-only 插件，只能通过
  `cordis.patch.yml` 配置；做成界面开关需要 client-plugin 侧的设置面板扩展。
- **去掉 PowerShell 依赖**：Windows 端可改用 FFI（koffi 等）直调 `user32.dll`，免起子进程；
  但会引入原生二进制，破坏「零运行时依赖」，故暂未采用（现状：PS 5.1 为 Windows 自带）。
- **正式图标**：`assets/icon.svg` 为占位设计（最大化双框图形），欢迎替换为正式图标。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © FideFei

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.
