plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
plugins.readme_text:
SVG Studio

Image + prompt → pure, layered SVG.
A local-first vectorization studio for DeepSeek Harness.
Built and maintained by xiangwriter.

dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio

简体中文 · Install · Usage · Engine · Development · License

> **Personal, non-commercial use only.** > This repository is source-available, not open-source. Commercial use of any kind > requires a separate written licence from xiangwriter; see [COMMERCIAL.md](COMMERCIAL.md). > The `xiangwriter` name, mark and branding must remain intact. --- SVG Studio turns a character illustration, sticker or flat-colour image into a **real SVG made of paths, gradients and masks** — no embedded bitmap, no external tracing service. It ships as three things in one DeepSeek Harness plugin: - a full **Web Studio** page in the Harness sidebar, - an agent tool, **`svg_studio`**, for file-path workflows, - a reusable agent skill, **`svg-vector-recreation`**. Everything runs locally. Images and prompts go only to the local Harness server and the local Python engine. ## Why it exists Most image-to-SVG tools either return one giant traced path, or quietly embed the source PNG inside an SVG. SVG Studio is built for character art: it keeps the figure, refines the face locally, builds a clean backdrop, and validates that the result is genuinely vector. The original illustration is never included in this repository; the plugin contains code and synthetic test fixtures only. ## Highlights - **Prompt-guided presets.** Write what you want in natural language (“keep the wine-red backdrop, clean up the contour, more detail in the eyes”) and the engine maps those notes to colour counts, face detail and backdrop settings. Explicit overrides always win. - **Layered colour tracing.** Median-cut palette → connected colour regions → closed contours with even-odd holes → optional RDP simplification. A single colour can contain many islands. - **A figure-aware clip.** The engine samples the backdrop, separates it from the figure, handles interior holes and near-white areas, then pre-clips colour paths to the character. Background noise and stray colour blobs are less likely to become paths. - **Local face-detail pass.** A small, soft-masked palette refines eyes, cheeks, mouth and hair details without changing the rest of the image. - **Clean backdrops without invented effects.** The default `gradient` backdrop is a clean gradient derived from the source border. It does **not** add a synthetic halo or dark ring. Choose `original` to keep the source background. - **Outline is opt-in.** The extra dark outer contour is **off by default**. Turn it on in Advanced settings only when you want a sticker-like rim. - **Small, inspectable output.** Paths, gradients, a soft face mask, and no `` or `data:image` payloads. A structural check rejects malformed SVG. - **Bounded work.** Long edges above 1200 px are scaled down; the engine warns when an output gets large. Typical 240 px chibi art completes in under two seconds. - **English and Chinese UI**, with locale files you can extend. ## Install Requires a DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web UI and a Python 3.10+ interpreter with **Pillow** and **numpy**. 1. Install the plugin from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` Or from a local checkout: ```bash dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` 2. Install the Python engine dependencies into the interpreter DSH can see: ```bash python -m pip install -r engine/requirements.txt ``` On Windows, DSH also detects its bundled Python runtime and `DSH_SVG_STUDIO_PYTHON` if set. The Studio page shows **Local engine ready** when Pillow and numpy are available. 3. Refresh the Harness Web UI. The sidebar entry **SVG Studio / SVG 矢量化** opens the Studio. The plugin is a bundle with a Host half (`index.js`), a Web client (`client.js`), a Cordis patch, locale metadata and the Python engine. ## Use it ### In the Web Studio 1. Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, or click to choose one. Images are normalised to a maximum 1200 px long edge and flattened onto white before upload. 2. Optional: write a short direction in **Your ideas and direction**. 3. Pick a preset (or open **Advanced settings**). 4. Press **Generate SVG**. Preview, download, copy the code, or open the SVG in a new tab. ### From an agent Ask in natural language; the skill is selected automatically when the task matches it: ```text Use svg_studio on D:\art\character.png. Preset: faithful. Keep face detail on, outer contour off, clean gradient background. Save the SVG next to the source. ``` Or call the tool directly. Common arguments: | Argument | Values | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `image_path` | local path | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF | | `prompt` | free text | Stored in the SVG description; guides settings | | `preset` | `faithful`, `clean`, `flat`, `original`, `mini` | Defaults to `faithful` | | `colors` | 24–224 | Overrides the preset palette size | | `face_detail` | boolean | Local face pass | | `outline` | boolean | Extra outer rim, off by default | | `background` | `auto`, `gradient`, `original` | Clean gradient, auto, or source backdrop | | `saturation`, `contrast` | numbers | Small colour adjustments | | `output_path` | local path | Optional destination for the `.svg` | ### Presets | Preset | Palette | Face pass | Backdrop | Best for | | --- | ---: | :---: | --- | --- | | `faithful` | 160 | on | clean gradient | closest overall recreation | | `clean` | 112 | on | clean gradient | smaller, flatter, tidier files | | `flat` | 72 | off | clean gradient | poster-like colour masses | | `original` | 140 | on | source backdrop | scenes, photos, or when the backdrop is part of the art | | `mini` | 64 | off | clean gradient | very simple art and tiny files | The outer contour is independent of the preset and is **off by default**. ## Output contract - The SVG contains ``, ``, ``, ``, `` and a `` — no raster image. - The output is XML-validated; ``, `data:image`, and base64 payloads are rejected. - Generated files are stored under `$DSH_HOME/svg-studio/outputs/` and pruned to the newest 40. - The result is a local file; nothing is uploaded to a cloud service. ## Local API The Studio talks to three exact, local-only routes served by the Host plugin: | Method | Route | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/api/health` | Python, Pillow and numpy availability | | `POST` | `/svg-studio/api/generate` | data-URL or file-path generation | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/file?name=.svg` | serve a saved output from the output directory | These routes are registered on the local Harness web server and are not intended to be exposed publicly. ## How the engine works ```text source image │ normalize / flatten ▼ adaptive palette

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

# Opencode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-Plugin-blueviolet?logo=deepseek)](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) [![OpenCode Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-Desktop%20Free%20Models-2ea44f?logo=opencode)](https://opencode.ai) [![GitHub Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Dreftian%2FOpencode--Connect-black?logo=github)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) [![Status: Production Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Production%20Ready-success)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) **Seamlessly connect and dynamically auto-sync all OpenCode Desktop free models into DeepSeek Harness.** [English Documentation](#english) • [Documentación en Español](#español)
--- ## 🇬🇧 English Documentation ### 📌 Overview & The Problem It Solves **DeepSeek Harness** is a high-performance orchestration framework and desktop workspace for advanced AI agents, multi-step reasoning, and software development workflows. However, developers often face friction with paywalled APIs, rate limits, credit-card requirements, or complex authentication setups for secondary models. **OpenCode Desktop** provides an extensive, curated suite of free LLM models optimized for coding, reasoning, long-context analysis, and multimodal tasks. **OpenCode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)** bridges this gap: - **Zero API Keys Required**: Seamlessly leverages your existing local OpenCode Desktop instance. - **10+ Free Pre-Configured Models**: Instantly exposes high-capability free models into DeepSeek Harness with no billing or subscription requirements. - **Dynamic Auto-Synchronization**: Automatically monitors and syncs models whenever OpenCode Desktop updates its model registry, changes configurations, or introduces new free models—with zero restarts required. - **Native DeepSeek Harness Streaming**: Full integration with Cordis and DeepSeek Harness protocols, featuring real-time token streaming and reasoning/thinking traces (`thinking_delta` & `text_delta`). --- ### 🧠 Supported OpenCode Desktop Free Models The plugin automatically discovers and maps the complete catalog of free models from OpenCode Desktop: | Model ID | DeepSeek Harness Name | Context Window | Thinking / Reasoning | Modality | Best For | | :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | `opencode/beam-free` | Beam Free [Free] | 32,768 | ❌ | Text | Ultra-fast responses, linting, concise edits | | `opencode/big-pickle` | Big Pickle [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Balanced algorithmic coding & problem solving | | `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | High-throughput code synthesis & agent planning | | `opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free` | GLM-5.3-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Deep reasoning, multilingual translation, code review | | `opencode/longcat-2.5-preview-free` | LongCat 2.5 Preview Free [Free] | 262,144 | ❌ | Text | Massive context comprehension, full-repo analysis | | `opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Low-latency chat & reactive interactive agents | | `opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free` | Nemotron 3 Ultra Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Enterprise code analysis & complex architecture | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free [Free] | 65,536 | ❌ | Text | Instant snippet generation & documentation | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text, Image | UI/UX mockups, visual debugging, charts | | `opencode/space-bunny-free` | Space Bunny Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Creative engineering, prompt design, test suites | --- ### 🔄 Dynamic Auto-Synchronization Engine ```mermaid flowchart LR A["OpenCode Desktop
(Local Service / CLI)"] <-->|"opencode models
Periodic Discovery"| B["OpenCodeModelSynchronizer
(Background Daemon)"] B -->|"Event: models-updated"| C["OpenCodeAdapter
(LlmAdapter)"] C -->|"Dynamic Registration"| D["DeepSeek Harness
LLM Runtime"] D -->|"Stream Requests / Thinking Blocks"| E["Agent & Chat Sessions"] ``` 1. **Auto-Discovery on Boot**: On initialization, `OpenCodeModelSynchronizer` invokes `opencode models` via standard local CLI paths across Windows, macOS, and Linux. 2. **Differential Comparison**: Keeps a snapshot of known models and computes differences. If OpenCode rolls out a new model version or introduces a new free tier model, the synchronizer emits a `models-updated` event. 3. **Hot Registry Refresh**: DeepSeek Harness updates its active provider catalog dynamically. Users can immediately select newly added models in the dropdown selector without reloading the application. --- ### 🚀 Installation Instructions for DeepSeek Harness #### Method 1: Via DeepSeek Harness GUI (Recommended) 1. Open **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**. 2. Click on **Complementos** (Plugins) in the left navigation sidebar. 3. Click the **+ Agregar complemento** (+ Add Plugin) button in the upper right. 4. In the text field, paste the official GitHub repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect ``` *(Alternatively, you can provide the package name `dsh-plugin-opencode-connect` if published, or the path to a local directory).* 5. Click **Instalar** (Install). DeepSeek Harness will install the plugin and automatically detect your OpenCode Desktop models. --- #### Method 2: Via DeepSeek Harness CLI / Cordis Patch Using the DeepSeek Harness CLI toolchain: ```bash # Using pnpm pnpm dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-opencode-connect # Or using npm npm install --save dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` Or apply the included bundle patch in your `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: llm-opencode-connect name: dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` --- #### Method 3: Local Directory Path Installation (Development / Offline) To run or develop from source: ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect.git cd Opencode-Connect # Install dependencies and build npm install npm run build ``` Then in DeepSeek Harness GUI: 1. Navigate to **Complementos** > **+ Agregar complemento**. 2. Select **Cargar desde directorio local** (Load from local folder) or paste the absolute path: ```text C:\Users\\path\to\Opencode-Connect ``` 3. Click **Confirmar**. --- ### ⚙️ Configuration Options Configuration can be specified in your Cordis / DeepSeek Harness configuration file (`cordis.yml` or plugin options): ```yaml dsh-plugin-opencode-connect: # Path to opencode or opencode-cli executable. # Leave empty ("") to auto-detect across standard installation paths. cliPath: "" # Background synchronization polling interval in milliseconds. # Default: 30000 (30 seconds) syncIntervalMs: 30000 # Filter only free models provided by OpenCode Desktop. # Default: true onlyFreeModels: true # DeepSeek Harness LLM provider prefix ID. # Default: "opencode" providerPrefix: "opencode" # Human-readable provider display name. # Default: "OpenCode Desktop" providerDisplayName: "OpenCode Desktop" # Enable streaming of internal reasoning/thinking tokens. # Default: true enableThinking: true # Per-request execution timeout in milliseconds. # Default: 180000 (3 minutes) timeoutMs: 180000 # Diagnostic log level ('debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'). # Default: "info" logLevel: "info" ``` --- ### 🛠️ Troubleshooting & Diagnostics #### 1. "OpenCode CLI binary not found" - **Cause**: OpenCode Desktop might be installed in a custom non-standard directory, or not yet launched. - **Solution**: - Ensure **OpenCode Desktop** is installed and has been run at least once so it extracts its CLI helper. - Specify the explicit binary path in your config (`cliPath: "C:\\path\\to\\opencode-cli.exe"` or `/usr/local/bin/opencode-cli`). - Standard auto-detected locations: - **Windows**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\@op

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Hindsight 记忆服务的随行守护，DSH 启动时拉起本地 daemon，退出时连同嵌入式 PostgreSQL 一起清理，并在设置里提供独立页面。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hindsight-daemon

给 [DSH Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的 **Hindsight 本地记忆 daemon 生命周期插件**。

DSH 启动时自动把 Hindsight daemon 拉起来，DSH 退出时把它连同它依赖的嵌入式 PostgreSQL
一起停掉 —— **不产生任何常驻进程**，也不需要开机自启项、计划任务或后台监视器。
安装完成后在「设置 → Hindsight 记忆」里有一个独立页面，可以看状态、装依赖、启停服务、改配置。

> 仅支持 **Windows**（依赖 `taskkill` 与 `pg_ctl` 的 Windows 语义）。

---

## 为什么需要这个插件

Hindsight 的 coding-agent 集成有三种模式：`cloud`、`self-hosted`、`daemon`。
选 `daemon` 时，记忆存在本机（嵌入式 PostgreSQL + pg0），只有"抽取事实"这一步会调用
你自己的 LLM —— 数据不出机器，也不需要任何云端账号。

但官方插件在 `daemon` 模式下有两个限制，导致它无法自己把 daemon 拉起来：

1. **它只认进程环境变量。** `detectLlm()` 读的是 DSH 进程的 `process.env`
   （`HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER` 或 `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / …），
   读不到 `~/.hindsight/profiles/<profile>.env` 里已经配好的值。检测不到就直接放弃，
   日志里留下 `daemon mode needs an LLM for fact extraction`。
2. **它只等 12 秒。** 会话启动时 `seedIfCold` 用 `DAEMON_WAIT_SESSION_START_MS = 12e3` 等待，
   且**每个进程只尝试一次**。而 daemon 冷启动要 ~30 秒（Python 侧 `import torch` +
   `import sentence_transformers` 就要 12～13 秒），根本等不到。

这个插件把"拉起 daemon"这件事从官方插件手里接过来：**在 DSH 自己的 Cordis 树里**
做，时机更早、不占用任何额外进程，而且退出时能干净收尾。

---

## 它是怎么工作的

```
DSH 启动
  └─ Cordis 加载本插件 (lib/index.js → apply)
       ├─ 注册 /hindsight-daemon/api/* 路由（设置页用）
       └─ 后台 spawn: hindsight-embed -p <profile> daemon start
            └─ daemon (pythonw) 监听 127.0.0.1:9077
                 └─ pg0 拉起嵌入式 PostgreSQL (:5432)

DSH 退出
  └─ main.js 的 before-quit → 拦截退出 → dispose 整棵 Cordis 树（宽限 5 秒）
       └─ 本插件 apply() 返回的 disposer
            ├─ taskkill /F /IM hindsight-embed.exe /T   ← 掐掉 detached 的 CLI
            ├─ 按端口找到 daemon PID → taskkill /T
            └─ pg_ctl stop -m fast -D <data>            ← 优雅关库，下次不用回放 WAL
```

实测：`apply()` 返回耗时约 **2 ms**（不阻塞 DSH 启动），disposer 清理约 **600 ms**，
远在 5 秒宽限之内。冷启动到健康约 **30 秒**（模型与依赖已就绪时）。

清理必须显式做三件事，原因都在实测里踩过：

- `hindsight-embed daemon start` 这个 CLI 是 **detached** 的，daemon 被杀后它会把 daemon
  再拉起来 —— 所以第一步先掐 CLI。
- `hindsight-embed daemon stop` **不会停 PostgreSQL**，而且实测要 4 秒，贴着 5 秒宽限，不安全 ——
  所以改按端口 PID 强杀 daemon，再用 `pg_ctl stop -m fast` 单独关库（约 160 ms）。

---

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Windows 10 / 11 |
| DSH Desktop | 2.0.x（依赖 `apply()` 返回函数即 disposer 的 Cordis 4 语义） |
| Node.js | ≥ 20（仅 `scripts/install-deps.mjs` 需要） |
| uv | 由安装流程检查；缺失时会提示如何安装 |
| 磁盘 | 约 3 GB（Python 依赖 1.5 GB + 本地模型 1.2 GB + 数据库） |
| 模型服务 | 一个 [OI] 兼容的 LLM 接口（只用于抽取事实） |

---

## 安装

### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/CHANGE_ME/dsh-hindsight-daemon.git
cd dsh-hindsight-daemon
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
```

脚本会：

1. 在 DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一个 insert 块（修改前自动备份）；
2. 调用 `scripts/install-deps.mjs` 安装 Python 依赖与两个本地模型。

可用的参数：

```powershell
-Profile <名>    DSH profile 名，默认 desktop
-DshHome <路径>  DSH home 目录，默认 $env:DSH_HOME 或 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh
-SkipDeps        只挂插件，依赖留到设置页里点「一键安装」
```

脚本是幂等的：重复执行不会写入第二个 insert 块。

装完**重启 DSH**，然后打开 **设置 → Hindsight 记忆**，填入你自己的模型服务。

### 方式二：手动挂载

把插件目录放到任意位置，然后在 `<DSH home>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: hindsight-daemon
      name: 'D:/path/to/dsh-hindsight-daemon/lib/index.js'
```

注意 `name` 用**正斜杠**，指向 `lib/index.js`。之后在设置页点「一键安装」补齐依赖。

### 方式三：npm

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-hindsight-daemon
```

`package.json` 里带了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装后由包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动挂载。

> 三种方式**只能选一种**。重复挂载会让 `/hindsight-daemon/api` 前缀路由注册两次，
> DSH 启动时报 `webserver: duplicate prefix route`。

---

## 设置页

**设置 → Hindsight 记忆**（导航里排在靠后的位置）包含六块：

> **每个按钮都有明确反馈**：点击后按钮文字立刻变成 `保存中…` / `启动中…` / `切换中…` 这类进行中状态并禁用，避免重复点击；操作结果紧跟在底部 **保存配置 / 重新探测** 两个按钮下方 —— 成功是绿色回执（如「配置已保存」），5 秒后自动消失；失败是红色错误，一直保留到下一次操作成功。

### 服务状态

显示阶段（`已停止` / `启动中` / `运行中` / `安装中` / `异常`）、地址与已运行时长，
并提供 **启动** / **停止** 按钮。每 2 秒刷新一次。

### 环境检测

分别显示 `uv`、`hindsight-embed`、`PostgreSQL` 与数据库目录的就绪状态。
任何一项缺失都可以用一键安装补齐。探测优先级：**设置里填的路径 > 环境变量 > PATH > 常见安装位置**。

### 一键安装

幂等，可以重复点。依次执行五个阶段：

| 阶段 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `check` | 定位 `uv` |
| `packages` | `uv tool install hindsight-embed --with hindsight-api --force` |
| `profile` | 创建 / 对齐 `hindsight-embed` 的 profile（写环境变量） |
| `models` | 用 venv 里的 Python 通过 `huggingface_hub` 下载 embedding 与 reranker |
| `verify` | `import torch, sentence_transformers, hindsight_api` 自检 |

`--with hindsight-api` 这一步很关键：把 API 装进**同一个 venv**，daemon 启动时才能直接找到
`hindsight-api.exe`；否则它会退回 `uvx hindsight-api@<version>`，在临时环境里重新下载一遍 600 MB。

### 当前记忆

**只读**，回答「记忆到底存在哪」：数据库目录、占用空间，以及每个记忆库的节点 / 关联 / 文档数。

一个代码仓库对应一个记忆库，按仓库名自动命名，不同项目之间互不可见。这些信息不能在这里修改
—— 位置由下面的「高级」决定，想换地方见「文件都放在哪」。

### 记忆仓库（Profile）

列出本机所有 profile，标明哪个正在使用，并可以直接新建、切换。

一个 profile 就是一间独立的仓库：自己的数据库、自己的 env（含网关密钥）、自己的日志。
新建只写 env 文件，**不建数据库、不启进程** —— 等它被启用、daemon 第一次启动时才建出来，
所以新建本身不占磁盘。启用某个仓库会停掉当前 daemon 再按新仓库拉起（约 30 秒），
原来的仓库原封不动，随时能切回来。

名字只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，以字母或数字开头，最多 32 个字符。
只允许切到已经存在的 profile —— 手输一个拼错的名字会静默建出空库，比直接报错更难察觉。

### 模型服务

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | 目前走 OI 兼容协议，选 `openai` 即可 |
| 模型名 | 抽取事实用的模型，例如 `gpt-4o-mini` |
| Base URL | 兼容网关地址，例如 `https://api.example.com/v1` |
| API Key | 落盘明文保存；设置页只回显圆点（`••••`）表示已设置，留空保存表示不修改 |

填完 `Base URL` / `模型名` / `API Key` 之后，点 **测试连通性** 会立刻用当前草稿发一次最小请求，
直接告诉你通不通、失败原因、耗时和接口实际回显的模型名 —— 不必等到写记忆时才发现配错。
密钥留空时自动回退到已保存的那一份，所以「刚填完还没保存就想测」也能用。
测试只读，不写配置、不影响正在运行的 daemon。

### 高级

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Profile 名 | **只读**，显示当前使用的仓库。要换仓库请用上面的「记忆仓库（Profile）」列表 —— 直接改名等于指向一个全新的空库：旧记忆不会被删除，但也不会跟过来 |
| 记忆库命名模板 | 留空 = 每个代码仓库自动一个库，模板为 `coding-agent::{gitProject}`。填了会当成字面模板 —— 填 `work` 就是所有项目共用 `work` 这一个库 |
| 本地端口 | daemon 监听端口，默认 `9077`，改动需重启 DSH |
| HF 镜像 | 默认 `https://hf-mirror.com`，只影响首次下载模型，装好后不再起作用 |
| PyPI 镜像 | 默认清华源，只影响安装依赖，装好后不再起作用 |

前两项决定记忆存在哪，后三项只影响下载与监听 —— 所以界面上把危险项排在前并单独加了警示。

#### 记忆库到底叫什么

上游插件按模板算库名，默认模板是 `coding-agent::{gitProject}`，`{gitProject}` 取 **git 仓库根目录名**：

| 当前工作区 | 推导出的库名 |
| --- | --- |
| `D:\WORKSPACE.SUN\...\JLC-Agent`（git 仓库） | `coding-agent::JLC-Agent` |
| `D:\WORKSPACE.SUN\dsh-plugins\dsh-hindsight-daemon`（不是 git 仓库） | `coding-agent::dsh-hindsight-daemon`（目录名） |

可用占位符：`{gitProject}`（git 仓库根目录名，worktree 会追到主仓库）、`{project}`（当前目录名，不追仓库根）、`{harness}`、`{channel}`、`{user}`。

所以换一个工作区目录，只要它是另一个 git 仓库，就会自动写进另一个库 —— 互不串味，不需要任何配置。库里没东西就是还没在这个仓库里聊过天。

页面底部合并展示插件日志与 daemon 日志（各取尾部），排错时先看这里。

---

## 文件都放在哪

| 内容 | 路径 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件配置 | `<DSH home>/hindsight-daemon/config.json` |
| profile 环境变量 | `%USERPROFILE%\.hindsight\profiles\<profile>.env` |
| hindsight 全局配置 | `%USERPROFILE%\.hindsight\coding-agent.json` |
| daemon 日志 | `%USERPROFILE%\.hindsight\profiles\<profile>.log` |
| 数据库 | `%USERPROFILE%\.pg0\instances\hindsight-embed-<profile>\data` |
| Python 运行时 | `<UV_TOOL_DIR>\hindsight-embed`（默认 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\uv\tools`） |
| 本地模型 | `%HF_HOME%`，未设置则在 `%USERPROFILE%\.cache\huggingface` |

---

## 卸载

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1
```

只从 `cordis.patch.yml` 里移除 insert 块（同样会备份）。重启 DSH 后插件不再加载。
Python 依赖、模型与数据库都保留，方便之后重新挂上；要彻底清理请按上面表格手动删除对应目录。

---

## 常见问题

**首次启动很慢？**
正常。首次要下 1.5 GB 依赖 + 1.2 GB 模型，之后冷启动约 30 秒。装好依赖和模型后，
每次启动就只是 Python 导入的开销。

**日志里出现 `daemon mode needs an LLM for fact extraction`？**
这是官方 `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` 插件在报怨它自己检测不到 LLM —— 它只看
DSH 进程的环境变量。本插件不依赖那条路径，看到这条可以忽略，只要 daemon 状态是「运行中」即可。

**依赖安装到一半失败？**
装依赖对网络比较敏感。默认已经走清华 PyPI 镜像和 hf-mirror；如果在公司网络里，把
「PyPI 镜像」和「HF 镜像」改成内网地址，或留空走官方源。装到一半失败可以直接重试，
已下载的轮子有缓存。

**端口 9077 被占用？**
改「本地端口」并重启 DSH。插件启动前会先探测 `/health`，如果端口上已经有一个健康的
daemon（可能是你自己手动起的），会直接复用而不是再拉一个。

**改了端口 / Profile 名没生效？**
这两项要**重启 DSH** 才生效（要重建 profile 与全局配置）。

**DSH 非正常退出（崩溃 / 强杀）后 daemon 还在？**
说明 disposer 没跑到。手动收一次即可：

```powershell
taskkill /F /IM hindsight-embed.exe /T
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9077 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { taskkill /F /PID $_.OwningProcess /T }
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.pg0\installation\*\bin\pg_ctl.exe" stop -m fast -D "$env:USERPROFILE\.pg0\instances\hindsight-embed-<profile>\data"
```

下次启动 DSH 时如果数据库没干净关闭，PostgreSQL 会自己回放 WAL 恢复，不会丢数据。

## 开发

```powershell
node --check lib/index.js          # 语法
node scripts/install-deps.mjs      # 在 DSH 之外跑一遍安装流程，便于调试
```

目录结构：

```
lib/
  index.js        Cordis 入口：什么时候挂接口、什么时候拉起、什么时候收摊
  lifecycle.js    生命周期：探测 → 启动 → 停止 → 安装 → 保存配置
  api.js          /hindsight-

plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the session terminal tool from pwsh to the local Git Bash on Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-tool

在 Windows 上把模型的终端工具从 **pwsh** 换成 **本机 Git Bash** 的 DSH 插件。

设计取向：**一个开关、所有 preset 跟随、不动 preset 文件、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**。默认 `dialect: pwsh`，装上去什么都不变；改成 `bash` 后，**新会话**拿到 `bash` 工具、`pwsh` 从该会话的工具目录里消失，已开的会话保持原状。

---

## 为什么要这个插件

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的平台组合在 Windows 上是互斥的：

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
- id: tool-bash          # 同样的平台断言
- id: tool-pwsh
```

`ctx.shell` 是单实例服务（同一 context 内加载第二个会抛错），所以 Windows 上根本没有 bash 执行器，`bash` 工具也不存在。想用 Git Bash 只有三条路：

| 路线 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 改 `dsh-base` / profile patch 的平台断言 | 要动第一方组合，重启，且只影响那一个平面 |
| 自研 PTY / 自研工具 | 重写 60KB+ 的工具契约，容易与官方行为漂移 |
| **本插件：会话级隔离替换** | 只在新会话的 `isolate('shell')` 子树里注入执行器，宿主平面不动 |

本插件选第三条。

---

## 工作原理

插件本身不实现终端。它做四件事，全部复用第一方组件：

1. **执行器**：`GitBashExecutor extends LocalBashExecutor`，只改两处——
   - `execute()` 用配置的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径组 `[bash, -c, command]`（基类硬编码 `"bash"`，在 Windows 上会命中 `System32\bash.exe`，那是 WSL 启动器）；
   - `resolve()` 注入 `PATH`（`spawnSpec` 里 `spec.env` 是唯一能塞 PATH 的位置）。

   超时、输出收集与溢出、abort 分类、`dshEnv` 合并、结果整形全部继承，行为与官方 bash 执行器一致。

2. **工具本体**：直接挂官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`。前台/后台、超时转后台、`sandbox_permissions` 升级、会话 cwd、工具卡片、退出码标记，官方自带。

3. **会话级替换**（`src/replace.ts`，在 `agent/created` 里执行）：
   ```
   shellCtx = agentCtx.isolate('shell')       // 该 agent 私有的 shell realm
   shellCtx.plugin(GitBashExecutor, {...})    // 只在这个子树里可见
   shellCtx.plugin(ToolBash, {...})           // 注册出的 bash 落在 agent 自己的工具层
   agentCtx.tools.restrict({ deny: ['pwsh'] })          // 只过滤「继承来的」工具
   agentCtx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'tool:pwsh', text: '' })  // 空文本=渲染时丢弃
   ```
   四步都登记在 `agentCtx` 上，会话结束由 cordis 逆序释放；中途失败则逆序回滚，会话退化为原样。

4. **配置**：所有字段 `.volatile()`，Host 侧由 `dsh-settings` 投影成可写 namespace；**客户端半区**（`lib/client.js`）再用官方 `configForms` 服务把同一份值渲染成 **设置 → 通用 → 终端工具** 的一行，写回仍落在 profile 的 patch 层。不加客户端半区时，Host 侧值虽然可写，但设置页里没有任何 UI 入口。

### 关键设计约束（为什么不那么做）

- **不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**：那会让所有会话（包括没选 bash 的）跟着变，并且与宿主平台的执行器冲突。
- **不编辑 preset**：`preset-standard` 在 profile 里是完整快照，改它等于接管用户的组合文件，且升级会被覆盖。
- **只对新会话生效**：工具与 prompt 是会话创建时装配的，运行中换不掉——这是 DSH 的语义，不是插件的取舍。
- **`restrict` 只过滤继承层**：官方文档明确 "never what its OWN layer registers"，所以从 agent scope 调 `restrict({deny:['pwsh']})` 恰好只隐藏 preset 带进来的 `pwsh`，不影响本层注册的 `bash`。
- **不绕过沙箱**：受限模式下仍走 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`，起不来就如实把官方错误交给模型。

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows + DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（本插件在该版本上开发与验证）
- 本机已装 Git for Windows（或 MSYS2 / Cygwin）
- 想用受限沙箱的话，见下面「已知限制」第 3 条

### 步骤

```powershell
# 1. 构建（产物在 lib/）
git clone https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-tool.git
cd dsh-terminal-tool
npm install
npm run check        # typecheck + build + contractcheck + selftest + integration

# 2. 装进 profile（本机 profile 为 desktop）
#    用插件管理器从本地目录安装：
#    plugin_manager install_bundle → target = 本仓库的绝对路径
npm pack
# 或把 tarball / 目录放进 profile 的依赖里，例如
#   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
```

插件包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的组合层会读取它并插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: terminal-tool
      name: dsh-terminal-tool
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

**安装或升级后必须重启 DSH**：运行中插入的 row 只进组合树，插件的 `apply` 不会被调用。

### 启用

重启后打开 **设置 → 通用**，底部会多出一行 **终端工具**（客户端半区注册的 `settings.general.item` 行）：

```
终端工具
[PowerShell（pwsh）] [Git Bash（bash）]
Git Bash 路径  [__________________________]  [自动发现]
更改对新会话生效（运行中的会话保持启动时的选择）。
```

- 两枚胶囊按钮切换 `dialect`，**默认 `pwsh`**：装插件本身不改变任何行为。
- 选 `bash` 后才出现路径行。「自动发现」会扫一遍本机 Git Bash，把可用路径持久化进 `bashCandidates`；候选多于一条时输入框变成下拉。
- 已经选好的路径**不会**被后续扫描改写（除非它已失效）。
- 挂载时**不扫描、不写配置**：扫描只在点「自动发现」时发生，`/state` 只读配置。

设置行通过两条只读 `/api` 路由取数（写入仍走 `configForms`，落 profile patch 层）：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/state` | 平台、设置可用性、当前值、能力探测。**不扫描**，所以打开设置是瞬时的 |
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/discover` | 用户点「自动发现」时才调用，返回全部可用候选 |

Config 字段（设置行只暴露前三个；其余仍可直接写 profile patch）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dialect` | `pwsh`（默认，行为不变）/ `bash` |
| `bashPath` | 显式 bash.exe 绝对路径；留空 = 自动发现 |
| `bashCandidates` | 上一次「自动发现」的可用路径（也接受手填的安装根目录） |
| `autoDiscover` | 会话装配时 `bashPath` 为空是否自动发现 |
| `discoverTimeoutMs` | 一次发现的上限（只 stat 文件，不 spawn） |
| `loginShell` | 传 `-l`，读取登录 profile |
| `extraPath` | 追加到子进程 PATH 的目录 |
| `pythonUtf8` | 导出 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| `timeoutMs` / `maxTimeoutMs` / `maxOutputBytes` / `maxSpillBytes` / `graceMs` | 继承自官方 bash 执行器的同名字段 |

把 `dialect` 改成 `bash`，**新建会话**即可看到工具目录里是 `bash` 而不再是 `pwsh`。已开的会话不受影响。

---

## 自动发现顺序

`bashPath` 为空且 `autoDiscover` 为真时，按下列顺序找，命中即止：

1. `bashCandidates` 里的每一项（展开为 `bin\bash.exe` / `usr\bin\bash.exe`）
2. 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\GitForWindows` 的 `InstallPath`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\Git`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Git`、`%LocalAppData%\Programs\Git`
4. `%ProgramFiles%\MSYS2`、`C:\msys64`、`%LocalAppData%\MSYS2`
5. `%SystemDrive%\cygwin64`、`%SystemDrive%\cygwin`
6. PATH 上 `git.exe` 反推（`<root>\bin\bash.exe`）

**WSL 被硬排除**：`C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` 和 `WindowsApps\bash.exe` 都不是 Git Bash，交给执行器会得到另一个操作系统和另一套文件系统。

发现只做文件系统探测（`statSync`）+ 一次异步 `reg.exe query`，**不会 spawn `bash --version`**——宿主在 `agent/created` 里串行派发事件，同步 spawn 会卡住整个进程。

---

## PATH 组装

执行时子进程 PATH = `工具链 bin` → `usr\bin` → `bin` → `usr\local\bin` → `extraPath` → **宿主 PATH**。

顺序是有意的：MSYS2 的 `git`/`ls`/`grep` 必须赢过 Windows 上的同名同源工具，而宿主 PATH 必须保留，否则 `node`/`python` 等原生命令会消失。去重按「小写 + 去尾分隔符 + `/`→`\`」归一化。

---

## 排障

诊断日志（每次会话一行）：

```
%TEMP%\dsh-terminal-tool.log
```

用 `DSH_TERMINAL_TOOL_DIAG_FILE` 覆盖路径。典型行：

```
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] ok session=... bash=C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe source=registry path=4 entries
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] skip session=... reason=bash-not-found: C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe: file does not exist
[2026-10-18T02:10:00.000Z] skip session=... reason=already-replaced
```

`reason` 取值：`not-win32` / `dialect-pwsh` / `no-agent-context` / `already-replaced` / `bash-not-found` / `missing-service` / `mount-failed`。

排查思路：

1. **工具目录还是 pwsh** → 先看日志有没有 `ok session=`。没有 `ok` 就按 `reason` 走。
2. **`bash-not-found`** → 把 `bashPath` 显式指到 `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe` 试试。
3. **`mount-failed`** → `detail` 里是 cordis 的原始错误（常见是配置校验或服务缺失）。
4. **bash 能出现但命令报错** → 见「已知限制」第 3、4、5 条。

插件永不因自身问题让会话创建失败：`agent/created` 是串行派发的，监听器抛错会让 agent 注册失败，所以整个监听体是防御式的，任何异常只落日志。

---

## 已知限制

1. **仅 Windows**。非 Windows 上 patch 行的 `disabled` 为真，插件根本不加载。
2. **只对新会话生效**。工具与 prompt 段是会话创建时装配的，运行中无法替换。
3. **受限沙箱下 Git Bash 起不来**。`read-only` / `workspace-write` 用受限令牌执行，MSYS2 无法创建 `BaseNamedObjects`：
   ```
   bash.exe: *** fatal error - NtCreateDirectoryObject(\BaseNamedObjects\msys-2.0S5-…): 0xC0000022
   exit -1073741502
   ```
   需要 `danger-full-access`。**这是宿主沙箱行为，与插件无关**，插件不会绕过它。
4. **原生 Windows 程序输出可能乱码**。`cmd`/`tasklist`/`powershell` 按 ANSI 代码页（中文系统为 936）写管道，DSH 按 UTF-8 解码 → 中文乱码；`chcp 65001` 无效。仅 Python 可用 `PYTHONIOENCODING` 缓解（默认已开）。
5. **`cmd /c` 会被 MSYS 参数改写**，需写 `cmd //c` 或设 `MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'`。
6. **首次安装必须重启 DSH**（理由见「安装」）。
7. **`minimal` preset 的持久 shell 会退化为一次性 shell**。持久终端由 `dsh-terminal-bash` 后端提供，本插件只替换一次性 `bash` 工具。

---

## 工程结构

```
src/index.ts      插件入口：apply / Config / agent 事件
src/config.ts     schemastery Config（全 volatile）+ 会话级快照
src/discover.ts   Git Bash 自动发现（含 WSL 排除）
src/paths.ts      路径算术：安装根、PATH 条目、校验、PATH 合成
src/executor.ts   GitBashExecutor（继承 LocalBashExecutor，含沙箱分支）
src/replace.ts    每会话替换 + 逆序回滚
src/diag.ts       诊断日志
src/types.ts      共享类型
src/shared/protocol.ts  Host/客户端共享的线路协议（路由路径、常量、视图类型）
src/routes.ts      两条只读 /api 路由：/state 与 /discover
src/client/        客户端半区：设置 → 通用 的「终端工具」行
                  index.ts 注册 settings.general.item；row.tsx 是行组件；
                  store.ts 是状态机（自动发现、写回、错误）；api.ts 取数
src/testing.ts     仅测试用的第二入口（不发布）
```

```powershell
npm run typecheck     # tsc --noEmit（devDeps 钉 0.2.1-rc.2 真 .d.ts）
npm run build         # esbuild → lib/index.js（Host ESM）+ lib/client.js（客户端半区，react 保持 external）
npm run contractcheck # Config 全 volatile / patch 行 / 导出面 / 客户端半区装载形状 / bundle 未内联第一方
npm run clientsmoke   # 真实执行 lib/client.js：模块装载形状、apply 注册行、无 configForms 时降级、迟到服务替换、HMR 幂等（8 项）
npm run rowselftest   # 行状态机 13 项：/state 读取、乐观写入、自动发现持久化、各类失败提示
npm run rend

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s
