plugins.description: 让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。
plugins.readme_text:
# Chinese Language Guard (dsh-language-guard)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> Make the DSH agent think and answer in the language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default, three strength levels, effective on the next message, zero dependencies, no build step.

---

## Table of Contents

- [Why you need it](#why-you-need-it)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Install](#install)
- [Strength levels](#strength-levels)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Settings panel and quick language switch](#settings-panel-and-quick-language-switch)
- [The `/language` slash command](#the-language-slash-command)
- [Verifying that the constraint reached the system prompt](#verifying-that-the-constraint-reached-the-system-prompt)
- [Coexisting with dsh-context](#coexisting-with-dsh-context)
- [How it differs from the official cot-translation plugin](#how-it-differs-from-the-official-cot-translation-plugin)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Design boundaries](#design-boundaries)
- [License](#license)

---

## Why you need it

The DSH system prompt is assembled from many sections: identity, plan policy, team policy, **tool descriptions**, deliverable references, deployment persona. The largest block by far is the tool documentation — written in English, and placed in the middle of the prompt.

Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (everything after order 50): **98.1% of the characters and 99.8% of the ASCII** come from English tool documentation, and 5.7K–14K characters separate the opening section from the closing one. The model reads overwhelmingly English tokens, and so it drifts:

- The first few turns stay in your language;
- as soon as it starts chaining tool calls, reading long files, or reasoning at length, the reasoning slides back into English;
- nothing in your settings changed — the conversation simply got longer.

A single "please answer in Chinese" line at the very top of the system prompt is enough for a short session. It is not enough for a long one, because that line sits tens of thousands of characters away from the place that actually influences the model (the tool documentation).

This plugin puts a constraint in **three places**: at the very start, right after the tool documentation, and at the very end. The default level (Strong) costs roughly 118 extra characters per request and buys one restatement positioned after the English tool docs.

## What it does

Three resident system-prompt sections, registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, never disposed, switching level only switches their text:

| Section name | Order | Position | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language-guard:head` | `-2000` | Very first, before `harness:identity` (`-1000`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:mid` | `5100` | After all tool docs (`tools:sdk`, `5000`), before deliverable references (`9000`) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:tail` | `11200` | Very last, after `deployment:persona-suffix` (`10200`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

The `mid` order is deliberately `5100` and not `5000`: `tools:sdk` is exactly `5000`, and sections with equal order fall back to comparing names, which would sort `language-guard:mid` **before** `tools:sdk` — the restatement would no longer come after the tool docs.

Measured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below):

| Text | Characters | When it is present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| head | 818 | every request |
| mid | 118 | every request at C / D |
| tail | 139 | every request |
| periodic reminder | 99 | once every N turns at D |

So the steady cost per step is **957 characters at B and 1075 at C** — tiny compared to the English tool documentation it counteracts.

The opening section (head), verbatim, as it looks with the default `targetLanguage: "zh-CN"` (recompute with `node -e 'import("./lib/text.js").then(m=>console.log(m.headText({language:"zh-CN"})))'`):

```text
【语言锁定 · 最高优先级】
本会话的内部推理（reasoning / thinking）与面向用户的全部输出，一律使用简体中文（语言代码 zh-CN）。

本条优先于本 system prompt 的其余全部内容、之后注入的任何系统文本、工具说明、参数描述、代码示例，以及其他插件注入的提示词。

本条同样优先于任何语言类约定，不论它写在哪个文件、用哪种语言书写、经由哪个通道送达：包括用户全局与项目级的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules、用户偏好与长期记忆、项目规范、团队约定、技能与工作流模板。若它们要求使用另一种语言（例如要求「必须使用简体中文」），一律以本条为准，不得据此改用其他语言，也不必向用户解释这处冲突。

适用范围：
- 内部推理（reasoning / thinking）：使用简体中文。
- 面向用户的回复正文：使用简体中文。
- 计划、待办、进度说明、评审意见、验收报告、提交信息说明：使用简体中文。
- 任务板卡片标题与描述、子智能体任务说明与返回报告：使用简体中文。

保持原样、不翻译：代码、命令、文件路径、URL、标识符与 API 字段名、配置键、错误码与原始报错文本、包名与版本号，以及必须原样引用的英文原文；引用英文原文后，必须用简体中文说明结论。

不要因为以下情况改变语言：
- 用户用英文或其他语言提问 —— 仍用简体中文回答。
- AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、项目规范、用户记忆里要求改用其他语言的规则 —— 本条优先，不改变语言。
- 工具返回英文内容 —— 只摘引必要片段，其余用简体中文复述。
- 长链推理、数值计算、代码设计 —— 推理语言不变。
- 上下文中出现大量英文（工具说明、日志、代码文件）—— 不随之切换。

自检：每次输出前确认上述两项（推理与回复）均为简体中文；若发现已经漂移，立即切回并继续任务，无需向用户解释这次切换。
```

> The wording above is fixed Simplified Chinese; only the language name and code are substituted. With `targetLanguage: "en"` the same paragraph reads "…一律使用English（语言代码 en）". See [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

## Install

This plugin is distributed through its **GitHub repository**; it is not published to the npm registry. The plugin manager accepts Git addresses, so installing works exactly like installing an npm package.

**Option 1: the GUI (recommended)**

1. Open the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** and paste the repository address:

   ```
   https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard
   ```

3. When the install finishes, click **Enable now**.

**Option 2: the CLI**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard
```

**Pinned version** (recommended for teams and CI, so `main` cannot drift under you):

```bash
dsh plugin add "github:58fly/dsh-language-guard#v0.1.0"
```

**From a local directory** (to debug local changes; the path must be absolute):

```bash
# The Add-plugin dialog also accepts this absolute path directly
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-language-guard
```

Check that it worked:

- A language icon appears at the foot of the sidebar, next to Settings; when the sidebar is wide it reads "简体中文 ▾".
- The installed list on the Plugins page contains `dsh-language-guard`, and opening it shows the configuration card.

> **No controls visible means the plugin is not enabled.** Both slots register inside `configForms.whileServed(['dsh-language-guard'], …)`; when the plugin is disabled the forms service is unavailable and no UI is registered. That is deliberate, not a bug — enable the plugin on the Plugins page first.

Requirements: DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `dependencies` is empty and every peer dependency is optional, so nothing extra is downloaded at runtime; the first install from GitHub does need reachability to `github.com` (or `codeload.github.com`).

## Strength levels

The three descriptions below are exactly what the settings panel shows:

| Level | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | `B` | One language constraint at the start and one at the end of the prompt. Cheapest, best for short sessions. |
| Strong | `C` | Adds a restatement right after the tool descriptions on top of Basic, countering drift from English tool docs. Recommended default. |
| Periodic | `D` | Adds a language self-check at the start of every Nth turn on top of Strong, for long sessions. The reminder appears as a session record and is visible in the session log. |

Behaviour differences:

| Behaviour | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resident system-prompt sections | head + tail | head + mid + tail | head + mid + tail |
| Restatement after tool docs | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Self-check every N turns | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (N defaults to 8, range 3–50) |
| New record in the session log | none | none | one per N turns (`source.kind = "language-guard"`) |
| Injection timing | — | — | the **first step** of a matching turn, alongside that turn's user message; no extra request |
| Counter after restart / resume | — | — | **not reset**: the turn number comes from the session log's `turn` projection, so `turn % N` is stable |
| Best for | short sessions, token-sensitive | the default | long sessions, or drift already observed |

How to choose:

- **Start with the default, Strong.** It is the only level aimed at the actual roo

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

plugins.description: Dots-style always-on agent for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): its own computer, reachable over IM, scheduled work, hard budget limits
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-dot **English** | [中文](#中文说明) Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) into a **Dots / Grok-Bot-style always-on agent**: it has its own computer, you reach it over WeChat / Feishu / QQ / Telegram, it works on a schedule or when a page you watch changes, and it stops itself when the day's budget is spent. dsh-dot is mostly composition plus a few hundred lines of glue: | Layer | Plugin | Role | |---|---|---| | Its own computer | [dsh-computer](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer) | microVM with shell, browser, live view, approval gates, audit log | | Reachable over IM | [dsh-bridge](https://github.com/wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge) | WeChat / Feishu / QQ / Telegram, card approvals, files | | Scheduled work | official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle` | daily / weekly / cron, survives restarts, wakes cold sessions | | Hard spending limit | [dsh-budget](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-budget) | session / daily / monthly caps, `block` policy | | Glue | **dsh-dot** (this repo) | identity file, model-free page watching, silence protocol, budget → pause + IM notice, midnight reset | ### Install ```bash # dsh desktop (quit the app first) "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \ github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer @wenbin_wb/dsh-bridge dsh-budget \ @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle ``` All five go in one command: dsh only layers bundles that are direct dependencies of the profile. Then set `overLimit: block` and a daily cap in **Settings → Plugins → Budget**, and connect an IM account in **Settings → Remote access** (dsh-bridge). --- ## 中文说明 dsh-dot 让 dsh 变成一个常驻 agent：**有自己的电脑、IM 上找得到、会定时和在页面变化时主动做事、花钱和危险操作有硬约束**。 北极星场景：在微信或飞书里说一句"每天早上看看 X 有没有更新，有就告诉我"。第二天到点，它在自己的电脑里打开网页检查；有更新就推到 IM，没更新就不打扰；遇到登录页推审批卡片，附实时画面链接；当天花费超限就自动暂停并通知你。 ### 一、安装 先退出 dsh 桌面版，再用**一条命令**装齐五个包。dsh 只把 profile 的直接依赖加进层栈，所以必须一起装： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \ github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer @wenbin_wb/dsh-bridge dsh-budget \ @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` 命令行版把 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web`，用 `dsh web` 启动。 ### 二、第一次设置 1. **预算**：设置 → 插件 → Budget，把超限策略设为 `block`，填一个日预算。不设的话 dsh-budget 默认只提醒、不拦截。 2. **IM**：设置 → 远程访问（dsh-bridge），连接微信、飞书、QQ 或 Telegram。建议开发送者白名单，只听你的。 3. **dot 的身份**：编辑 `~/dot/AGENTS.md`，写它叫什么、长期负责什么、你的偏好。在 `~/dot` 里开的会话会自动读这个文件。 4. **主会话**：在 IM 里和 dot 说一句话，或者在 dsh 里从 `~/dot` 新建会话。dot 会把定时提醒以外的主动消息（页面变化）投递到 IM 当前绑定的会话；没有绑定 IM 时，投递到 `~/dot` 里最近的会话。建议在 IM 里用 `/sessions` 切到 `~/dot` 的会话。 5. **公网实时画面（可选）**：按 dsh-computer README 用 `tailscale serve` 暴露实时画面，审批卡片里的链接在手机上才能打开。 ### 三、怎么用 | 你说 | 发生什么 | |---|---| | "每天早上 8 点看看 X 有没有更新" | agent 用官方 `schedule_create` 建任务；到点在虚拟机里检查 | | "盯着这个页面" | agent 把它写进 `~/dot/watch.json`；dot 定期抓取比较，不调模型；变了才叫醒 agent | | 发送 `/dot` | 查看 dot 状态：主会话、虚拟机、IM、预算、免打扰、关注项、积压事项 | | 发送 `/dot check` | 立即检查一遍关注项 | **静默协议**：被定时任务或页面变化叫醒时，检查后没有值得说的，agent 只回复 `DOT_SILENT`，这条不会发到 IM。 **预算**：dsh-budget 拦截后，dot 不再叫醒 agent，并在 IM 里通知你（模型不可用时直接发，不经过模型）；拦截期间的事项会攒着，解除后一并处理。日预算的拦截会在本地零点自动解除，第二天的定时任务照常运行。 **免打扰**：默认 23:00–08:00。期间检测到的变化先攒着，结束后再处理（官方定时任务不受影响）。 ### 四、配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `dsh-dot` 行的 config，或用环境变量： | 配置项 / 环境变量 | 默认值 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `home` / `DSH_DOT_HOME` | `~/dot` | `AGENTS.md` 和 `watch.json` 所在目录 | | `mainSession` | 自动 | 固定一个主会话 id | | `quietHours` | `23:00-08:00` | 免打扰时段，空字符串关闭 | | `autoUnblockDaily` | `true` | 本地零点自动解除日预算拦截 | | `notifyWebhook` / `DSH_DOT_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK` | 空 | IM 不可用时的备用通知：飞书机器人、企业微信机器人、Server酱（`https://sctapi.ftqq.com/.send`）或任意接收 JSON `{title, text}` 的地址 | | `precheckSeconds` / `budgetPollSeconds` | `60` / `15` | 扫描关注列表、查询预算的间隔 | `watch.json` 格式见 `~/dot/AGENTS.md`。 ### 五、工作原理与限制 - **和 dsh-bridge 的衔接**：dsh-bridge 会把绑定会话里的所有助手回复转发到 IM，但没有对外接口。dot 在运行时包装了它会话桥基类的两个方法，实现静默、读取绑定会话、不经模型直接发消息。会先检测类的结构，对不上就关闭这部分并提示，退回 webhook。计划给 dsh-bridge 提 PR，把这三个能力做成正式接口。 - **必须有 dsh-computer**：没有虚拟机隔离，"放心不管"就不成立，所以 dot 依赖它，缺了就不启动。dot 的唤醒、预算事件都写进 dsh-computer 的审计日志 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`（`kind: "dot"`）。 - **页面检查在本机发起**：用一个普通 GET 请求，不经过虚拟机。需要登录或 JS 渲染的页面看到的是空壳，这类页面请用定时任务让 agent 在虚拟机里看。 - **不做**：长期记忆、多个 dot、自我进化、自己的 IM 桥接或心跳框架。 - **需要电脑开着**：桌面版关窗口后仍在后台运行，但电脑休眠或退出 App 就停了；24 小时在线请部署到服务器。 ### 六、验证情况 在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 上已验证（云端，Docker 后端，模拟模型）：五个包同装无冲突；`~/dot/AGENTS.md` 被模型读到；`schedule_create` 建的任务到点投递进 dot 会话；页面变化被检测到并叫醒主会话；预算拦截后 dot 发通知、暂停唤醒、攒着事项；零点自动解除并补发事项；静默、会话绑定、直接发消息在真实 dsh-bridge 类上通过单元测试。 待在真实 IM 上验证：飞书或微信里的审批卡片和回传；公网实时画面链接在手机上能否打开。 MIT License.

# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：进程内看门狗自动复活 + 兜底清理，附设置页（状态/配置/清理/演练）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tmp-cleaner

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

DSH 插件：保证 `/tmp` 清理守护进程一直活着，并在「设置」里提供一个「临时清理」页。

- 启动时确保 `tmp-clean watch` 在跑；被 Android 杀掉后 **≤2 分钟自动复活**（进程内看门狗），
  即使守护进程一直被系统杀，到期的清理由 dsh 进程自己兜底执行；
- 设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理 / 演练，所有请求走 `/tmp-clean/api/*`；
- 清理工具本体是零依赖 Python 3 脚本，命令行与设置页**共用同一份配置**。

## 仓库内容

| 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边：看门狗、`/tmp-clean/api/*` 路由 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：`settings.section` 里的「临时清理」页 |
| `bin/tmp-clean` | 清理工具本体（Python 3，零第三方依赖） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插件行声明（`dsh.bundle`） |
| `test/*.mjs` | 离线测试（假 ctx / 假 loader） |

工具默认从 `/root/dsh-bin/tmp-clean` 调用（`lib/index.js` 的 `TOOL` 常量）；
装到别处时改这个常量，或把 `bin/tmp-clean` 复制/链接到该路径。

## 宿主半边（lib/index.js）

1. web 启动（或 HMR 重载本插件）时调用 `apply()`：
   - 若 `watch.pid` 对应的进程**确实是 tmp-clean**（核对 `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`，防 PID 复用误判）→ 不动；
     否则 detached 拉起 `tmp-clean watch`；
   - 异常只写 stderr，不影响 web 启动。
2. **进程内看门狗**（每 2 分钟）：
   - Android 的 phantom process killer 会时不时杀掉 detached 子进程。以前只有重启 web 才会重新拉起，
     表现就是设置页一直「守护进程：未运行」。现在掉线后 ≤2 分钟自动复活；
   - 重拉本身有 5 分钟冷却，避免连环刷进程；
   - 若守护进程持续缺席 ≥3 分钟，且按 `interval_hours` 已到期，则由 **dsh 进程自己**执行
     `tmp-clean run` 兜底清理。
3. 注册路由（经 `ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)`）：
   - `GET  /tmp-clean/api/status` → `tmp-clean status --json --fast` + 日志尾（默认不扫盘，页面秒开）
   - `GET  /tmp-clean/api/status?scan=1` → 完整扫描 `/tmp` 实际占用（7–20 秒，仅手动触发）
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/revive` → 手动拉起守护进程（带冷却）
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/config` → `tmp-clean config set …`
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/run` → `tmp-clean run [--dry-run]`

## 浏览器半边（lib/client.js）

以 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 手写 bundle 形式发布，
注册到 `settings.section` 槽位（id `tmp-cleaner`，order 60，标签「临时清理」）：

- 状态默认走快路径；「扫描大小」按钮才触发完整扫盘；
- 读取失败时给出原因和「重试」按钮（web 刚重启后常见，不必刷新整页）；
- 守护进程未运行时显示「看门狗 2 分钟内自动拉起」，不再是无解释的「未运行」。

## 配置

`/root/.tmp-clean/config.json`（命令行与设置页共用）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | true | 是否启用自动清理 |
| `interval_hours` | 24 | 清理周期（小时） |
| `max_size_gb` | 20 | 超过该占用就清 |
| `target_size_gb` | 10 | 清到该占用为止 |
| `min_age_hours` | 2 | 只删这么旧的目录 |
| `poll_minutes` | 15 | 守护进程轮询间隔 |
| `dry_run` | false | 演练模式（不真删） |

## 测试

```bash
node test/host-test.mjs     # 假 ctx：4 条路由 + 快/慢状态 + revive + CLI 读写往返
node test/client-test.mjs   # 假 loader：materialize bundle + 注册/渲染断言
node test/probe-web.mjs     # 对运行中的 web 探测（需有效本地 cookie）
```

## 安装 / 卸载

- 安装：把仓库放进 `/root/dsh-tmp-cleaner`，在 profile 的 `dependencies` 加
  `"dsh-tmp-cleaner": "link:/root/dsh-tmp-cleaner"`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `dsh-tmp-cleaner`，
  建 `node_modules/dsh-tmp-cleaner` 链接，把 `bin/tmp-clean` 放到 `/root/dsh-bin/`，**重启一次 web**。
- 卸载：反做上述步骤，并 `kill $(cat /root/.tmp-clean/watch.pid)`。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a wa_* tool family that lets the agent operate a WhatsApp account through a bundled Baileys bridge.
plugins.readme_text:
# wa-agent

WhatsApp control for the DeepSeek Harness agent.

`wa-agent` adds a family of 46 `wa_*` tools that let an agent operate a
WhatsApp account: connection and pairing, chats and message history, text,
media, locations, contacts and polls, reactions, edits, deletes, groups,
contact book, profile and privacy, presence, and the event stream.

The tools talk to a long-lived **wa-agent bridge** that ships inside this
package. The bridge (`bridge/bridge.mjs`, built on
[Baileys](https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys)) owns the WhatsApp socket,
the auth state and the message store; it also exposes a loopback HTTP endpoint
for the human-facing QR code. The plugin speaks to it over JSON-lines RPC on
stdio or, when a service manages the bridge, over loopback HTTP.

## Install

One command installs the plugin, the bridge and the bridge's npm dependencies:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/wa-agent
```

On pnpm 11 and newer, that command may stop once because pnpm blocks
dependency build scripts by default (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`). It names the
packages. Approve them in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run the
same command:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  baileys: true      # preinstall only checks the Node.js version
  protobufjs: false  # postinstall belongs to the protobufjs CLI, not the runtime
```

Restart the harness to load the bundle (the bundle layer is read at boot, not
at install time):

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the add command appends `wa-agent`
to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. That line is the only
activation.

Check the loaded line:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 wa-agent
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: wa-agent
  name: wa-agent
  config: {}
```

No extra step is needed to run the bridge: the plugin spawns it on the first
tool call (`autoStart`, default `true`) and restarts it after a crash. The
first thing left to do is pair your WhatsApp account (next section).

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command, then restart the harness
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove wa-agent   # uninstall, then restart
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **pnpm** on `PATH` (`npm install -g pnpm`); the harness manages profile
  plugins with it.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- **A WhatsApp account you control**, paired by you (see below).

## Pairing

On first run the bridge has no session and shows a QR. With the default
`httpPort: 29141`:

1. Open <http://127.0.0.1:29141/qr.png>.
2. In the phone, open WhatsApp > **Linked devices** > **Link a device** and
   scan the QR.
3. Call `wa_status` (or ask the agent) to confirm the phase and the paired
   account.

Alternative: ask the agent for `wa_pair_sms_code` with the full international
phone number. The phone receives a 6-digit code, typed in WhatsApp > **Linked
devices** > **Link with phone number**.

The session is stored by the bridge, never by this package. It is reused on
every reconnect until `wa_logout` is called. Pairing is per account; you pair
your own account.

## Usage

Ask the agent in natural language:

- "What is the WhatsApp status?"
- "Show the last 20 messages from this chat."
- "Send this image to `<recipient>` with the caption `<caption>`."
- "Create a group named `<name>` and add `<participants>`."
- "Mark this chat as read."

Tool groups:

| Group | Tools |
|---|---|
| Connection | `wa_status`, `wa_pair`, `wa_pair_sms_code`, `wa_restart`, `wa_logout` |
| Chats and messages | `wa_chats`, `wa_chat_messages`, `wa_send_text`, `wa_edit_message`, `wa_send_media`, `wa_send_location`, `wa_send_contact`, `wa_send_poll`, `wa_send_reaction`, `wa_pin_message`, `wa_delete_message`, `wa_forward_message`, `wa_download_media`, `wa_mark_read`, `wa_chat_modify` |
| Groups | `wa_groups`, `wa_group_info`, `wa_group_create`, `wa_group_join`, `wa_group_update`, `wa_group_participants`, `wa_group_settings`, `wa_group_invite`, `wa_group_approvals`, `wa_group_leave` |
| Contacts | `wa_contacts`, `wa_contacts_allow`, `wa_contacts_clear`, `wa_phone_check`, `wa_peer_info`, `wa_block_user`, `wa_blocklist`, `wa_save_contact` |
| Account | `wa_profile`, `wa_profile_update`, `wa_profile_picture`, `wa_privacy_get`, `wa_privacy_set`, `wa_status_post` |
| Events | `wa_events` |

Sends are per recipient. The plugin adds no mass-messaging, scraping or
follower-growth surface.

## Bridge resolution

The plugin looks for the bridge in this order:

1. an explicit deployment: `bridgeDir` in the plugin config, or the
   `WA_WORKSPACE` environment variable. The directory may hold `bridge.mjs`
   directly, or a workspace that holds `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`.
2. the bridge bundled in this package: `bridge/bridge.mjs`.
3. a historical standalone deployment under `~/wa-agent` (`bridge.mjs` or
   `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`).

Set `bridgeDir` (or `WA_WORKSPACE`) to keep using a bridge you already run.
When it is set, it is authoritative: a missing file fails with
`WA_BRIDGE_MISSING` instead of silently starting the bundled bridge against a
different state directory. When it is not set, the bundled bridge is used, with
its runtime root at your home directory, so state lives in `~/wa-agent/`.

## Configuration

Every path is configurable; the defaults derive from your home directory. A
patch replaces the whole config of the line, so restate every key you want to
keep.

| Key | Environment | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bridgeDir` | `WA_WORKSPACE` | bundled bridge | bridge deployment directory; also the runtime root for state |
| `dataDir` | | `<root>/wa-agent/data` | WhatsApp auth-state directory override |
| `mediaDir` | | `<root>/wa-agent/media` | downloaded-media directory override |
| `httpPort` | | `29141` | loopback port for QR, health and RPC; `0` disables HTTP |
| `autoStart` | | `true` | spawn the bridge on demand and restart it after a crash |
| `rpcTimeoutMs` | | `120000` | per-RPC timeout |

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: wa-agent
  config:
    bridgeDir: '/absolute/path/to/wa-agent'
    httpPort: 29141
```

Use an absolute path in the config; `~` is not expanded by the harness. Leaving
`bridgeDir` out uses the bundled bridge.

The plugin adopts a bridge that is already listening on `httpPort` (for
example, one managed by a service) instead of spawning a duplicate. With
`autoStart: false`, start the bridge yourself before calling a tool:

```sh
WA_WORKSPACE="$HOME" WA_HTTP_PORT=29141 \
  node "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/wa-agent/bridge/bridge.mjs"
```

## Troubleshooting

- **`pnpm not found on PATH`** — `npm install -g pnpm`, then re-run the add
  command.
- **`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`** — pnpm ≥ 11 blocked the `baileys` preinstall
  and the `protobufjs` postinstall. Add the `allowBuilds` block shown in
  *Install* to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run the add command.
- **`WA_BRIDGE_MISSING`** — an explicit `bridgeDir`/`WA_WORKSPACE` does not
  contain `bridge.mjs` or `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`. The error lists the paths it
  tried. Unset it to use the bundled bridge.
- **No QR** — call `wa_status`. The bridge may still be connecting, or
  `httpPort` may be `0` (HTTP disabled).
- **Pairing rejected on the phone** — the announced WhatsApp Web version may be
  outdated. The bridge asks Baileys for the current version at every boot; if
  the link still fails, update the package and Baileys.
- **Plugin installed but no tools appear** — restart the harness; the bundle
  layer is read at boot.

## Security and limits

- **The WhatsApp session is a private key.** The bridge stores it in its data
  directory (`<root>/wa-agent/data`, `~/wa-agent/data` with the bundled
  bridge). Never commit it, paste it into a prompt, or copy it into a
  repository. This package ships the bridge code only: no session, no message
  store, no QR cache and no media.
- **The HTTP endpoint is loopback-only.** Do not expose `httpPort` to a
  network: anyone who reaches it can drive the account.
- **Baileys is an unoffic

plugins.description: DSH 回合提醒音乐插件：对话结束时自动播放音乐叫你回来，内置叮铃铃铃声，可自定义/上传音频并随时暂停
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-turn-music

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-turn-music?logo=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-turn-music)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-turn-music?color=blue)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> DeepSeek Harness 的**回合提醒音乐**：对话（回合）结束时自动响起音乐，把离开屏幕的你叫回来。内置电话「叮铃铃」铃声，可在设置里开关、改路径或直接上传音频，右下角浮标随时暂停。

> Turn-finished music reminder for DeepSeek Harness Web: a chime/ringtone (bundled telephone ring, or any local audio file, or an upload) plays when the agent finishes a turn, with an in-page chip to pause/dismiss.

---

## 它解决什么问题

Agent 跑长任务时你走开了，回来才发现它十分钟前就答完了。这个插件在**回合结束的那一刻**播放一段音乐，一直响到你点暂停；声音在浏览器里播，所以手机、笔记本、远程访问的页面都能听见。

```
回合开始 → （你走开）→ 回合结束 → 🔊 叮铃铃 + 右下角浮标「⏸ 暂停 / ✕」
```

## 特性

- **回合结束自动响**：监听会话状态（`running` 由 true 变 false），不依赖模型自我提醒，也不占用 API 调用。
- **设置里开关**：`设置 → 内置插件 → 回合提醒音乐`，同一张卡片也出现在左侧**插件**面板里。
- **自定义音乐**：填宿主机绝对路径（支持 `~`），或直接在卡片里**选文件上传**（远程访问也能用）。
- **内置默认铃声**：随包分发的电话「叮铃铃」（6.5 秒，52 KB，纯合成、CC0，见 `scripts/make-ringtone.py`），装完即响，不需要准备任何音频。
- **暂停 / 继续 / 关闭**：右下角浮标，点击暂停，再点继续，✕ 关掉这一次。
- **全局默认配置**：默认值可以写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（部署级），个人设置在设置页覆盖，所有会话、所有项目共用一份。
- **不吵人**：默认忽略子代理会话（子代理只是父对话的一步）；可选「只提醒当前正在看的会话」；默认响 120 秒自动停，可设 0 = 不限。
- **单文件、无构建**：host half 是普通 ESM，browser half 是 shell 模块表里的一份 CJS 风格 bundle，`npm i` 即用。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-turn-music
```

装完**重启一次 dsh web**（或在插件面板里触发一次重载），刷新页面即可。

从 GitHub 装（未发布到 npm 时的备用来源）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ramwin/dsh-turn-music
```

## 使用

1. 打开 `设置 → 内置插件 → 回合提醒音乐`（或左侧栏「插件」面板里的同名卡片）。
2. 「启用」默认已开；点**试听**确认音量和音源。
3. 想要自己的音乐：填路径，或点文件框选一个 mp3 上传。
4. 回合结束时音乐响起，右下角浮标可**暂停 / 继续 / 关闭**。

> **浏览器自动播放**：浏览器要求页面至少被点过一次才允许出声。你正常用 GUI 打字/点按钮就已经满足；如果第一时间没声音，浮标会显示「浏览器拦截了自动播放，点一下播放」，点它即可。

### 设置项

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 启用 | 开 | 回合结束时是否播放 |
| 音乐文件 | 空 | 留空 = 内置叮铃铃；填 `~` 或绝对路径；也可上传 |
| 音量 | 80 | 0–100，只影响本插件的播放 |
| 循环播放 | 开 | 一直响到你手动暂停/关闭（关掉则播完一遍就停） |
| 最长响多久 | 120 秒 | 循环时的安全上限，0 = 不限 |
| 只提醒当前会话 | 关 | 开：只对屏幕上正在看的会话响 |
| 忽略子代理会话 | 开 | 子代理的回合结束不响 |

设置存在 `~/.dsh/turn-music.json`（全局，不分项目/会话）；上传的音频存在 `~/.dsh/turn-music/`。

### 部署级默认值（全局）

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给插件条目写 `config`，它成为**默认值**（个人设置仍可覆盖，「恢复默认」回到这里）：

```yaml
- id: turn-music
  name: 'dsh-turn-music'
  config:
    enabled: true
    file: /srv/sounds/ring.mp3
    volume: 80
    loop: true
    maxSeconds: 120
    onlyCurrent: false
    muteSubagent: true
```

## 工作原理

```
浏览器                                    宿主进程
────────────────────────────────────      ─────────────────────────────
sessions.list 快照
  running: true → false  ──┐
                           ├─► <audio src=/dsh-turn-music/audio>
GET /dsh-turn-music/config ┘                 ├─ 读 ~/.dsh/turn-music.json
POST /dsh-turn-music/config ────────────────►├─ 校验并落盘
POST /dsh-turn-music/upload ────────────────►└─ 存 ~/.dsh/turn-music/ringtone.*
```

- **为什么触发在浏览器**：回合结束这个「边界」只有页面能看见（`sessions.list` 是客户端会话列表 store，每行带 `running`）；也只有页面能把声音放出来。宿主进程在服务器上，没有扬声器。
- **为什么要宿主 half**：浏览器读不到宿主机的绝对路径。音频由宿主经 HTTP 流式下发（支持 `Range`），所以远程打开页面、甚至手机访问，都能播出本机上的那个文件。
- **不回放历史**：页面打开时的第一份快照只做基线，已经在跑的会话不会因为刷新就误响。

## 常见问题

**没声音？** 先看浮标：显示「浏览器拦截了自动播放」就点一下；否则检查设置里的音量与「启用」，以及文件路径是否还存在（宿主会自动回退到内置铃声）。

**多个标签页同时开着？** 每个页面都会响一次。需要单窗口行为的话，关掉其他标签页即可（这点与音乐播放器不同，后续可按需加跨窗口去重）。

**刷新/重启后设置还在吗？** 在。设置在宿主侧 `~/.dsh/turn-music.json`，不依赖浏览器 localStorage。

**能不能播放网络音频？** 目前只支持本机文件与上传。在线电台/音乐建议配 `dsh-music-player`。

**安全边界**：`/dsh-turn-music/*` 走 dsh 自己的登录态；能读到的只是被配置的那一个音频文件（或上传目录），不做任意路径列举。

## 开发与验证

```sh
npm test          # host 侧校验逻辑 + 浏览器侧回合检测逻辑（无 jsdom）
```

需要一个**独立实例**做端到端验证（会真的跑一轮模型回复，别对着正在用的宿主跑）：

```sh
dsh web --port 3099 --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 > /tmp/boot.log 2>&1 &
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]*' /tmp/boot.log | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
node scripts/verify-browser.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3099/?token=$TOKEN"   # 客户端 half 是否加载、浮标是否创建
node scripts/verify-turn.mjs    "http://127.0.0.1:3099/?token=$TOKEN"   # 真发一条消息，等回合结束，断言浮标亮起+暂停可用
```

重新生成内置铃声（需要 ffmpeg）：

```sh
python3 scripts/make-ringtone.py assets/ringtone.mp3
```

## 许可

MIT。内置铃声由 `scripts/make-ringtone.py` 纯数学合成，不涉第三方素材，随包按 CC0 使用。

plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, theme-aware, fullscreen zoom viewer
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mermaid-plus

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mermaid-plus.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mermaid-plus)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-mermaid-plus.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-4b5563)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)
[![install](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh%20plugin%20add-dsh--mermaid--plus-5b8def)](#install)

Mermaid diagrams for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) — rendered **on demand** by default, so a transcript full of diagrams costs nothing until you ask for one.

[中文说明](#中文说明)

---

## Screenshots

On demand, in a light theme — the source stays until you press **Diagram**:

![A mermaid card showing its source and a Diagram button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/card.png)

Fullscreen viewer, light and dark. The sheet takes the palette the diagram was rendered for, so labels stay readable in both themes:

![Fullscreen mermaid viewer on a light sheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/viewer-light.png)

![Fullscreen mermaid viewer on a dark sheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/viewer-dark.png)

## What it does

A fenced ` ```mermaid ` block in the conversation (or in a Markdown file preview) becomes a card:

- **On demand (default)** — the source stays visible and a `Diagram` button waits in the card header. The 3.5 MB Mermaid runtime is **not downloaded** and no layout work happens until you press it.
- **When visible** — a diagram renders the first time its card scrolls into view.
- **Always** — renders as soon as the block appears (the classic behaviour).

Every rendered diagram can be opened **fullscreen** with zoom and pan, which is the point: a wide flowchart squeezed into the message column is unreadable, while the same diagram at natural size is fine.

## Features

- Renders `mermaid`, `mermaidjs`, `mmd` and unlabelled blocks that start with a diagram keyword.
- Supports the diagram types the bundled Mermaid build ships: `flowchart`/`graph`, `sequenceDiagram`, `classDiagram`, `stateDiagram`, `erDiagram`, `gantt`, `pie`, `mindmap`, `journey`, `timeline`, `quadrantChart`, `xychart`, `gitGraph`, `requirementDiagram`, `C4`, `block-beta`, `packet-beta`, `sankey-beta`, `kanban`, `architecture-beta`, and more.
- **Theme-aware**: diagram colours are derived from the app's live design tokens, and a palette change re-renders only the diagrams you are looking at.
- **Streaming-safe**: a block is handed to Mermaid only after its source settles, so a half-written fence never flashes a parse error.
- **Cached**: a rendered diagram is kept by source + palette, so switching between Code and Diagram, or reopening the viewer, costs nothing.
- **Fullscreen viewer**: wheel zoom, drag to pan, double-click to fit, `Esc` to close, focus-trapped dialog, restores focus and page scrolling.
- Falls back to the visible source with a short error line when a diagram does not parse.
- Unmounting restores every code block to its original place in the transcript.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-mermaid-plus
```

Or install it from a catalog in **Settings → Plugins → Marketplace** (see the [DSH 1024Store](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins) listing). Restart the app or reload the page afterwards.

The Mermaid runtime is **bundled** with the package (`vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs`, Mermaid 11.17.0) and served from the plugin's own Host route, so rendering works offline and no CDN is contacted. The fullscreen viewer and card never send diagram source anywhere.

## Settings

**Settings → General → Mermaid diagrams** offers the three modes. The choice is stored per page origin and is namespaced by package name, so it never collides with another diagram plugin.

## Compatibility

- Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (Desktop `2.0.17-next`).
- DSH is a developer preview: client plugin contracts, slot keys, and rendered Markdown can change between releases. This plugin decorates the rendered `<pre><code>` output, which is the part most likely to shift; if a release breaks it, the cards simply stop appearing and the code blocks stay intact.
- Requires a browser or Electron renderer with `IntersectionObserver` (used only in "when visible" mode) and `DOMParser`.

## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`) mounts one prefix route that serves the vendored Mermaid ES module. The route is derived from the package name (`/x-dsh-mermaid-plus`), so two diagram plugins can coexist.
- **Browser half** (`client.js`) is a normal DSH client bundle: it registers a root-scoped occupant on `shell.overlay` (which exists before any session), plus a status row and the settings row. It never imports Harness client packages and never touches the model's context.
- Because the shipped Markdown renderer exposes no code-block extension point, the browser half decorates the rendered output: it moves a mermaid `<pre>` into a card it owns, and puts it back on unmount. The original DOM node is preserved, so the transcript, copy, and select all keep working.

## Troubleshooting

The browser half reports lifecycle events to its Host half, which appends them to a bounded log:

```
<os tmp>/dsh-mermaid-plus/report.json
```

It records lifecycle events only — `start`, `apply-ok`, `apply-throw`, `adopted`, `render-ok`, `render-error`, `blocks-unmatched` — with counts, not document text: no diagram source, no file contents, no paths beyond the plugin's own. If diagrams stop appearing, that file plus the browser console (a failed import) usually identifies the cause.

## Development

The plugin has no build step for its own code: `index.js` and `client.js` run as they are. Only `vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs` is generated, and only when the bundled Mermaid version changes.

```sh
npm install                 # mermaid 11.17.0, esbuild, jsdom
node build.mjs              # rebuild vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs
node test/run.mjs           # host route, real cordis mount, jsdom browser-half behaviour
node test/serve-e2e.mjs     # then open http://127.0.0.1:8732/ for 35 real-browser cases
node tools/doctor.mjs       # activation, install mode, last browser events
node tools/dev-sync.mjs     # copy this checkout over an npm-installed copy
```

[`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md) covers the debug loop, what each symptom means, and the release flow.

## License

MIT. Bundled Mermaid is MIT; see `vendor/mermaid.LICENSE`.

---

## 中文说明

把对话（以及 Markdown 预览）里的 ` ```mermaid ` 代码块渲染成图表卡片。

**默认按需渲染**：代码块保持源码可见，卡片右上角有一个「图形」按钮；在你点它之前，Mermaid 那个约 3.5 MB 的运行时不会被下载，也不做任何布局计算。另外两种模式是「滚动可见」（卡片进入视口才渲染）和「立即」（出现即渲染）。

渲染后的图表可以**全屏放大**：滚轮缩放、拖动平移、双击适应窗口、`Esc` 关闭；全屏只克隆已有 SVG，不会重新渲染。

其他特性：

- 配色取自应用当前的 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌，明暗主题各自适配；主题切换只重绘你正在看的图。
- 流式输出期间不会渲染半截源码。
- 渲染结果按「配色 + 源码」缓存，切换「代码/图形」或重开全屏都是零成本。
- 解析失败时保留源码并给一行错误提示。
- 卸载时把每个代码块放回原位，不破坏对话内容。

模式开关在 **设置 → 通用 → Mermaid 图表**。Mermaid 运行时随包内置（11.17.0），由插件自己的 Host 路由提供，**不访问 CDN、离线可用**，图表源码不会发往任何地方。

兼容 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。DSH 处于开发者预览阶段，客户端插件契约可能变化；本插件装饰渲染后的 `<pre><code>`，是最容易受影响的一层——若某次升级后卡片不再出现，代码块本身仍然完好。

排障：浏览器半侧会把生命周期事件报告给 Host，写入 `<系统临时目录>/dsh-mermaid-plus/report.json`（`start` / `adopted` / `render-ok` / `render-error` / `apply-ok` / `apply-throw`）。

plugins.readme_text:
# AI 短剧工作区 · `dsh-plugin-ai-drama`

[![test](https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-6f42c1)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把 AI 短剧的 **立项 → 总纲 → 人物 → 世界观 → 剧本 → 分镜 → 导出** 收进侧栏工作区，
> 并附带「短剧模式」Agent 预设——**34 个 `drama_*` 工具**、**9 个随包技能**、`/drama` 斜杠命令，
> 以及与 LibTV / NeoWoW 画布 CLI 对接的生成编排适配层。

> English: An AI short-drama workspace plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
> It ships a sidebar + main-panel workspace for the full short-drama pipeline, a dedicated `drama` agent preset
> with 34 agent tools and 9 bundled skills, a `/drama` slash command, and an adapter layer that drives external
> canvas CLIs (LibTV / NeoWoW) for image / video / voice generation. UI and docs are in Chinese.

---

## 它解决什么问题

写一部短剧，真正麻烦的不是「让模型写一段」，而是**让几十集内容彼此一致、可查、可交付**：
人物设定散在聊天记录里、伏笔写完就忘、分镜表和剧本对不上、改一集要翻十处、导出还要手工拼。

这个插件把短剧创作当成一个有状态的项目来做：

- **单一事实源**：结构化数据落在 `.aidrama/*.json`，`.md` 由它渲染，避免「两边同时改」的双写冲突；
- **落盘可恢复**：所有写入走「临时文件 → rename」原子替换，覆盖前留 `history/` 快照；
- **确定性检查**：一致性检查（人物/时间线/场景/道具等 7 类规则）不依赖模型，随时可跑；
- **生成物先入草稿区**：AI 产出先进草稿，用户采纳后才进正式稿；
- **生成编排不内建生成能力**：出图/出视频/出配音交给外部画布 CLI，插件只做适配、编排、回流与预算护栏。

## 能力一览

| 模块 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| 工作区 | 侧栏「AI 短剧」入口 + 中央面板（14 个页签），不遮蔽内置工作区浏览器，可与其它工作区插件共存 |
| 项目 | 新建 / 打开 / 重命名 / 删除；固定中文目录结构；全文检索；目录树子节点展开折叠并持久化 |
| 内容 | 剧集契约、分集总纲、人物设定卡、世界观、分集剧本、分镜表、本剧记忆（伏笔/已用桥段/时间线/待回收） |
| AI 能力 | 34 个 `drama_*` Agent 工具（仅在「短剧模式」会话注册）；检索增强；一致性检查；草稿区与采纳/丢弃 |
| 预设 | 「短剧模式」Agent 预设：短剧编剧/制片/分镜导演/合规顾问人格，**移除 shell 类工具**（工具白名单） |
| 技能 | 9 个随包技能：立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜、导演/镜头语言、润色、审读、导出 |
| 命令 | `/drama`（项目 / 进度 / 检查 / 草稿 / 导出 / 定稿 / 大纲 / 人物 / 世界观 / 剧本 / 分镜 / 润色） |
| 交付 | 导出 Markdown 全本 / JSON 结构化包 / CSV 拍摄用分镜表（UTF-8 with BOM）；定稿快照与回滚 |
| 生成（可选） | LibTV（主选）/ NeoWoW（备选）CLI 适配：规划 → 提交 → 收敛三段式；预算台账与闸门；产物回流登记 sha256 |

## 安装

要求：

- **DeepSeek Harness ≥ `0.2.0-rc.2`**（`engines.dsh` 会校验；桌面端与 npm 版 `dsh` 均可）
- **Node.js `^22.19.0 || ^24.0.0`**
- Web 界面（插件含客户端半，需要 `dsh web` / 桌面端的 Web 面）

插件是**纯 JavaScript、无构建步骤**（不需要 `prepare` / `allowBuilds`），三种安装方式任选。

### 方式一：直接从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama#v0.6.3
```

`<profile>` 换成你的 profile 名（`dsh web` 对应 `web`，桌面端通常是 `desktop`）。首次使用 `dsh plugin` 会自动创建 profile。

### 方式二：从 GitHub Release 的预打包 tarball 安装

```sh
curl -L -o dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz \
  https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/releases/latest/download/dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz
```

### 方式三：本地开发目录

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-plugin-ai-drama
```

### 验证安装

```sh
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config    # 应出现 "# == dsh-plugin-ai-drama" 层
```

重启 DSH（或桌面端）后，侧栏出现 **「AI 短剧」** 图标；新建会话时预设选择器里出现 **「短剧模式」**。

> 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-plugin-ai-drama`。卸载**不会删除**你工作区里的 `AI短剧/` 数据。

## 快速开始

1. 重启后新建一个会话，在预设选择器里选 **「短剧模式」**；
2. 点侧栏「AI 短剧」→ 新建项目，输入剧名（会生成固定目录结构）；
3. 用对话驱动，或直接敲斜杠命令：

```text
/drama 大纲 都市悬疑，12 集，每集 90 秒，强钩子
/drama 人物 补全主角与反派，给出形象提示词
/drama 进度                  # 看当前阶段与关键事实
/drama 检查                  # 跑一致性检查，直接返回问题清单
/drama 草稿                  # 查看待处理的 AI 草稿
/drama 导出 csv              # 导出拍摄用分镜表
/drama 定稿 3                # 冻结第 3 集剧本与分镜为快照，可回滚
```

4. 在面板里可以逐页编辑：总纲 / 人物 / 世界观 / 剧本 / 分镜 / 记忆 / 草稿 / 定稿 / 账本 / 导出等。

## 「短剧模式」预设

预设以 Cordis YAML 声明（`presets/drama.patch.yml`），基于 DSH 随包标准预设改写：

- persona 换成短剧编剧 / 制片 / 分镜导演 / 合规顾问；
- **去掉 shell 命令类工具**（工具白名单）；
- 收敛子代理编排组，工具面聚焦创作；
- 追加隔离服务插件 `dsh-plugin-ai-drama/preset`：在该预设作用域内标记 `dramaMode`，
  主插件据此**只对处于短剧模式的 Agent** 注册 `drama_*` 工具，预设计未启用时工具不出现，切走自动回收。

预设同时通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` 的 `bundledSkillDir` 随包挂载 `skills/`，
所以「短剧模式」会话里 9 个技能自动可用。

## `drama_*` 工具（34 个）

| 分组 | 工具 |
|---|---|
| 项目 | `drama_list_projects` / `drama_create_project` / `drama_get_project` |
| 写入 | `drama_save_contract` / `drama_save_outline` / `drama_save_characters` / `drama_save_world` / `drama_read_episode` |
| 检索与上下文 | `drama_search_context` / `drama_get_progress` / `drama_save_memory` |
| 台词与素材 | `drama_get_dialogue` / `drama_export_voice_script` / `drama_list_assets` / `drama_add_asset` |
| 定稿与账本 | `drama_finalize_episode` / `drama_list_finalized` / `drama_get_ledger` |
| 导入与草稿 | `drama_import_script` / `drama_save_draft` / `drama_list_drafts` / `drama_resolve_draft` |
| 质检与导出 | `drama_check_consistency` / `drama_export` |
| 生成编排（阶段二） | 规划 / 提交 / 收敛 / 预算 / 绑定相关工具（`lib/tools.js`） |

工具全部是**确定性实现**（读写文件、结构化校验、检索、渲染），生成类操作交给 Agent 调用模型，
插件只负责把结果安全落盘。

## 随包技能（9 个）

`drama-setup`（立项）、`drama-outline`（总纲）、`drama-characters`（人物）、`drama-episode`（剧本）、
`drama-storyboard`（分镜）、`drama-director`（导演 / 镜头语言）、`drama-polish`（润色）、
`drama-review`（审读）、`drama-export`（导出）。

## 斜杠命令 `/drama`

| 输入 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `/drama` | 用法 + 当前工作区项目与进度 |
| `/drama 项目` | 列出短剧项目 |
| `/drama 进度 [剧名]` | 阶段与关键事实 |
| `/drama 检查 [剧名]` | 一致性检查，直接返回问题清单 |
| `/drama 草稿 [剧名]` | 待处理草稿 |
| `/drama 导出 <markdown\|json\|csv> [剧名]` | 导出交付物 |
| `/drama 定稿 <集数> [剧名]` | 定稿某一集 |
| `/drama 大纲\|人物\|世界观\|剧本\|分镜\|润色 [要求]` | 交给 Agent 生成（会产生一次模型回复） |

两条纪律：**只在「短剧模式」会话生效**（其它会话返回明确错误）；**确定性操作不产生模型轮次**。

## 数据落盘

在会话工作区下：

```text
<工作区>/AI短剧/
  <短剧名>/
    剧集契约.md                 ← 由 .aidrama/contract.json 渲染
    总纲/分集大纲.md            ← 由 .aidrama/outline.json 渲染
    人物/人物设定卡.md          ← 由 .aidrama/characters.json 渲染
    分集剧本/第001集.md         ← 剧本正文（可直接编辑）
    分镜/第001集.分镜.md        ← 由 .aidrama/storyboard/ 渲染
    构想/ 世界观/ 台词与音效/ 素材/ 草稿区/ 定稿/ 账本/ 本剧记忆/ 导出/
    .aidrama/                   ← 机读源数据 + history/ 历史快照
  共享资料/                     ← 跨项目共享资料
```

结构化数据以 `.aidrama/*.json` 为唯一事实源；可见的 `.md` 由它渲染，**不存在双写**。
所有写入原子替换，覆盖前留 `history/` 快照（保留最近 20 份）。

## 生成能力对接（可选）

插件**不内建**图片 / 视频 / 配音生成，而是适配外部画布 CLI：

| | LibTV（主选） | NeoWoW（备选） |
|---|---|---|
| 形态 | 本地 CLI `libtv` 子进程 | 本地 CLI `neowow` 子进程 |
| 登录 | CLI 内完成 | API Key |
| 能力 | 画布 / 节点 / 上传 / 生成 / 下载 | 画布 / 节点 / 生成 / 轮询 |

统一接口 `available(ctx)` / `catalog(kind)` / `estimate(input)`，业务代码不认具体平台；
主选不可用时自动降级到备选。

生成编排拆成三段（避免长任务把一次请求挂住）：

1. **规划** `planEpisode()`：由分镜确定性构造逐镜提示词，不产生副作用；
2. **提交** `submitBatch()`：可部分失败，单镜失败不影响其余；
3. **收敛** `collectBatch()`：可反复调用，直到产物全部回流到 `素材/生成/` 并登记 sha256、来源、任务 id。

护栏：

- **预算台账** `.aidrama/budget.json` + 闸门，同一任务只计费一次；
- **上游冲突保护**：绑定检查 + 写入前指纹 + 写入后漂移判定；
- **双主防护**：以项目分镜为唯一事实源，按镜号对账画布节点，只报告差异、不自动改画布；
- **不假装**：账号状态来自 CLI 实测，产物状态必须见到真实文件。

## 架构

```text
dsh-plugin-ai-drama/
  package.json            # dsh.manifestVersion / dsh.bundle.patch[2] / dsh.client
  cordis.patch.yml        # 把主插件插入组合树
  index.js                # 宿主半：68 个 POST /api/ai-drama/<method> 路由 + 工具白名单挂载 + /drama
  preset.js               # 预设伴生入口：provide('dramaMode') + 挂载随包技能
  presets/drama.patch.yml # 「短剧模式」Agent 预设声明
  lib/store.js            # 项目仓储：原子写入、快照、结构化文档、检索、条目管理
  lib/drafts.js           # 草稿区：生成物先入库，采纳后进正式稿
  lib/consistency.js      # 一致性检查（确定性规则）
  lib/retrieval.js        # 本地词法检索（中文单字 + 二元组 + BM25 风格打分）
  lib/tools.js            # drama_* Agent 工具
  lib/backends/           # LibTV / NeoWoW CLI 适配层
  lib/generation.js       # 任务台账 / 预算台账与闸门 / 产物回流
  lib/guard.js            # 上游冲突保护与双主防护
  lib/orchestrator.js     # 生成编排：规划 → 提交 → 收敛
  lib/exporter.js         # 导出 Markdown / JSON / CSV
  skills/drama-*/SKILL.md # 9 个随包技能
  client.js               # 客户端半：侧栏入口 + 14 页签面板
  test/                   # 21 个测试套件，纯 Node 运行，无外部依赖
```

宿主半提供 `POST /api/ai-drama/<method>` 精确路由（请求头 `x-ai-drama-request: 1`），
客户端半只用浏览器模块表提供的 React，不引入额外运行时依赖。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check preset.js
npm test          # 21 个套件
```

测试全部是纯 Node 脚本，使用假 CLI / 假 React，**不需要 API Key、不消耗任何生成积分**。
其中「旧数据不变性」类断言在没有本地样例数据时会自动 SKIP，不影响公共 CI。

CI：GitHub Actions 上跑 Node 22 / 24 × Windows / Ubuntu 组合（见 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`）。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上（`0.2.x` 线）；
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || ^24.0.0`；
- 宿主半跨平台；主要开发/验证环境为 Windows 11 + Node 24（

plugins.description: DSH plugin: sync model-catalog reasoning levels (reasoningEfforts) from what the provider advertises on /v1/models — sync_reasoning_levels tool plus a one-click button in the Models settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-sync

把 **DSH 模型目录里的推理等级**与**供应商实际声明的能力**对齐。

> 宣传页：**https://dc1024.github.io/dsh-effort-sync/**（源码在 `docs/`）

两个入口，共用同一段逻辑：

- **设置界面 → 模型** 页尾部的「**同步推理等级**」按钮 —— 点一下就把供应商公布的等级补齐（本文档新增）。
- **工具 `sync_reasoning_levels`** —— 给 agent 用，默认 dry-run。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 自己做不到这件事，原因是契约缺一个槽位：

- **发现契约没有推理字段**：`LlmDiscoveredModel = { id, name?, contextWindow?, maxTokens?, inputModalities? }`
  —— 所以即使供应商在 `/v1/models` 里报了能力，DSH 也搬不进来。
- **推理能力只有一条入口**：`LlmResolvedModelInfo.reasoning`，而它来自适配器自报或目录声明
  （`reasoningEfforts`）。
- 结果：像 **magpie** 这样已经提供 `supported_reasoning_levels` 的网关，在界面上加完模型后，模型选择器里依然没有思考强度可选。

本插件读上游、写目录，补上这一段。写回走的是 `configEditor` —— **和设置界面同一条正规路径**。

## 界面按钮

座位是官方声明的加性扩展点 `settings.models.footer`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models`
声明），**不覆盖任何自带 UI**。按钮的工作流：

1. 读取每个往 `providers` 里声明的供应商（含手写 patch 层里的）；
2. 用 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取密钥，请求 `<baseURL>/models`；
3. 把两边都有、而目录里还缺的等级写回 `reasoningEfforts`；
4. 在按钮下方直接列出**写了哪些模型、从什么变到什么**、以及哪些值被跳过。

一个供应商读不通只会被单独报告，不会挡住其它供应商的写入。

> 客户端插件（`dsh.client`）**需要重启 DSH 才会挂载**；host 半边的改动是热加载的。配置写入本身即时生效。

## 工具用法

```
用 sync_reasoning_levels 看看会改什么         # dryRun 默认 true，只报告差异
用 sync_reasoning_levels 应用（dryRun=false）  # 真正写回配置
```

参数：

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | 全部 | 要同步的 provider key（如 `magpie`）；不传则同步所有声明的供应商 |
| `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告差异，不写（**界面按钮相反：点击即写**） |
| `noneMapsToOff` | `false` | 是否把上游的 `none` 档映射成 DSH 的 `off`（**按上游而异，默认不猜**） |
| `only` | 全部 | 只同步指定的模型 id |
| `replace` | `false` | 用上游列表**替换**声明（默认是加性合并；替换有掉档风险，见下） |

## 安全设计

1. **默认不写**：工具 `dryRun` 默认 true；界面按钮是显式点击，写完把差异回报给你。
2. **只写 DSH 认识的等级**：词表固定 `off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max`；上游多出来的值（如 `none`）只报告、不猜。
3. **保留既有 wire 拼写**：已存在的映射（如 `max: ultra`）不会被覆盖 —— 与设置界面同一规则。
4. **不动上游没广告的模型**：查不到的模型原样跳过，并在报告里说明。
5. **加性优先**：中转网关公布的档位常是上游能力的**保守子集**（实测 magpie 对某模型只报 low/high/max，而上游六档全收），所以默认只增不减；`replace` 需显式开启。
6. **不碰凭据**：只经 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取值，不落盘、不打印。
7. **不整块改写供应商**：只写 `models` 这一项，并且是从**有效配置**（含下层）+ 本层已有内容重建的，不会把下层手写的 `apiKeyEnv`/`baseURL` 变成空值，也不会丢模型。

## 两个已知边界

- **`reasoning: false` 不代劳**：若上游对某模型标 `reasoning: false`，插件**不会**替你写 `reasoningEfforts: false`
  （那会让选择器消失，属于行为变更）。它只在报告里提示你手工决定。
- **`none` 档不猜**：见 `noneMapsToOff`。

## 自测

`node rehearsal.mjs` 用假 ctx + 假上游跑全流程（真实 HTTP 走的是本插件自己的路由），断言覆盖：

- dry-run 只算差异、**零写入**；
- 应用后写入的模型表**结构与拼写**（保留 `max: ultra`、新档用同一性拼写、不动无关模型）；
- 幂等（第二次点击无改动、无冗余写入）；
- 单个供应商读不通 / 缺密钥 / 无模型 / 未知 provider / 非 POST 请求的错误路径。

宣传页另有一条渲染自检（防止首屏空白与横向溢出这两类老坑）：

```bash
node tools/verify-site-chrome.mjs   # 无头 Chromium 直接经 CDP 驱动，输出截图与量测
```

它用 DevTools 协议量 `scrollWidth` / 元素可见性 / 溢出元素，桌面与移动各出一张全页截图，报告写在 `.verify/`。

## 安装

```bash
pnpm pack        # 产出 dsh-effort-sync-<version>.tgz
```

然后在 DSH：**设置 → 插件** → 安装 tarball（或 `plugin_manager install_bundle <tarball>`），**重启 DSH**。

> 升级务必 bump 版本号：DSH 按 generation 路径缓存已加载的 ESM。

## 改动记录

| 版本 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0 | 加界面按钮（client 半 + `settings.models.footer`）、`POST /dsh-effort-sync/sync`、逐供应商报告与容错、`replace` 选项、离线 rehearsal 与 `tools/pack.mjs` |
| 0.1.2 | 加性合并（只增不减）、多供应商同步、`tools/` 探针 |
| 0.1.1 | 保留既有 wire 拼写、跳过未知等级 |
| 0.1.0 | 首个版本：`sync_reasoning_levels` 工具，默认 dry-run |

## License

MIT

# dsh-agnes-tools

**Agnes AI image & video generation as native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) tools.**

`agnes_image` · `agnes_edit_image` · `agnes_video` · `agnes_video_status` · `agnes_models`

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

---

## English

A small, tool-only plugin: it adds five tools to the agent and nothing else — no UI panel,
no settings page, no runtime dependencies beyond the Schemastery peer DSH already ships.

### Why this one

Five Agnes plugins already exist, so here is the honest difference:

- **Video jobs are resumable.** `agnes_video` submits, polls, and downloads — but when the
  in-call wait runs out it returns the `video_id` instead of losing the job. `agnes_video_status`
  picks it up later and downloads the mp4. On a queue that is regularly full
  (`503 video_queue_full`), that is the difference between a lost render and a finished one.
- **`agnes_models`** lists the models your key can actually reach, so you can tell a bad key
  from a bad model name in one call.
- **Free-tier aware.** Retries with backoff on `503`/`429`, 6 s polling to stay under 20 RPM,
  and tolerance for the ~20 s window after submission where a status query wrongly reports 404.
- **Tool-only, zero runtime deps.** If you work in the chat and do not want a floating panel.

### Install

From the DSH plugin market, once listed — then restart `dsh web`.

<details>
<summary>Manual install (verified on Windows)</summary>

Add the package to your web profile and register it as a bundle:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/path/to/dsh-agnes-tools"   // or: "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Host-side plugins are loaded at startup — there is no hot reload.

> Two traps worth knowing: `dsh plugin --profile web install` can answer *"Already up to date"*
> without installing anything, so run `pnpm install` in the profile yourself. And the hoisted
> linker **copies** `file:` dependencies, so re-run `pnpm install` after editing the source.

</details>

### Configure

`cordis.patch.yml` holds the defaults; override any key in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` or plugin settings.

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | Name of the DSH credential holding your key. Recommended. |
| `apiKey` | *(empty)* | Inline key. Takes precedence over `apiKeyRef`. Not recommended. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | Mainland endpoint. International: `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1`. |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | Absolute, or relative to the `dsh` process working directory. |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | How long `agnes_video` waits inside a single tool call. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | Do not lower it: the free tier allows 20 requests/minute. |

The key is resolved in this order: `apiKey` → the DSH credential named by `apiKeyRef` →
`process.env[apiKeyRef]`.

### Tools

| Tool | Required | Optional |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio` (1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9), `size` (1K/2K/3K/4K), `save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`, `images` | `ratio`, `size`, `save_path` — `images` accepts local absolute paths, public URLs, or data URIs |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds` (`"4"`–`"12"`, default `"5"`), `aspect_ratio`, `mode` (`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`), `first_frame`, `last_frame`, `images` (≤5), `save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

Files land in `outputDir` as `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`.
Generated images are also attached to the reply when the host supports attachments.

### API quirks the code already handles

1. **`size` is a tier, not a pixel size.** Agnes takes `1K/2K/3K/4K` plus `ratio` — not `1024x768`.
2. **Images must come back as base64.** On the international endpoint the returned image URL
   lives on `storage.googleapis.com`, which is unreachable from mainland China. The plugin always
   asks for base64 instead.
3. **The video queue is often full** — `503 video_queue_full`. Retried with backoff (up to 6
   attempts, 8 s → 30 s).
4. **A status query within ~20 s of submission reports 404 "task not found".** The poll loop
   tolerates it.
5. **The free tier allows 20 requests/minute**; exceeding it returns 429. Hence the 6 s interval.
6. **Video size is always `"720P"`**; the real pixel size follows `aspect_ratio`
   (16:9 → 1280x704).

### Development

```bash
npm install && npm test        # loads the plugin with a mock context and checks every tool
```

Add `node_modules` to your profile and point `dsh-agnes-tools` at your checkout to iterate.

## 中文

把 **Agnes AI** 的生图 / 生视频接成 DeepSeek Harness 的原生工具，一共 5 个，
纯工具型：没有悬浮面板、没有设置页，除 DSH 自带的 Schemastery 外没有运行时依赖。

### 和已有的 Agnes 插件有什么不一样

Agnes 生图生视频的插件市面上已经有 5 个，所以这里只说真实差异：

- **长视频任务可以续查。** `agnes_video` 会一次调用内提交 + 轮询 + 下载；但等待超时后它
  返回 `video_id` 而不是把任务丢掉，之后用 `agnes_video_status` 接着查、完成后自动下载 mp4。
  视频队列经常满（`503 video_queue_full`），这条差异决定了你是白等一场还是拿到成片。
- **`agnes_models`** 列出当前 Key 真能访问的模型，一次调用区分「Key 不对」还是「模型名不对」。
- **为免费额度调过参。** `503`/`429` 退避重试、6 秒轮询卡在 20 RPM 以内、
  容忍提交后约 20 秒内状态查询误报 404。
- **纯工具、零运行时依赖。** 如果你就在对话里干活、不需要悬浮面板，这个更干净。

### 安装

插件市场上架后可直接安装，装完**重启 `dsh web`**。

<details>
<summary>手动安装（Windows 上已实测）</summary>

在 web profile 里登记依赖和 bundle：

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/你的路径/dsh-agnes-tools"   // 或 "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。host 侧插件在启动时装载，没有热加载。

> 两个坑：① `dsh plugin --profile web install` 可能回一句 “Already up to date” 却什么也没装，
> 直接进 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install` 更可靠；② hoisted linker 下 `file:` 依赖是**复制**不是软链，
> 改完源码要重跑 `pnpm install`。

</details>

### 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里写的是默认值，可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 或插件设置里覆盖。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | DSH 凭据里的引用名，推荐 |
| `apiKey` | 空 | 直接写 Key，优先级高于 `apiKeyRef`，不建议 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | 国内节点；国际站是 `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1` |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | 绝对路径，或相对 dsh 进程的 cwd |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 单次工具调用内最长等待 |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | 别调小：免费 Key 只有 20 RPM |

Key 的解析顺序：`apiKey` → `apiKeyRef` 指向的 DSH 凭据 → `process.env[apiKeyRef]`。

### 工具

| 工具 | 必填 | 选填 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio`（1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 3:2 / 2:3 / 21:9）、`size`（1K/2K/3K/4K）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`、`images` | `ratio`、`size`、`save_path`；`images` 支持本地绝对路径、公网 URL、data URI，可多张 |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds`（`"4"`–`"12"`，默认 `"5"`）、`aspect_ratio`、`mode`（`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`）、`first_frame`、`last_frame`、`images`（≤5）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

产物落在 `outputDir`，文件名形如 `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`；生成的图片在宿主支持时会一并作为附件回复。

### 代码里已经处理掉的 API 怪癖

1. **`size` 是档位不是像素**：Agnes 收 `1K/2K/3K/4K` + `ratio`，不是 `1024x768`。
2. **图片必须按 base64 取回**：国际站返回的图片 URL 在 `storage.googleapis.com`（国内不通），
   插件一律请求 base64，不依赖那个域名。
3. **视频队列经常满**（`503 video_queue_full`）：内置退避重试，最多 6 次，8 秒 → 30 秒递增。
4. **提交后约 20 秒内查询会误报 404**「任务不存在」：轮询循环里已容忍。
5. **免费 Key 20 RPM**，超了报 429，所以轮询间隔设成 6 秒。
6. **视频尺寸固定 `"720P"`**，实际像素由 `aspect_ratio` 决定（16:9 → 1280x704）。

### 开发

```bash
npm install && npm test        # 用 mock context 加载插件，逐个校验注册出来的工具
```

plugins.description: D友の酒 · Dyou Wine：让 DSH 界面和鲸鱼娘玩偶按固定节奏 Q 弹，支持满屏飞行、碰墙反弹与内置 BGM。
plugins.readme_text:
# D友の酒 · Dyou Wine **代码在跑，大肥鱼娘也在跑。** 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 加一点快乐：界面按固定节奏 Q 弹，蓝白鲸鱼娘毛绒玩偶满屏巡航，碰到墙就弹回来。两个效果独立开关，也能一起蹦。 默认清醒。点「开喝」开始整活，按 `Escape` 随时醒酒。 `0.1.0-alpha.14` · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dyou-wine/v/0.1.0-alpha.14) · [测试记录](docs/TESTING.md) · [兼容矩阵](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) > **给作者续一杯 · [鸽子中转站](https://api.doveli.top/)**
> OpenAI 兼容 API，给常用 AI 编程工具接个入口。[查看接入文档](https://www.doveli.top/docs/) ## 效果演示 ![真实 DSH 界面与大肥鱼娘一起固定节奏 Q 弹，玩偶满屏飞行并碰墙反弹](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DoveLi-Gu/dsh-dyou-wine/main/docs/assets/demo.gif) 真实 DSH Web 录屏，12 秒原速无声循环。「上头」档，固定 120 BPM，界面与玩偶一起蹦；玩偶继续匀速飞行、碰墙反弹。画面来自隔离测试会话，没有私人聊天或真实模型请求。 | 开关 | 打开以后 | | --- | --- | | 界面律动 | 文字、卡片和可安全处理的界面区域一起 Q 弹，横向撑开、纵向压扁，再弹回来。 | | 飞行玩偶 | 大肥鱼娘在 DSH 页面里到处飞，撞墙掉头——有点像 DVD 屏保，只是这次长了鲸鱼尾巴。 | 两个都开，就是界面和鱼一起上头。它们共用固定节拍，碰墙或切换其中一项，都不会把另一项带跑拍。 ## 安装 开喝条件：**DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 的 Web 客户端、桌面 Chromium 浏览器**，Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。当前是 Alpha；Desktop、TUI、移动端和其他 DSH 版本尚未承诺兼容。 把大肥鱼娘请进你的 Web profile： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dyou-wine@0.1.0-alpha.14 --ignore-scripts ``` **重启 DSH Host，再刷新页面。** 这是确切版本安装命令，请保留版本号。已有其他 Web profile 的话，把 `web` 换成你使用的 profile。 也可以从 [Alpha.14 Release](https://github.com/DoveLi-Gu/dsh-dyou-wine/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.14) 下载已编译的 `.tgz` 安装；源码构建和隔离试用步骤在下方折叠区。 ## 操作：三步开喝 1. **选谁蹦。** 展开「D友の酒」，勾选「界面律动」「飞行玩偶」，可以两个都选。默认只勾界面律动，安装后不会自动开蹦。 2. **选酒量。** 微醺／上头／整活，改变形变幅度；节奏始终是固定的 **120 BPM**。选好后点「开喝」。 3. **叫上气氛组。** 想听原梗音乐就勾选 BGM，再点「开喝」。BGM 默认关闭，开启后以 50% 音量循环播放。 | 控制 | 实际效果 | | --- | --- | | 开喝 | 按所选开关开始或继续；勾上谁，谁上场。 | | 暂停 | 冻结界面和玩偶，音乐也暂停，再开喝从原进度继续。 | | 醒酒 / `Escape` | 停止效果、收走玩偶，音乐回到开头。 | 切到后台会暂停，回到前台按原运行状态恢复。浏览器若拦住了有声播放，面板会给出提示，点「开喝」重试。 ## 鱼可以上头，操作得清醒 - **巡航范围是 DSH 页面可视区，包含侧栏。** 玩偶点击穿透；浏览器工具栏、其他应用和 Windows 桌面不在巡航范围内。当前使用透明 PNG 玩偶，没有三维转身。 - **输入和审批优先。** 焦点、中文组合输入、选区、正在操作的控件与审批区域保持局部稳定；控制面板和醒酒入口也保持稳定。 - **覆盖范围有边界。** 可处理的父区域会带着子区域一起动；跨域 iframe、封闭 Shadow DOM、Canvas 内部，以及部分滚动／定位／变换冲突区域可能无法参与。 - **浏览器偏好照顾到。** 尊重减少动态效果设置，后台暂停；性能保护减少同时参与的目标数量，保留目标的节奏和幅度照常。 - **不额外烧模型 Token。** 插件不接入模型或工具调用链，不上传聊天正文或文件。设置留在当前浏览器，刷新后不会自动恢复开喝。 具体通过的版本、交互和测试边界见 [兼容矩阵](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) 与 [测试记录](docs/TESTING.md)。 ## BGM：气氛组在这里 音频：[BV1hXbN6VEKV](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1hXbN6VEKV/) 来源为活跃黑江乐的《朋友的酒 DJ 完整版》，原投稿说明基于 Synthesizer V 夢ノ結唱 HALO。内置音轨由用户指定投稿导出，约 3.23 MiB、187.37 秒；图片和音乐都由 DSH Host 从插件包内同源提供，播放不创建视频窗口或 iframe，也不请求 B 站播放器或媒体服务器。面板内的音频署名可以跳回原投稿。 界面和玩偶沿用固定 120 BPM 时钟，播放音乐不重置动画；**不宣称与原曲每一拍精确同步**。 项目代码采用 MIT 许可。歌曲录音、词曲和合成声库不适用本项目代码的 MIT 许可；来源署名不表示已取得原权利人的公开分发许可。GitHub 源码、发行附件与 npm 包包含该录音，来源记录、生成玩偶的说明及各素材的独立范围见 [素材说明](docs/ASSETS.md)。 ## 认真一点的部分，折起来放
设置、动画和演示细节 面板保持 320 px 的简洁布局，只提供两个效果开关、三个档位、原梗 BGM，以及开喝／暂停／醒酒。不提供本地音频上传或高级参数编辑入口。 启动控制器时保留预设和三个开关，并将高级参数恢复默认：BPM 120、相位 0、强度 65、玩偶 180 px 与 180 px/s、所有区域开启、后台不播放、Escape 停止、循环 true。旧的范围关闭或强度为零设置不会让效果继续消失；底层设置校验和音频资源路径保留，供兼容 API 与测试使用。 设置保存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-dyou-wine.settings.v1`，同一浏览器源下的 profile 共用设置。清除这一条即可恢复默认参数。`pageEnabled`／`petEnabled` 独立，`musicEnabled` 默认 false；旧 `mode: 'pet'` 迁移为界面关／玩偶开，旧 `mode: 'page'` 迁移为界面开／玩偶关，明确布尔值优先。 玩偶沿用 Alpha.6 的蓝白鲸鱼娘毛绒形象：深蓝长卷发、浅蓝发梢、鲸鳍耳、蓝色大眼与白围裙鲸纹，通过 imagegen 生成，不宣称官方角色素材。外层匀速推进位置，左右碰撞反转水平速度，上下碰撞反转垂直速度；内层按固定周期反向缩放 X／Y。界面每拍平滑压矮、拉高并复位，底部固定，不逐帧随机变速、错相或改幅度。 文字按块参与，不拆字、不重建宿主 React DOM。父级参与时带动子区域，避免叠加形变；被父级带动不等于每个子节点都有独立动画。Alpha.8 扩充了普通 `div`／`span`、页头与侧栏文字、行内图片和 SVG 等候选，仍只对可见且能安全处理的目标生效。交互保护解除后按统一相位重新加入，未知宿主版本或缺少必要标记会提示兼容问题，无法保证所有第三方插件都被覆盖。120 个目标是工程预算，不能替代真实物理性能、Windows IME、模型流式、审批交互与 Desktop 壳的分别验收。 暂停与后台暂停保留音乐进度，醒酒／Escape 回到开头，卸载释放媒体资源。Alpha.9 移除了左下角视频；Alpha.13 将媒体拆为包内独立文件，音乐支持字节 Range 请求，不占据客户端 JavaScript 入口。 演示 GIF 为 800 × 500、15 fps、12 秒原速无声循环，源码路径 `docs/assets/demo.gif`。npm README 使用同一 GitHub 图片地址；GIF 和赞助 Logo 仅在 GitHub 源码中，npm 安装包不携带这两张展示图片。
发行包、源码构建、隔离试用与卸载 从 [Alpha.14 Release](https://github.com/DoveLi-Gu/dsh-dyou-wine/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.14) 下载 `dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz`： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 安装后重启 Host 并刷新页面。已有 Web profile 可用 `dsh plugin --profile 你的profile add 安装包绝对路径` 更新，这会影响该 profile 的全部会话。 从源码构建： ```sh npm ci npx playwright install chromium npm run check npm pack --ignore-scripts ``` 生成 `dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz`。推荐在独立 DSH home 和 Web profile 先试用；下面是 PowerShell 示例： ```powershell $env:DSH_HOME = Join-Path $PWD '.qa/dsh-home' dsh --version dsh --profile dyou-wine-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config $wineTarball = Join-Path $PWD 'dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz' dsh plugin --profile dyou-wine-test add $wineTarball --ignore-scripts dsh --profile dyou-wine-test --dump-config dsh --profile dyou-wine-test --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 ``` 按 Host 日志打开 Web 地址，依该 profile 的认证提示登录。`DSH_HOME` 只影响当前终端及其子进程。CLI 安装依赖并注册 bundle；修改后没有宿主 HMR 时，重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。 卸载前点击「醒酒」，然后执行，并在需要时重启 Host、刷新页面： ```sh dsh plugin --profile dyou-wine-test remove dsh-dyou-wine ``` 直接安装 GitHub spec 时应固定审查过的 tag／提交。DSH 使用 pnpm，源码包的 `prepare` 需要开发依赖和构建脚本；pnpm 10/11 可能拦截构建。仅在审核来源后，在目标 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中保留原设置并允许确切包： ```yaml allowBuilds: dsh-dyou-wine: true ``` [DSH 官方发布流程](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md) · [本项目发布指南](docs/RELEASING.md)
发布状态、市场收录与开发验收 Alpha.14 已公开，是 README 同步版；编译入口、玩偶图片和音频与 Alpha.13 逐字节一致。公开 `alpha`／`latest` 均指向 Alpha.14；版本仍是 Alpha，请按上方确切版本安装。Alpha.13 首次公开时删除 `latest` 返回 HTTP 400 的记录保留为历史。 npm 的 README 随版本保存，GitHub main 的文案更新不会改写旧包。这次通过新的 Alpha.14 包同步说明，原 Alpha.13 版本、tag 和发行附件保留。最新发布记录见 [更新公告](CHANGELOG.md)。 市场发现保留 `dsh-plugin` npm 关键词、`dsh.bundle`、已验证的 `engines.dsh`、中英文名称说明和图标；根 `screenshots.json` 指向真实画面。远程已设置 `dsh-plugin` Topic 与另外 8 个相关主题。 累计八项正式投稿（三个 PR、三个 Issue、两个网页表单）。[dsh.pub](https://dsh.pub/zh/plugins/dsh-dyou-wine/)、w211 与 [dshplugin.online](https://dshplugin.online/plugins/doveli-gu--dsh-dyou-wine) 已可查到 Alpha.13 快照，dsh-find-plugin 的实时 Community 搜索也能找到本插件；最新 Alpha.14 尚未同步到这些静态目录。本轮更新原三个 Issue 和 [ydhrdh PR #17](https://github.com/ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace/pull/17) 的版本资料，另补投 [Britneycode PR #1](https://github.com/Britneycode/dsh-update-center/pull/1)。其余审核、表单队列、Hub 预检故障与 Awesome 准入限制见 [市场状态](docs/MARKETPLACE.md)；社区来源和自动契约检查不等于人工审核。 开发命令： ```sh npm ci npm run dev npm run typecheck npm test npm run build npx playwright install chromium npm run test:browser npm run pack:check ``` `npm run check` 依次运行类型检查、单元测试、构建、浏览器测试、市场资料与包白名单检查。修改运行时代码后先构建，将 `lib/host.js`、`lib/client.js` 与两份 `lib/assets` 资源加入同一待提交变更；市场自检比较 Git 暂存区与构建内容，CI 验证已提交产物。Linux 首次可运行 `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`。 模拟页：`http://127.0.0.1:4179/tests/fixture/`，并非实际 DSH。真实隔离宿主检查：`node scripts/dsh-smoke.mjs --tarball ./dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz`，CLI 自动发现本地或全局安装，特殊布局可加 `--dsh-bin /absolute/path/to/dsh/lib/bin.js`；60 秒对照单独运行 `npm run benchmark`。[测试记录](docs/TESTING.md) 分别记载模拟页、真实宿主及其他验收边界。 复现演示需要 DSH、Playwright Chromium 和 PATH 中的 FFmpeg：构建、打包后运行 `npm run demo:record -- ./dsh-dyou-wine-0.1.0-alpha.14.tgz`。脚本创建新的隔离 DSH home 和测试会话，录制原速双效果及两个方向的反弹，导出 `docs/assets/demo.gif`；原录屏和采样报告留在忽略提交的 `.qa/demo/`。 客户端由宿主 ModuleLoader 加载，使用宿主 React，以独立 id 注册 `shell.overlay`。DOM 版本适配不依赖构建后 CSS 哈希。[GitHub Actions](https://github.com/DoveLi-Gu/dsh-dyou-wine/actions) 在 Ubuntu／Windows Node 24 运行检查；npm 工作流仅手动触发，上传代码或 tag 不会自动发布 npm。 需求和设计：[PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) · [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md)。完整原策划案保存在源码仓库，不进入 npm 安装包。
## 给作者续一杯

鸽子中转站 · Pigeon API Relay

大肥鱼娘蹦完了，代码还得继续写。

如果这只鱼让你会心一笑，欢迎顺路看看作者维护的 **鸽子中转站**：提供 OpenAI 兼容 API、密钥管理和用量记录，在已有客户端中配置自己的 API 地址与密钥即可接入。 [接入文档](https://www.doveli.top/docs/) 提供 OpenCode、Hermes、Codex++ 与 CC Switch 等工具的配置步骤。平台也有余额与订阅入口，可在[模型与价格](https://api.doveli.top/model-pricing/)页面查看模型与分组计费；线路、价格和套餐权益以站内实时信息为准。 D友の酒本身无需中转站账号，这里是作者项目的介绍。
