plugins.description: Keyless, zero-cost web_search for DeepSeek Harness with a browser you choose: render Shenma through any Chromium browser (Edge / Chrome / Chromium / Brave / Vivaldi) over CDP and read Bing over HTTP. No API key, no model call, no bill.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-edge

零密钥、零费用的 `web_search` 后端，给 DeepSeek Harness 用。抓取走**本机浏览器**——**用哪个浏览器你说了算**。

**内核要求：dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.1`**（`ctx.web` 的 Config 从这一版起支持 `.volatile()`）。

## 浏览器可随意设置

渲染通道不绑定 Edge。以下四种方式任选，优先级从高到低：

| 方式 | 写法 |
|---|---|
| 插件配置 | `browserPath: "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"` |
| 环境变量 | `DSH_SEARCH_BROWSER` 或 `DSH_EDGE_PATH` |
| 自动探测 | `browserPath` 留空：按常见路径依次找 Edge / Chrome / Chromium |
| 完全不用浏览器 | `transport: http`，只走纯 HTTP 抓取 |

任何基于 Chromium 的浏览器（Edge、Chrome、Chromium、Brave、Vivaldi……）都能用：渲染走标准
`--headless=new --dump-dom`，不依赖厂商私有接口。换浏览器不影响结果解析，因为解析是对 DOM 做的。

自动探测覆盖三平台：Windows 找 `msedge.exe` / `chrome.exe`（`ProgramFiles(x86)`、`ProgramFiles`、
`LOCALAPPDATA`），macOS 找 `/Applications` 下的 Edge / Chrome / Chromium，Linux 找
`microsoft-edge` / `google-chrome` / `chromium` 的常见路径。要是指定路径不存在，浏览器通道会被判为
不可用并明确报出来，不会静默退化成空结果。

## 内核兼容性

本插件跟随 DSH 内核的 `ctx.web` 契约。内核在 `0.2.1-rc.1` 引入 **volatile config**：被标为
`.volatile()` 的字段在运行时以**活访问器**形式下发（`config.maxResults.get()`），而不是普通值，
并且只改这些字段时内核会把新值**提交进正在运行的 fiber，不重启、不重挂载**。

因此本插件的两点约束：

- `Config` 的每个字段都是 `.volatile()`，且各自位于固定对象路径上。内核**不允许** volatile 字段
  嵌套在另一个 volatile 字段里，也不允许标在数组**元素**上（`z.array(z.string().volatile())`
  在构建 schema 时就会抛错），所以数组/联合类型是整体标记。
- `apply` 收到的配置必须**逐字段用 `get()` 解包**。直接读字段会拿到访问器对象，`typeof` 判断
  全部落空并静默回落到默认值——你的设置会被无声丢弃。解包由 `readOptions` / `readField` 统一做。

`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 是内核兼容性闸门的**唯一依据**：只要声明了它，`peerDependencies`
就不参与判定，范围不满足时 profile 启动会直接拒绝挂载该插件。

## 它解决的是什么坑

DSH 自带的 `deepseek-official` 搜索提供方没有独立搜索接口，它把一次搜索实现成**一次完整的
Messages 模型调用**（带上服务端的 `web_search_20250305` 工具），抓到的网页正文就是输入
token。于是每次 `web_search` 都真实扣一次 DeepSeek 余额——哪怕你聊天的模型是别人家的，
搜索这一下仍然记在你自己的账上。

本插件改成直接读搜索结果页，归一化成 `ctx.web` 需要的 `WebSearchResult`：无密钥、不调模型、
不计费。它注册进同一个 `ctx.web` 破缝，`dsh-tool-web` 依旧负责模型侧的 `web_search` 契约。

## 为什么用浏览器渲染而不是纯 HTTP 抓取

值得用的中文引擎都是**客户端渲染**的：服务器发回来的 HTML 里根本没有结果卡片，结果由页面
自己的 JavaScript 填充。HTTP 抓取永远看不到它们，浏览器渲染后就能拿到。

实测（本机，`--headless=new --dump-dom`，用 Edge）：

| 引擎 | 通道 | 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| **神马 `m.sm.cn`** | **Edge 渲染** | 渲染后 372 KB，稳定 10 条结果，标题/来源/真实 URL 齐全，无广告位，**不限流** |
| **Bing** | HTTP | 250–450 ms，10 条。HTML 里就有结果，渲染它反而要 5.5 秒，纯属浪费 |
| 360 | — | 按出口 IP 限流，连着几次整机进验证码。**已从本插件移除** |
| 百度 / 搜狗 / Quark | Edge 渲染 | 仍然被验证码或反爬页拦住，不可用 |

**关键否定结果**：360 和百度的拦截是**按出口 IP**的，不是按指纹。用真实 Edge 无头跑同一个
URL，拿到的还是同一个验证码页。所以这类引擎不是"换个浏览器就能过"，而是没有价值，已删除。

## 引擎与通道

```yaml
transport: auto      # 默认：每个引擎走自己能用的通道
```

| `transport` | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `auto`（默认） | 神马走浏览器渲染（约 4–5 秒），Bing 走 HTTP（约 0.3 秒）。**正确且最快** |
| `browser` | 全部走浏览器渲染。最慢，但完全不受 HTTP 层拦截影响 |
| `http` | 全部走普通抓取。最快；神马这类客户端渲染的引擎会明确报告"渲染型引擎，请用 auto"而不是静默返回空 |

| 引擎 id | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `shenma` | 神马/UC。中文质量最好，走浏览器渲染。 |
| `bing` | 始终可达。英文/技术查询强，但按源 IP 定位，本地中文查询会漂移到别的城市。 |

旧 id 会被映射，配置写错不会让整个搜索挂掉：

```
smcn / sm / uc / shenma-mobile  →  shenma
bing-html / google / duckduckgo →  bing
```

## 四个关键机制

**相关性闸门（按稀有度加权）**。一个词如果每条候选里都有（"下载"、"天气"），它不能区分答案；
只在少数页面出现的词（`works2`、`stm32f103`、`梯形图`）才决定相关性。所以每个词按
`1 / (0.5 + 文档频率/候选数)` 加权，并且命中至少要落在**一个有区分度的词**上，否则整条丢掉。
标题命中权重 2、URL 1.5、摘要 1。

**答非所问提示**。Bing 会按 IP 地理位置给答案，而且给得很自信。所以当最终结果没有覆盖查询里
的**区分性词**（例如问"上海"却全是滨州的页面），插件不假装成功：照常返回结果，但在 `content`
里写一句"这些来源没覆盖 X，是最接近的匹配而非确认答案"。`dsh-tool-web` 会把 `content` 印在
来源列表上方，模型能自己决定要不要换词重查。

**限流冷却**。引擎返回验证码/反爬页时记一笔，默认 10 分钟内不再问它——反复戳验证码端点只会
让 IP 关得更久，而且每次重试都把整次搜索拖到超时。冷却中的引擎不会在每次搜索里刷提示，只有
在结果确实可疑、或只剩一个引擎答上来时才会说明。

**同站限额**。`blog.csdn.net` 和 `bbs.csdn.net` 是两个 host、一个站。默认同一注册域最多占 3
条；超出名额在别的站不够用时再回填，所以限额不会缩短结果集。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `engines` | `[shenma, bing]` | 引擎列表，顺序仅用于打平。 |
| `maxResults` | `8` | 单次搜索返回上限。 |
| `maxPerSite` | `3` | 同一注册域最多几条。 |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | 单个 HTTP 请求预算。 |
| `transport` | `auto` | `auto` / `browser` / `http`，见上表。 |
| `browserPath` | `""` | 显式指定浏览器（Edge / Chrome / Chromium / 任意 Chromium 内核）；空则自动探测（`DSH_SEARCH_BROWSER` / `DSH_EDGE_PATH` 也可）。 |
| `browserTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次无头渲染预算。 |
| `cooldownMs` | `600000` | 被限流后跳过多久。 |
| `minAnchorCoverage` | `0.75` | 结果要覆盖多少比例的区分性词，低于此值才出提示；`0` 关闭。 |
| `debugDomDir` | `""` | 填一个目录就把每次渲染的 DOM 存下来，便于排查页面改版。 |

以上字段全部是 volatile 的：在设置页改动后**下一次搜索即生效**，不需要重启 DSH。

### 浏览器的用法与隐私

渲染用 `<浏览器> --headless=new --dump-dom <url>`，**每次都用全新的临时 profile 目录**，用完即删。
它不会读写你真实的浏览器配置、历史、cookie 或扩展，也不会和你已经打开的浏览器窗口冲突。
`--virtual-time-budget=9000` 让渲染器快速推进定时器，这样结果填完才截图 DOM。

## 接线

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: free-scrape
    fetchProvider: http
- id: web-search-deepseek
  disabled: true          # 计费的那条提供方直接关掉，写错配置也只会报错不会扣钱
- id: web-deepseek-api
  disabled: true          # rc.2 新增的官方 Search/Fetch API 行，同样关掉
- insert:
    - id: web-search-free
      name: dsh-web-search-edge
      config:
        engines: [shenma, bing]
        transport: auto
```

`web-fetch-http` 仍是 fetch 提供方，`web_fetch` 一直是免费的，没有变化。

## 取舍

- 结果就是引擎给的结果：标题、URL、摘要，**永远没有合成答案**（`content` 只用来放上述提示），
  模型拿来源自己去 `web_fetch`。
- 走浏览器渲染的神马通道每次约 4–5 秒，主要开销是浏览器启动本身；实测把渲染预算从 9 秒降到 4 秒
  对结果数量没有影响，所以预算是够用就好，不是越大越好。
- 中文长尾质量取决于神马是否可达；只剩 Bing 时本地化查询可能偏移，插件会明说，不会装作答上了。
- 抓取受各引擎自身条款约束；这是给个人低频率查询用的，不是批量爬取。

## 回滚

删掉 profile patch 里的四段（`web` 覆盖、`web-search-deepseek` 禁用、`web-deepseek-api` 禁用、
`web-search-free` insert），`searchProvider` 回到内核默认的 `deepseek-official`。改完重启 DSH 生效。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话 AI 回复结束时用 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标弹系统通知 | DSH plugin: system notification with the DeepSeek whale when a session's AI turn finishes
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

System notifications for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: when a session's AI turn finishes, DSH raises a system notification carrying its black-whale mark and tells you **which task** completed.

![preview](preview.png)

---

## English

### How it works (and why it is built this way)

The **host** subscribes to the session log's own `session/event` stream and reacts to `turn/end`; the **browser** receives those completions over Server-Sent Events and raises the notification.

This split is deliberate. Earlier versions tried to detect completion in the browser by reading client-side projections, and both attempts failed silently:

| Attempt | Why it never fired |
|---|---|
| `sessions.list.byId[*].running` | DSH 0.2.x keeps `running` on the session object and no longer refreshes the list row live, so no `true → false` edge ever appeared. |
| `sessions.binding(id).session` | `binding()` returns `this.scopes.get(id)?.binding` — it only answers for an **already-retained** scope, so a root-level plugin got `undefined` for every session. |

Both are private internals. `session/event` is the documented seam — the `dsh-session` package documents *"Persistence is a plugin concern (subscribe to `session/event`, drain on `session/flush`)"* — and `turn/end` is a stable type in the session log's own event vocabulary. The host also has the durable session header, so titles come from the source of truth rather than from a UI projection.

### Behaviour

- Fires for **every** finished turn, in any session.
- Title `任务完成` (`任务出错` when the turn failed); body names the session.
- Icon: the **DeepSeek whale**, served by the host at `/dsh-notify/whale.svg` and rasterized to a PNG in the browser (Windows toasts prefer a bitmap).
- **Click** the notice to ask the shell to focus that session.
- One `EventSource` handles reconnection on its own.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** — the node half is loaded at boot, so a page refresh alone is not enough.

### Diagnosing

**Settings → General** shows the permission state, a **"Send a test notification"** button, and the live link state:

```
Link: live · 3 completion event(s) received
```

- Test button works but the counter stays 0 → the host half is not loaded (restart DSH).
- Counter grows but no toast → the OS/browser is suppressing notifications.

### Endpoints

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-notify/stream` | `text/event-stream` of completion frames |
| `GET /dsh-notify/completions` | recent completions + current sequence watermark |
| `GET /dsh-notify/whale.svg` | the whale mark |

### Tests

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`tests/host-test.mjs` (29 assertions) covers the event mapping (only `turn/end` counts; title/cwd/id fallbacks; failure text), the feed (monotonic seq, history cap, detach), and every route including the SSE handshake, a pushed frame, and detach on close. `tests/client-test.mjs` (20 assertions) covers the two-slot registration, the stream wiring, notification content, click-to-open, denied permission, and the settings row.

### License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party marks: [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

---

## 中文

### 工作原理（以及为什么这样设计）

**宿主**订阅会话日志自身的 `session/event`，对 `turn/end` 作出反应；**浏览器**通过 SSE 收到完成事件后弹出通知。

这个分工是刻意的。此前两版都试图在浏览器里读客户端投影来判断"是否跑完"，两次都静默失效：

| 尝试 | 为什么从不触发 |
|---|---|
| `sessions.list.byId[*].running` | 0.2.x 把 `running` 放在会话对象上，列表行不再实时刷新，因此永远等不到 `true → false` 边沿。 |
| `sessions.binding(id).session` | `binding()` 返回的是 `this.scopes.get(id)?.binding` —— 它只对**已被 retain** 的 scope 有答案，根级插件对每个会话都拿到 `undefined`。 |

这些都是私有内部实现。而 `session/event` 是**文档化的**扩展点（`dsh-session` 包里写明"订阅 `session/event`"是持久化插件的做法），`turn/end` 是会话日志事件词汇表里的稳定类型。宿主还能读到会话的 header，所以标题取自事实来源，而不是 UI 投影。

### 行为

- **任何会话**的每一轮结束都会通知；
- 标题 `任务完成`（该轮失败则 `任务出错`），正文带会话标题；
- 图标是 **DeepSeek 鲸鱼**：由宿主在 `/dsh-notify/whale.svg` 提供，浏览器栅格化成 PNG（Windows 通知偏好位图）；
- **点击通知**让外壳聚焦该会话；
- `EventSource` 自带重连。

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
```

**装完必须重启 DSH** —— 宿主半边在启动时加载，只刷新页面不够。

### 怎么排查

**设置 → 通用** 里显示权限状态、**「发一条测试通知」** 按钮，以及实时连接状态：

```
连接：已连接 · 已收到 3 条完成事件
```

- 测试按钮能弹、但计数一直是 0 → 宿主插件没加载（重启 DSH）；
- 计数在涨、但没弹窗 → 系统/浏览器在拦截通知。

### 接口

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-notify/stream` | 完成事件的 `text/event-stream` |
| `GET /dsh-notify/completions` | 最近的完成记录 + 当前序号 |
| `GET /dsh-notify/whale.svg` | 鲸鱼图标 |

### 测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`tests/host-test.mjs`（29 项）覆盖事件映射（只有 `turn/end` 算数；标题/cwd/id 兜底；失败信息）、feed（序号单调、历史上限、解绑），以及全部路由（含 SSE 握手、推送一帧、断开解绑）。
`tests/client-test.mjs`（20 项）覆盖两个 slot 注册、流接线、通知内容、点击跳转、权限拒绝、设置行渲染。

### 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方说明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: delete archived sessions with reference-aware attachment garbage collection, as one reversible transaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archived-chat-cleanup（已归档会话清理）

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> A DSH plugin that deletes **archived** sessions together with their exclusively-referenced
> attachment objects and derived request-image caches — one reference-aware, journalled,
> reversible transaction. Install by package name: `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`.

## 安装

**通过 DSH 输入包名安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 插件管理器里输入 `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`，
或使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archived-chat-cleanup
```

安装/升级后需要重启宿主（模块缓存按包说明符生效）。

从源码安装（本地开发）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add <插件目录的绝对路径>
```

## English overview

DSH stores attachments content-addressed: one object can be referenced by many sessions, so
deleting a session must not blindly delete its attachments. This plugin deletes only archived
sessions, cascades into their subagent child sessions, scans every surviving session for
`sha256:` references, removes only unreferenced attachment objects, clears the
`request-images` derived caches, and updates the live indexes through the running services.
Every file move is journalled and reversible, including crash recovery on the next boot.

It ships a Host half (`delete_archived_session` tool + `archivedCleanup` Remote namespace) and
a browser half (two rows in the archived session's “…” menu). See the Chinese sections below
for the full behaviour, transaction protocol and test coverage.

删除**已归档**会话，并按引用关系回收附件实体；整个过程是一个可回滚的事务。
Host 半 + 浏览器半在同一个包里，安装后提供三个入口：会话「...」菜单、模型工具、Remote API。

## 它解决什么

DSH 的附件是**内容寻址**的：同一张图被多个会话引用时磁盘上只有一份。
所以"删除会话"不能简单地把附件一起删掉，必须先判断还有没有别的会话在引用。
DSH 自身没有删除会话的 API（`sessionPersistence` / `attachments` 都没有 delete），
这些数据只能由插件自己按事务方式落盘删除。

## 行为

一次删除调用按顺序完成：

1. **归档校验**：目标必须在 `workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds`（界面上的"已归档"）里。
   非归档会话直接拒绝（`session-not-archived`）。
2. **运行中会话**：`one` 模式整体拒绝（`target-live`）；`all` 模式**跳过**该会话及其全部子会话并在结果里报告（`skippedLive`），绝不删正在写的日志。
3. **级联**：递归带上目标会话的子代理子会话（它们是归档会话的内部会话，保留会让附件被"永久引用"）。
4. **取目标会话的附件引用**：完整读取会话日志，扫描其中出现的所有 `sha256:<64hex>`。
5. **取存活会话的引用**：扫描除目标外的**所有**现存会话（磁盘 + 内存 live，不区分是否归档）。
6. **判定**：
   - 未被任何存活会话引用 → 删除附件实体（镜像对象 `attachments/v1/objects/`、
     文件对象 `file-objects/`、以及别名目录 `files/`）；
   - 仍被其他会话引用 → **不删**，只随目标会话一起删除那条引用（引用存在会话日志里）；
   - 任何存活会话日志读不出来 → 整个操作中止（fail-closed，宁可不删）。
7. **删除派生缓存**：`<cacheRoot>/request-images` 与旧版遗留的 `attachments/v1/request-images`
   整体清掉（按"源对象+请求尺寸"派生，无法精确归属到某个会话，且下次看图会自动重建）。
8. **删除会话正文与索引引用**：会话目录、投影缓存记录（`session_projcache` 域）、
   message_feedback 记录、workspace 归属与归档集合。
   索引一律走**活着的服务/域**，不直接改文件——`workspaceRegistry` 会在内存里缓存状态，
   直接改文件会被它写回（这正是前两次手工清理踩过的坑）。

### 事务与回滚

- **阶段一**：把每个待删路径 `rename` 进隔离区（同卷、原子），每步写一次 journal；
- **阶段二**：改索引（先快照原值）；
- **阶段三**：两者都成功后彻底清空隔离区。
- 任意一步失败：先回滚索引，再逆序把文件搬回原位，journal 记为 `rolled-back`（隔离区清掉，journal 留作审计）。
- 进程崩溃：下次启动扫描 journal，自动恢复未完成的事务；`rollback-incomplete` 表示恢复不完全，需人工看 journal。
- 所有待删路径必须**严格位于**会话根/附件根/缓存根之内，否则 `unsafe-path` 中止。

## 用法

| 入口 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 会话「...」菜单 | 仅在该会话已归档时显示"删除已归档会话…"（order 500）与"清理全部已归档会话…"（order 501），**点两次**才执行 |
| 模型工具 `delete_archived_session` | `{ mode: "one"\|"all", session_id?, dry_run?, confirm }`；`dry_run:true` 只报告计划；真正删除需 `confirm:true` |
| Remote 命名空间 `archivedCleanup` | 端点 `archivedCleanup/status`、`/preview`、`/deleteArchived`，参数按名字传 `{ mode, sessionId, confirm }` |

## 路径与数据

- 会话根：`ctx.sessionPersistence.root`（回退：Loader 配置 / `DSH_HOME/sessions`）
- 附件根：`ctx.attachments.root`（回退 `DSH_HOME/attachments/v1`）
- 派生缓存：`ctx.attachments.cacheRoot`（回退 `DSH_HOME/cache/attachments`）
- 插件数据：`DSH_HOME/plugin-data/archived-cleanup/`（`transactions/` journal，`reports/` 执行报告）

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: A sidebar prompt template library for DeepSeek Harness: browse, manage, and insert reusable prompts into the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Library for DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that keeps reusable prompt templates one click away. It adds a searchable template library to the sidebar and a compact picker to the message composer. Choosing a template inserts it at the caret, or starts a new conversation with the template already in the draft when no conversation is open.

Repository: <https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt>

## Features

- **Sidebar library** — a bookmark entry in the left sidebar opens a full library panel.
- **Composer picker** — a small bookmark button in the composer tool row opens a compact, searchable picker without leaving the conversation.
- **Insert at the caret** — templates are inserted into the current draft; a selection is replaced. The edit is undoable through the composer's normal undo history.
- **No-conversation fallback** — with no conversation open, choosing a template starts a new conversation and puts the template in the draft.
- **Template management** — create, edit, delete, duplicate, copy, search, and filter templates by category.
- **Categories** — create a category before it has templates. The empty category offers **New template in this category**. A name matching a built-in category label belongs to that built-in category instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Eight built-in templates** — code review, refactoring, tests, debugging, explanation, summarization, translation, and structured research. They follow the UI language and are read-only; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy.
- **English and Simplified Chinese UI** — the interface follows the DSH language setting.
- **No configuration required** — no API key, token, password, account, or external service.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** or newer, with the Web or Desktop UI.
- A DSH profile in which bundles can be installed (the default Desktop profile is fine).
- Network access to GitHub when installing from this repository.

The plugin is a **bundle**, not a standalone web page. Install it through DSH's plugin manager; do not try to open `client.js` directly.

The repository root is the installable package root. It contains `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `index.js`, and `client.js`; there is no monorepo subdirectory and no build step.

## Install from GitHub

### Desktop / Web (recommended)

1. In DSH, open **Plugins**.
2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Paste the repository address:

   ```text
   https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
   ```

4. Review the trust notice and confirm the installation. DSH reads `package.json` and installs the bundle.
5. If the `prompt-library` row remains off, enable it in **Plugins**.
6. If the sidebar bookmark does not appear, refresh the Web GUI once.

### CLI

`dsh plugin --profile <name> add ...` forwards the install to pnpm in that profile. Use the profile you actually run (`web`, `desktop`, or a custom profile):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The equivalent GitHub URL form is accepted by pnpm-based installs:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

A git install fetches sources, not a prebuilt artifact. This package is plain JavaScript with no `prepare`/`build` script, so pnpm does not need to run an install-time build and users are not asked to allow one.

Do not edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand; the plugin manager owns those files.

### Local checkout (development)

Install the absolute path to this repository as a linked bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dev add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The plugin manager links the checkout into the profile, so edits to `client.js` are picked up after a page refresh. Replace `dev` with a disposable profile name; do not mix development links into a profile you rely on.

### Update and uninstall

DSH upgrades non-official plugins by uninstalling and reinstalling them. Uninstall the bundle in **Plugins**, then install the new repository version. With the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-prompt
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

Removing the bundle removes the sidebar entry and composer picker. Templates already saved in the browser are not deleted by uninstalling; clear the keys below if you want to remove them.

## Configuration

The plugin has **no Config schema** and no required settings. There is no API key, token, password, endpoint, or model selection to configure.

| Setting | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Templates | Managed in the library panel or the template editor. |
| Categories | Created with **New category** or by typing a new category in the template editor. |
| Language | Follows the DSH language setting (`English` or `简体中文`). |
| Built-in templates | Fixed in the plugin; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy. |

### Browser storage

Templates and categories are stored in the Harness Web origin's `localStorage`:

- `dsh.prompt-library.templates.v1` — user templates.
- `dsh.prompt-library.categories.v1` — categories that exist independently of templates. When this key is missing, categories already used by saved templates are migrated into it.

`localStorage` is scoped to the Web origin. A different origin, browser profile, or cleared browser storage has separate data. The plugin does not write templates to the session log, does not send them to a server, and does not read credentials. When you send a message, its text reaches your configured model through DSH as usual.

## Usage

### Sidebar library

1. Click the bookmark entry in the left sidebar.
2. Search by title, text, or category, or choose a category chip.
3. Choose **Insert** to put the template into the current draft, **Copy** to copy it, or **Save as mine** to duplicate a built-in template.
4. Use **New category** to create a category before it has templates.
5. Use the back arrow in the panel header to return to the conversation.

### Composer picker

1. Click the bookmark button in the composer's left tool row.
2. In a new, empty conversation the picker opens as a centered dialog, so the search field is always visible; in an active conversation it opens above the composer.
3. Search for a template. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to insert, or click a row.
4. The template is inserted at the caret (or replaces the current selection).

### Example

Create a reusable review prompt:

1. Open the sidebar library.
2. Choose **New template**.
3. Set the title to `Review a pull request`, the category to `Engineering`, and the body to:

   ```text
   Review this change for correctness, edge cases, performance, security,
   and maintainability. List issues by severity, then give concrete fixes.

   ```

4. Save. The template appears under **My templates**.
5. In any conversation, click the composer bookmark, choose the template, and it is inserted at the caret.

### Empty categories

A newly created category is selected immediately. Until it has templates, the panel shows **No templates in this category yet** and **New template in this category**. That button opens the editor with the category prefilled.

Categories can be created and selected, but renaming or deleting a category is not yet supported.

## Compatibility

- Built and verified with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**.
- The package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"`. Installation and profile startup refuse a bundle outside that range.
- The client half uses the public slot entries `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, `conversation.input.left`, and `conversation.input.overlay`, plus the composer's `InputActions.captureInsertion()` / `insertText()`.
- If a future DSH release changes those slots, the plugin may need an update. Please include the DSH version in bug reports.

## Privacy and security

- No analytics, telemetry, or network calls of its own.
- No credential, API key, token, cookie, or account access.
- No host filesystem access; the host half is an empty `apply()` row.
- Only templates and category names are stored, in this

plugins.description: 手机端交互与可读性适配：抽屉式侧栏（滑动开合 + 可调宽度）、滑动手势、触控命中区、软键盘避让、正文字号下限。Mobile interaction & readability layer for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-adapt

在手机上用 DSH Web，手感更顺一点。

原版界面是按电脑设计的：侧栏挤在一列里、按钮太小不好点、键盘弹出来挡住输入框、字偏小。这个插件把这些都调成适合手指用的样子。

## 功能

**侧栏变成抽屉**

- 右滑打开，左滑收起，手指跟着走；
- 宽度可以调：点一下按钮换一档（60% / 75% / 90% / 满屏），按住左右拖能连续调；
- 调过的宽度会记住，下次打开还是那样。

**手势**

- 右滑：打开侧栏；
- 左滑（侧栏开着时）：收起侧栏；
- 返回键：先关弹窗，再关侧栏，不会一不小心退出 App。

**会话列表好点也好认**

- 标题放大到 16px，长标题**折成两行**显示，不再一刀切成「手机端 dsh 适配手机交…」；
- 每行的时间（6 分钟 / 1 天）保留并放大，随时知道上次是什么时候聊的；
- 行末只留一个 `⋯` 按钮，归档、置顶、重命名都在它弹出的菜单里，不再占三格；
- 按钮放大到 40×40，行高跟着变高，拇指点得准；
- **拖动排序保留原样**：按住标题拖就能调整顺序，插件不拦这个手势。

**点得准**

- 按钮和菜单项放大到手指好按的大小，按下去有反馈；
- 去掉点完要等一下才能点的老毛病。

**键盘不挡输入框**

- 弹出键盘时界面自动往上让，输入框始终看得见。

**字更清楚**

- 正文最小 15px，输入框固定 16px；
- 你要是自己调过字号，插件不会覆盖，只是保证不会小于 15px。

**滚动不跑偏**

- 代码块、表格可以单独左右滑，不会把整个页面拖歪。

## 安装

```sh
bash install.sh              # 安装
bash install.sh --uninstall  # 卸载
```

装完刷新页面就生效，不用重启。

## 想自己调

打开 `lib/client.js`，改这几个：

| 改什么 | 找这个 |
| --- | --- |
| 多大的屏幕才算手机 | `PHONE_QUERY` |
| 正文最小字号 | `MIN_CONTENT_PX` |
| 宽度有哪几档 | `WIDTH_STEPS` |
| 默认宽度 | `DEFAULT_RATIO` |

改完重新跑 `bash install.sh`，刷新页面。

## 兼容

- 不往顶栏加按钮，也不强行改别的插件的控件大小，和大多数插件能一起用；
- 支持 **DSH 0.2 及以后所有版本**（没有写死版本上限，市场里升级到高版本 DSH 也不会被判定不兼容）；
- 只在窄屏（宽度 ≤767px）生效，电脑上不会改变任何东西。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text: # win-pilot English | [中文](./README.zh.md) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-0078D4) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.12-339933) Win-Pilot provides Windows computer use with DeepSeek Harness as its primary integration. Its `computer` tool operates in the current desktop or an optional separate Windows task session, with a compact visible window for pause and manual takeover. Plugin, MCP, CLI and native integrations share the same runtime. ## Features | Feature | Concrete behavior | |---|---| | Agent Plugin package | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` bundles the MCP server and operating skill | | Native Windows control | UI Automation, Win32 input/window management, and window-scoped screenshots | | Background-first actions | Supported capture and input paths avoid unnecessary focus stealing | | Isolated browser control | Launches Edge sessions and controls them through CDP-bound targets and tokens | | Recoverable protocol | Stable `ok`, `outcome`, `error_code`, post-action observations, and unknown-outcome handling | | Universal fallbacks | Local stdio MCP for tool-aware agents; JSON CLI plus skill for shell-capable agents | | Schema portability | Tool schema is validated for OpenAI- and Gemini-family consumers | | DSH provider lifecycle | Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2+ for Config forms; claims the exclusive `computerUse` provider slot | | Optional task desktop | Windows child session with a compact 432×300 frameless window and automatic manual takeover | ## Requirements - Windows 10/11 x64 - Node.js 22.12 or newer - Windows PowerShell 5.1 - Optional .NET 8 runtime for WGC capture - .NET 8 Windows Desktop Runtime for the optional task desktop - An Agent Plugin host, stdio MCP client, or shell-capable agent ## Quick Start ### Install with your Agent (recommended) Send this single instruction to an agent on the Windows machine: ```text Install and verify Win-Pilot by following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JeremyWangCY/win-pilot/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md ``` The agent will prefer the complete plugin, then fall back to MCP or CLI only when its host lacks plugin support. ### Manual installation Plugin-capable hosts can install `JeremyWangCY/win-pilot`. The package contains both `.mcp.json` and `skills/win-pilot`. For other hosts: ```powershell npm install -g win-pilot@latest win-pilot doctor --probe ``` Register this local MCP server through the host's normal plugin/tool settings: ```json { "mcpServers": { "win-pilot": { "command": "win-pilot", "args": ["mcp"] } } } ``` Convenience installers are provided for known hosts, while generic modes remain available for every other agent: ```powershell win-pilot install --agent codex win-pilot install --agent claude win-pilot install --agent qoder win-pilot install --agent pi win-pilot install --agent dsh win-pilot install --agent mcp win-pilot install --agent cli ``` Verify with: ```powershell win-pilot --version win-pilot status --json win-pilot doctor --probe --json ``` Expected for this release: version `0.3.1`, platform `win32`, and every required doctor check marked `ok`. Doctor checks installed prerequisites; a successful connection is required to verify a task session. ### Settings In DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 or later**, open **Settings → Win-Pilot** or the plugin detail page. The host projects the plugin's `Config`. Display preferences apply immediately. Changing the desktop environment applies to the next computer operation, including an existing chat. | Preference | Default | Effect | |---|---|---| | `overlay` | `true` | Show the operation cursor | | `statusPill` | `true` | Show the running status pill | | `browserHeadlessDefault` | `false` | Run browsers without a visible window | | `desktopEnvironment` | `current` | Where computer actions run: this desktop or the separate task window | `desktopEnvironment` defaults to `current`; `task` selects the separate task window. Save the setting to switch on the next computer operation. Win-Pilot cancels and cleans up the old control session before changing desktops, releases old browser claims, and requires a fresh window list or desktop screenshot before input. Old targets cannot carry over; failed cleanup blocks the switch. With the option off, model schemas, runtime skills and diagnostics do not advertise the task-desktop option. With it on, native actions, observations, clipboard and recovery stay in that task desktop; failure never redirects work to the main desktop. Browser actions require a browser launched by the same task. The light, frameless window defaults to 432×300. Its toolbar contains expand/restore, pin and close. In the expanded view, click, drag or type to take over: AI input stops before your first gesture is delivered. After 10 seconds without manual input, control returns to the AI; a held button or key prevents that return. The compact view is read-only. Right-click the toolbar for local sign-in settings. Complete Windows feature setup and local sign-in once; optionally remember credentials using the current Windows user's DPAPI and Credential Manager. Passwords stay in the local dialog. This mode requires .NET 8 Windows Desktop Runtime and working Windows child-session support. A Windows user change, credential change or system policy may require setup again; it is not a virtual machine. After updating an already-loaded plugin, restart DeepSeek Harness before saving new settings. See [task desktop](./docs/task-desktop.md) for behavior and verification limits. Use `win-pilot desktop --preview` to view the native window without creating a session or running computer actions. `win-pilot desktop` is the normal connection entry and respects the connection hold. Source builds use `npm run build:desktop`; checks without Windows sessions use `npm run test:desktop`. Numeric limits and input policy use internal defaults; old settings cannot change them. Required Windows/Meta system keys stay enabled internally. Background input, lock checks, user-interruption cancellation, focus yielding and window text reads follow this project's own [desktop control contract](docs/desktop-control-contract.md). CLI/MCP installs without a harness use the built-in defaults. ### Updating Finish active UI tasks, update the runtime, and restart or reload the host's plugin/MCP process: ```powershell npm install -g win-pilot@latest win-pilot doctor --probe ``` DSH profiles must be restarted separately. Re-run `win-pilot install` when you want its managed skill copy refreshed; user-maintained custom skills are not updated in the background. ### Sandboxed agents When a sandbox reaps children after every command, configure `win-pilot mcp` in the host's persistent plugin or MCP supervisor. Do not detach a process from an ephemeral command. Shell-only agents can use one-shot `win-pilot request` calls. ## Usage Version 0.3.1 applies desktop setting changes within existing chats and keeps the running pill visible for CLI observations and long actions. Switching requires fresh discovery before input. Version 0.3.0 adds session-scoped `stop` / `resume`, queued and active request cancellation, and atomic per-user control ownership. Observation remains available after stopping. Desktop accessibility uses stable sparse indexes and model-visible `full` / `delta` / `no_change` trees; hidden observations do not advance that baseline. Rich `paste` accepts `format: text | html | md` and restores supported original clipboard formats unless the user changes the clipboard meanwhile. Markdown conversion covers a limited subset. Browser additions are `browser_frames`, `browser_filechooser`, `browser_claim_tab`, and `browser_finalize`. Same-origin child frames use `frame_id` and semantic references; cross-origin/OOPIF frames are explicitly rejected. Claims bind to the current control session: keep `claim_id` for mutations, then finalize to release without activating the tab. Arm a chooser before

plugins.description: ai-course plugin for deepseek harness
plugins.readme_text:
# AI 课程（dsh-ai-courses）

把「一个学习诉求 + 手头资料」变成一门**结构化、可讲授、可反复翻阅、纯本地**的 AI 课程。

在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 `/ai-course` 建课，在侧边栏「AI 课程」里管课、按章节/知识点生成内容，在学习页里阅读图文、幻灯片与图表。课程数据全部落在本地文件里，可以直接打开、diff、备份或整目录拷贝。

> 适用：DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`，Web UI（含桌面端的 Web 界面）。  
> 运行形态：host + client 双半插件；包本身零运行时依赖。

---

## 目录

- [功能一览](#功能一览)
- [安装](#安装)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [参考资料与附件](#参考资料与附件)
- [配置](#配置)
- [数据与备份](#数据与备份)
- [升级、停用与卸载](#升级停用与卸载)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [从源码开发](#从源码开发)
- [License](#license)

---

## 功能一览

- **`/ai-course` 建课**：一句学习诉求（可带附件/资料路径）→ 课程、章节、知识点大纲。
  命令卡片显示推导阶段与用时；成功后同一条回复末尾出现可编辑的大纲卡片。
- **三种粒度生成内容**：整门课 / 某一章 / 单个知识点。后台任务，刷新页面不丢；
  宿主重启后残留任务标记为 `interrupted`，不会假装还在跑。
- **内容类型**：`图文`（Markdown）、`幻灯片`（Slidev 方言）。`音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`
  目前按 Markdown 降级生成，界面标注「格式待定」。
- **学习页**：Markdown 子集、Slidev 播放器、Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、本地媒体。
  打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`，离开 → `已掌握`；章节/课程进度自动聚合。
- **课程库**：按标签/分类过滤、按名称搜索、打开大纲、进入学习、删除课程（整个课程目录）。
- **课程库设置**：右上角配置按钮可直接修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换目录，无需重启。
- **纯本地数据**：`<courseRoot>/<courseId>/` 下的 JSON + Markdown；无外部存储 backend。
- **引用资料**：建课诉求/附件里点名的文本文件会随课程保存，生成内容时作为「参考资料」注入 prompt。
- **不占用旧 `course` 格位**：面板与 slot id 是 `ai-courses`，可与在装的 `dsh-course-plugin` 共存。

### Agent 工具

模型在会话里可以直接调用三个工具；UI 与工具走同一张 RPC 方法表，语义一致：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `course_read` | 读取课程、大纲与学习进度；生成内容前先读上下文 |
| `course_generate` | 为整门课 / 某一章 / 某些知识点发起后台生成 |
| `course_content_asset_put` | 写回某个知识点的内容资产（正文一律 Markdown） |

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- 已安装并启动 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本**。
- 使用 **Web UI**：`dsh web`，或桌面端内置的 Web 界面。
  TUI / headless 没有课程面板（client half 的 `platform` 是 `web`）。
- DSH 进程对课程库目录有读写权限；默认是 `~/.dsh/ai-courses`。
- 内容生成需要可用的模型与会话（生成动作由某个会话承载模型调用）。
- 从源码构建时另需 Node.js 20+。

### 方式一：npm / CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses
```

桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ai-courses
```

这条命令会同时写入 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不需要手工编辑 profile。

> **已知版本问题**：
> ① 0.1.2 及更早在 `dsh web` 下，客户端在 sidebar 槽声明之前就注册 `sidebar.panellist`，
> 会报 `dsh-ai-courses: failed` —— **0.1.3 已修复**；
> ② 0.1.3 及更早在中文 DSH 下仍可能显示英文 —— apply 时把 `<html lang>` 的初始 `en` 锁死，
> **0.1.4 起修复**（动态读取语言）。
> 建议安装 **0.1.4 或更新版本**。

> 如果 registry 上还搜不到 `dsh-ai-courses`（首次发布尚未完成），用方式三或方式四。

### 方式二：插件市场（推荐）

先确认已安装插件市场：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索「AI 课程」并安装。

> 桌面端通常已内置插件市场；没有的话把 `web` 换成 `desktop` 装一次。
> 如果市场里还搜不到，说明尚未收录；用下面的 npm 或本地方式。

### 方式三：从源码构建安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aix-plugin/ai-courses.git
cd ai-courses

# Mermaid 是浏览器按需加载的 vendor 文件；仓库已带，缺失时下载
node scripts/vendor-mermaid.mjs

# src/ → package/
node scripts/build.mjs

# 安装的是构建产物 package/，不是仓库根目录
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/package"
```

> ⚠️ 仓库根目录没有 `package.json`，`dsh plugin add` 必须指向 `package/`。

### 方式四：本地 tarball（内网/离线分发）

```bash
cd ai-courses/package
npm pack
# 产出 dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz
# 注意用绝对路径：dsh plugin 在 profile 目录里执行 pnpm，相对路径会解析错
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz"
```

### 安装后确认

1. **完全退出并重新打开 DSH**。新装 bundle 有时能热加载，但**替换/升级必须重启**才能加载新的 JS 模块。
2. 打开 **设置 → 插件**，确认 `dsh-ai-courses` 存在且已启用。
3. 侧边栏出现「AI 课程」面板。
4. 在会话里输入 `/`，能看到 `/ai-course`。

如果只有面板没有命令，或只有命令没有面板，通常是 host/client 有一半没加载：重启并查看宿主日志。

---

## 快速开始

### 1. 建课

在任意会话里发送：

```
/ai-course 用 3 章讲清 React Server Components，我熟悉 Vue 不熟 React
```

也可以带上资料：

```
/ai-course 根据 ./docs/rsc-spec.md 和附件，用 3 章讲清 React Server Components
```

建课时会发生：

- 命令卡片显示「已收到诉求，正在交给模型 / 已拿到课程结构，正在校验 / 正在写入课程库」等阶段与用时。
- 成功后回复末尾出现**课程大纲卡片**：章节、知识点、类型、时长（内容生成后回填）、生成状态、学习进度。
- 可以直接在卡片里改名、增删章节与知识点，也可以点「打开完整大纲」。
- 如果已存在同名课程，会先展示已有大纲并询问是否新建，避免误建重复课程。

### 2. 管理课程

打开侧边栏「AI 课程」：

- 课程库：按标签/分类过滤，按名称搜索。
- 课程库右上角的配置图标：修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换（见[配置](#配置)）。
- 课程卡片：名称、描述、标签、学习进度、大纲入口、学习入口、删除。
- 大纲页：修正章节/知识点，发起内容生成。

### 3. 生成内容

在大纲页、学习页或生成弹窗里选择范围：

- 生成整门课内容
- 生成本章全部内容
- 生成这个知识点

说明：

- 生成在后台进行，界面按约 1.5s 轮询进度；刷新页面不丢任务。
- 已有内容时会询问「保留并追加」还是「覆盖」。
- 生成需要由一个会话承载模型调用；如果提示「先打开任意会话」，先在左侧新建/打开一个会话。
- 宿主重启后，未完成的任务会标记为 `interrupted`，可以重新发起。
- 输入框上方的常驻状态条会显示「正在为哪门课写哪个知识点 / 已完成几个」，切换面板也能看到。

### 4. 学习

点击课程卡片上的「学习」，或在大纲里点某个已生成内容的知识点：

- `图文`：本地 Markdown 正文；支持 Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、示意图。
- `幻灯片`：Slidev 方言 Markdown，按页播放，支持讲稿。
- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`：当前按 Markdown 降级展示，标注「格式待定」。
- 打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`；离开/切换 → `已掌握`。没有额外的「标记已掌握」按钮。

### 5. 删除课程

课程卡片底部 → 删除 → 二次确认。

删除会连同该课程的章节、知识点、内容资产、生成任务、学习进度**一起删掉**（删除整个课程目录），且不可撤销。如果只是暂时不用这个插件，先在设置里停用它，不要删课程数据。

---

## 参考资料与附件

建课时可以通过两种方式提供资料：

1. **附件**：输入框的附件按钮，或 `@` 选择文件。
2. **诉求里的路径**：例如 `./docs/spec.md`、`@/tmp/notes.md`、`~/notes/spec.yaml`。

边界：

- 只读取**文本类**文件（md / txt / json / yaml / ts / py / csv 等）。
- 图片、二进制、URL 不会被抓取；不联网抓网页。
- 最多 **6 个**引用；单文件 **6000 字符**、单次合计 **24000 字符**，超出会截断并在 prompt 里标注「以上为节选」。
- 文件不存在 / 不是文本 / 无权限时**静默跳过**，不会阻断建课或生成。
- 诉求原文与附件副本会存进课程目录的 `sources/`，之后生成知识点时继续作为参考资料。

---

## 配置

### `courseRoot`

默认课程库：

```
~/.dsh/ai-courses
```

### 从界面修改（推荐）

课程库右上角 → **配置图标** → 修改「课程库目录（courseRoot）」→ **保存并切换**。

- 保存后**立即生效**，不需要重启 DSH；课程库会刷新到新目录。
- 旧目录里的课程**不会被移动或删除**；切回旧路径仍然能看到。
- 有生成任务或课程推导在跑时不允许切换，等任务结束再试。
- 设置保存在当前 profile 目录的 `ai-courses.settings.json`，**优先于** profile patch 里的 `courseRoot`。
- 目录必须是绝对路径；`~` 会展开；目标目录必须可写（host 会自动创建并做一次写探测）。
- 弹窗里会显示「当前生效」目录、来源（默认值 / profile 配置 / 界面设置）和设置文件位置。

### 从 profile patch 修改（默认/回退）

没有界面设置时，`courseRoot` 取自对应 profile 的 patch（web 示例）：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: ai-courses
  name: dsh-ai-courses
  config:
    courseRoot: /Users/you/Documents/ai-courses
```

桌面端对应 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`。

规则：

- 支持 `~` 展开；展开后必须是**绝对路径**，相对路径会被拒绝。
- patch 里的 `config` 是**整体替换**，不是深合并；插件会自动回填缺省值。
- 改完重启 DSH 生效。
- 一旦在界面里保存过设置，`ai-courses.settings.json` 会覆盖 patch 值；删掉该文件并重启，才会回到 patch 值。
- `maxParallelGenerations`、`defaultContentType` 目前只是配置兼容保留，**不改变运行时行为**，不要把它们当开关。

### 其他

- 插件包名：`dsh-ai-courses`
- bundle patch 行 id：`ai-courses`
- client platform：`web`
- 零运行时依赖；不写会话事件

---

## 数据与备份

### 目录结构

```
<courseRoot>/                         默认 ~/.dsh/ai-courses
└── c-20261013142530-a7f3/            课程 id = 目录名
    ├── course.json                   课程元数据 + 大纲 + schemaVersion
    ├── progress.json                 学习进度（只存知识点层）
    ├── tasks.json                    内容生成任务
    ├── content-assets/
    │   ├── <kpId>.json               内容资产信封（元数据、mediaRefs）
    │   ├── <kpId>.md                 图文正文
    │   ├── <kpId>.slides.md          幻灯片正文
    │   └── media/                    示意图等本地媒体
    └── sources/                      诉求原文与附件副本
        ├── request.md
        └── <附件文件名>
```

- `course.json` 里内联章节与知识点；`progress.json` 只存知识点进度，章节/课程进度由它派生。
- 正文里的媒体引用是**课程目录内的相对路径**，整个课程目录可以搬走。
- 删除课程 = 删除这一个目录，不存在跨系统的非原子删除。

### 备份与迁移

直接复制整个 `<courseRoot>`：

```bash
cp -R ~/.dsh/ai-courses ~/backup/ai-courses-$(date +%F)
```

换机器时把目录拷过去，然后在课程库右上角的配置里把 `courseRoot` 指到新位置（或删掉 `ai-courses.settings.json` 后改 profile patch、重启）。

### 版本与损坏

- 每个结构化 JSON 文件都有 `schemaVersion`；`course.json` / `progress.json` 带版本守卫。
- 如果 `course.json` / `progress.json` 来自**更新版本**的插件，旧代码会**只读降级**：可浏览、禁止写入，不会静默改写你的数据。
- JSON 解析失败时，该文件降级为空，并把原文件另存为 `.corrupt-<时间戳>`，其他课程不受影响。
- 早期版本写入的 SVG 可能不是合法 XML，浏览器不显示。在仓库内跑一次清洗器（会先预演并备份 `.bak`）：

```bash
node scripts/repair-media.mjs --write
```

---

## 升级、停用与卸载

| 场景 | 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 升级（npm） | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses@latest` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（市场） | 插件市场 → 更新 | 按提示重启 |
| 升级（本地 link） | `git pull && node scripts/build.mjs` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（tarball） | 重新 `npm pack` 后 `dsh plugin add` 新 tgz | 重启 DSH |
| 临时停用 | 设置 → 插件 → 关闭 | 界面消失，课程数据保留 |
| 卸载 | 设置 → 插件 → 卸载（推荐）；或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ai-courses`，并确认 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有残留 | **不会删除课程数据** |
| 删除数据 | 手动删除 `<courseRoot>` | 不可撤销，先备份 |

升级注意：

- **替换已安装包必须重启**才能加载新的 JavaScript 模块；只刷新页面不够。
- slot id 没变不代表浏览器端代码已更新，以重启后的界面为准。
- 升级不会动课程数据；但如果 `schemaVersion` 升了，回滚到旧版本会让数据变成只读（这是刻意的保护）。
- 回滚最快的方式是先在「设置 → 插件」里停用，而不是卸载。

---

## 已知限制

- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验` 目前只按 Markdown 降级生成，标注「格式待定」。
- `测验` 只展示题目与答案，不能作答判分。
- 音频/视频不做合成，只支持本地挂载素材。
- 课程数据纯本地，没有云同步；换机器需手动拷贝 `courseRoot`。
- 进度是轮询更新（约 1.5s），不是实时推送。
- 内容生成依赖模型与会话；模型不可用时无法生成。
- 幻灯片使用 Slidev 方言，但不是完整的 Slidev 运行时；只支持本插件实现的版式与能力。
- Mermaid 渲染器约 3.4 MB，按需加载；拿不到 vendor 文件时图表会降级成源码块，不会

plugins.description: Live wallpaper layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — procedural presets, images, GIF and video behind a translucent shell
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lively

Live wallpaper layer for the **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI**: an animated wallpaper
behind the interface — procedural presets, images, GIF or video — with a small
settings page to pick the look.

![Light theme preview](docs/preview-light.png)

**[▶ Watch the 47-second intro video](https://github.com/hero-jianghaojie/dsh-lively/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-lively-intro.mp4)** — narrated tour of the presets, custom wallpapers, playlist and controls (1080p30, Chinese narration).

## Features

- **Six procedural presets** — Flow, Aurora, Starfield, Lava, Mesh, Neon grid.
  Flow is the deliberately animated one (position + size drift); each preset has
  a dark variant for the dark palette and a bright variant for the light
  palette, so a light theme never ends up with a grey wash.
- **Custom wallpaper** — image, GIF, WebP, AVIF, MP4 or WebM, by URL or uploaded
  from disk. Uploads live under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-media/` and are served by
  the plugin's own route, so they survive a reload and a restart.
- **Controls** — wallpaper strength (how much wallpaper shows through), dim,
  video softness, animation speed, a motion switch (the reduced-motion escape
  hatch), pause when the window is hidden.
- **Playlist** — rotate through any subset of the presets every 1–240 minutes,
  in order or shuffled.
- **Wallpaper library** — every uploaded file is listed in Settings, so a
  wallpaper picked last week is one click away; the host lists
  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-media/` through `/dsh-lively/library`.
- **Theme aware** — the veil is keyed on `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the
  bright/dark preset variants are keyed on `html:has(> body[data-ds-dark-theme])`.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hero-jianghaojie/dsh-lively.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-lively
```

Then restart DSH (the sidebar's restart button, if installed) and open
**Settings → Live wallpaper**.

## How it works

- The wallpaper lives in one fixed layer at `z-index:-1` (`#dsh-lively-layer`)
  with three children: the animated **surface**, the theme-coloured **veil**
  (`strength`) and the **dim** overlay. The layer is appended to the root so it
  sits under every column.
- Why not the root element's own background? Chromium paints the root background
  into the canvas background layer; a `background-position`/`background-size`
  animation on `html` advances the animation clock but does not repaint on
  screen, so the presets looked static. An ordinary element repaints, and that
  is what the layer uses.
- The shell paints `--dsw-alias-bg-base` on the frame *and* on the centre
  column, and alphas multiply. The token is therefore fully **transparent**, so
  the layer shows through with the single veil painted once, above the surface.
- No `backdrop-filter` on the shell columns: it would make them the containing
  block for fixed-position descendants, and the sidebar's fold toggle is
  `position: fixed` — frosting the column drags that button onto the brand mark.
- Settings persist twice: `localStorage` (instant) and
  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-lively-state.json` via `/dsh-lively/state`, because the Desktop
  app's loopback port changes on every launch.

## Limitations

- A video wallpaper needs a real `<video>` element; CSS alone cannot play video.
- The softness control applies to video only — CSS cannot blur the root
  background, and blurring the columns breaks fixed-position shell chrome.
- The frame-transparency rule targets `[class$='_frame']`, which follows the
  shell's CSS-module naming.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
